1. The Section of Analysis

Anulomaṃ – hetupaccayo

Positive Method – Root Condition

53. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0019] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko [T 1.0025] khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

53. A wholesome phenomenon arises in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on wholesome aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. Wholesome and neutral phenomena arise in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form arise. (3)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ [V 1.0021] dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises in dependence on an unwholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on an unwholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on unwholesome aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. Unwholesome and neutral phenomena arise in dependence on an unwholesome phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form arise. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ[T 1.0026]. (1)

A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on a neutral phenomenon by root condition: in dependence on one resultant-neutral or functional-neutral aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant-neutral aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-produced material form arise; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise; in dependence on the aggregates, the physical basis arises; in dependence on the physical basis, aggregates arise; in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise; in dependence on three great elements, one great element arises; in dependence on two great elements, two great elements arise; in dependence on the great elements, mind-produced material form, kamma-produced material form, and derived material form arise. (1)

Kusalañca [M 1.0020] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on wholesome and neutral phenomena by root condition: in dependence on wholesome aggregates and great elements, mind-produced material form arises. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on unwholesome and neutral phenomena by root condition: in dependence on unwholesome aggregates and great elements, mind-produced material form arises. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

54. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

54. A wholesome phenomenon arises in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by object condition: in dependence on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises in dependence on an unwholesome phenomenon by object condition: in dependence on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Abyākataṃ [V 1.0022] dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. (1)

A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on a neutral phenomenon by object condition: in dependence on one resultant-neutral or functional-neutral aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant-neutral aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; in dependence on the physical basis, aggregates arise. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

55. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ [T 1.0027] paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

55. A wholesome phenomenon arises in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by dominance condition: in dependence on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. A neutral phenomenon arises in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by dominance condition: in dependence on wholesome aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. Wholesome and neutral phenomena arise in dependence on a wholesome phenomenon by dominance condition: in dependence on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced material form arise; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form arise. (3)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo [M 1.0021] uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three unwholesome aggregates condition one aggregate; two unwholesome aggregates condition two aggregates. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: unwholesome aggregates condition mind-produced material form. Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form; three unwholesome aggregates condition one aggregate and mind-produced material form; two unwholesome aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ[V 1.0023], dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve [T 1.0028] mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dominance condition: one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form; three such aggregates condition one aggregate and mind-produced material form; two such aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. One great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition mind-produced material form and derived material form. (1)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of the dominance condition: wholesome aggregates and great elements condition mind-produced material form. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of the dominance condition: unwholesome aggregates and great elements condition mind-produced material form. (1)

Anantara-samanantarapaccayā

Immediacy Condition and Contiguity Condition

56. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā. (Anantarampi samanantarampi ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

56. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of immediacy condition… by way of contiguity condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates. Both the immediacy condition and the contiguity condition are similar to the object condition.

Sahajātapaccayo

The Co-nascence Condition

57. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti sahajātapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

57. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three wholesome aggregates condition one aggregate; two wholesome aggregates condition two aggregates. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: wholesome aggregates condition mind-produced material form. Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form; three wholesome aggregates condition one aggregate and mind-produced material form; two wholesome aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. (3)

Akusalaṃ [M 1.0022] dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca [T 1.0029] dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti [V 1.0024] sahajātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three unwholesome aggregates condition one aggregate; two unwholesome aggregates condition two aggregates. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: unwholesome aggregates condition mind-produced material form. Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form; three unwholesome aggregates condition one aggregate and mind-produced material form; two unwholesome aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ; āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte [T 1.0030] paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ; utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ; asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the co-nascence condition: one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced material form; three such aggregates condition one aggregate and mind-produced material form; two such aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced material form. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and kamma-produced material form; three such aggregates condition one aggregate and kamma-produced material form; two such aggregates condition two aggregates and kamma-produced material form. Aggregates condition the base; the base conditions aggregates. One great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition mind-produced material form, kamma-produced material form, and derived material form. Externally, one great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition derived material form. Nutriment-produced: one great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition derived material form. Temperature-produced: one great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition derived material form. In beings without perception: one great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements; great elements condition kamma-produced material form and derived material form. (1)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition: wholesome aggregates and great elements condition mind-produced material form. (1)

Akusalañca [M 1.0023] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of the co-nascence condition: unwholesome aggregates and great elements condition mind-produced material form. (1)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutual Condition

58. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0025] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

58. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the mutual condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the mutual condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo [T 1.0031] khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vatthu ca, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho vatthu ca, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vatthu ca; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the mutual condition: one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and the physical base; three aggregates condition one aggregate and the physical base; two aggregates condition two aggregates and the physical base. Aggregates condition the physical base; the physical base conditions aggregates. One great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements. External… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… In beings without perception, one great element conditions three great elements; three great elements condition one great element; two great elements condition two great elements. (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Support Condition

59. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati nissayapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…. (Nissayapaccayaṃ sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ.)

59. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the support condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate…. (The support condition is similar to the co-nascence condition.)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

60. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati upanissayapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…. (Upanissayapaccayaṃ ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

60. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate…. (The decisive support condition is similar to the object condition.)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

61. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0024][V 1.0026] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

61. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe [T 1.0032] paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition: one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

62. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

62. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of the repetition condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of repetition condition: dependent on one functional-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

63. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0027] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

63. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon... [the three permutations follow].

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [M 1.0025] rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; asaññasattānaṃ [T 1.0033] ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate [states], dependent on one aggregate... [etc.]; at the moment of rebirth-linking... [etc.]; dependent on one great element, three great elements arise... [etc.]; dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise. For non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise... [etc.]; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates and great elements, mind-produced materiality arises. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates and great elements, mind-produced materiality arises. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

64. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā; tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

64. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of result condition: for a resultant-indeterminate [state], dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, for a resultant-indeterminate [state]: dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise. Aggregates are a condition for the base; the base is a condition for aggregates. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. Dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

65. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0028] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

65. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate... [the three permutations follow].

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ [T 1.0034] paṭicca… tīṇi.

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate... [the three permutations follow].

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ.

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate [states], dependent on one aggregate... [etc.]; at the moment of rebirth-linking... [etc.]; dependent on one great element, three great elements arise... [etc.]; dependent on the great elements, mind-produced materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise. For nutriment-produced [materiality]: dependent on one great element... [etc.]; dependent on the great elements, derived materiality arises.

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe….

Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon... [etc.].

Akusalañca [M 1.0026] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates and great elements, mind-produced materiality arises.

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

66. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati indriyapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

66. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of faculty condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate... [the three permutations follow].

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon... [the three permutations follow].

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (Indriyapaccayaṃ kammapaccayasadisaṃ.)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon... [etc.]. For non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element... [etc.]. (The faculty condition is similar to the kamma condition.)

Jhāna-maggapaccayā

Jhāna Condition and Path Condition

67. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0029] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā. (Jhānapaccayampi maggapaccayampi hetupaccayasadisaṃ.)

67. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of jhāna condition... by way of path condition. (The jhāna condition and the path condition are similar to the root condition.)

Sampayuttapaccayo

Associated Condition

68. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati sampayuttapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca…. (Sampayuttapaccayaṃ ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

68. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of associated condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate... [etc.]. (The associated condition is similar to the object condition.)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociated Condition

69. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca [T 1.0035] eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

69. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; the base is a condition by way of dissociation. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates, mind-produced materiality arises; the aggregates are a condition by way of dissociation. Both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-produced materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced materiality arise. The aggregates are a condition for the base by way of dissociation. Mind-produced materiality is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation. (3)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato [M 1.0027] dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. To the base, by way of dissociated condition. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: mind-originated materiality arises dependent on unwholesome aggregates. To the aggregates, by way of dissociated condition. Both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. The aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. Mind-originated materiality is a dissociated condition for the aggregates. (3)

Abyākataṃ [V 1.0030] dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo [T 1.0036] uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Vatthu khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociated condition. In the case of resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate states: dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. The aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. Mind-originated materiality is a dissociated condition for the aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in the case of resultant-indeterminate states: dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise. The aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. Kamma-originated materiality is a dissociated condition for the aggregates. Dependent on the aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, the aggregates. The aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. The base is a dissociated condition for the aggregates. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. To the aggregates, by way of dissociated condition. (1)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: mind-originated materiality arises dependent on wholesome aggregates and great elements. To the aggregates, by way of dissociated condition. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociated condition: mind-originated materiality arises dependent on unwholesome aggregates and great elements. To the aggregates, by way of dissociated condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

70. Kusalaṃ [T 1.0037] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati atthipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā.

70. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of presence condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise.

(Saṅkhitaṃ. Atthipaccayaṃ sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ.)

(Abbreviated. The presence condition is similar to the co-nascence condition.)

Natthi-vigatapaccayā

Absence and Disappearance Conditions

71. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0028][V 1.0031] dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā. (Natthipaccayampi vigatapaccayampi ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

71. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of absence condition… by way of disappearance condition. (The absence condition and the disappearance condition are similar to the object condition.)

Avigatapaccayo

Non-Disappearance Condition

72. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati avigatapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā. (Avigatapaccayaṃ sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ).

72. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon by way of non-disappearance condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise. (The non-disappearance condition is similar to the co-nascence condition.)

(Ime tevīsatipaccayā sajjhāyantena vitthāretabbā.)

(These twenty-three conditions should be elaborated by one who recites.)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

The Pure

73. Paccanīyaṃ – nahetupaccayo

The Negative – Non-root Condition

86. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

86. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Abyākataṃ [M 1.0032] dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [T 1.0041] rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ[V 1.0036]; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a neutral phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: dependent on one rootless resultant-neutral or functional-neutral aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant-neutral aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-object Condition

87. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

87. Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca [T 1.0042] vatthu; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a neutral phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on resultant-neutral or functional-neutral aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on resultant-neutral aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises; dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. Dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon and a neutral phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Akusalañca [M 1.0033][V 1.0037] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and a neutral phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-object condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-dominance Condition

88. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve [T 1.0043] khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

88. Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon, wholesome and neutral phenomena arise by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti naadhipatipaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, a neutral phenomenon arises by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, unwholesome and neutral phenomena arise by way of non-dominance condition: dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte [V 1.0038] paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0044]… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ [M 1.0034] paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon not by dominance condition: in the case of resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate phenomena, dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and matter produced by mind arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and matter produced by mind arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and matter produced by mind arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in the case of a resultant-indeterminate phenomenon, dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-produced matter arise; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced matter arise. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical basis arises; dependent on the physical basis, the aggregates arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise. Dependent on the great elements, matter produced by mind, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter arise. External… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… In the case of non-percipient beings: dependent on one great element, three great elements arise; dependent on three great elements, one great element arises; dependent on two great elements, two great elements arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced matter and derived matter arise. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

90. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon not by mutuality condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates, matter produced by mind arises. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon not by mutuality condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates, matter produced by mind arises. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati naaññamaññapaccayā – vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākate khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ; mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhire mahābhūte paṭicca [T 1.0045] upādārūpaṃ; āhārasamuṭṭhāne mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ[V 1.0039]; utusamuṭṭhāne mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ; asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

Napurejātapaccayo

Not by Prenascence Condition

92. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kusalo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – kusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

92. A wholesome phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon not by prenascence condition: in the formless sphere, dependent on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on a wholesome phenomenon not by prenascence condition: dependent on wholesome aggregates, matter produced by mind arises. (2)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – akusale khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0046] rūpaṃ. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon not by prenascence condition: in the formless sphere, dependent on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. An indeterminate phenomenon arises dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon not by prenascence condition: dependent on unwholesome aggregates, matter produced by mind arises. (2)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[V 1.0040]; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paṭicca ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

192. Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, vippayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ, (sabbattha ekaṃ) …pe….

192. By non-root condition, by non-object condition, by non-predominance condition, by non-contiguity condition, by non-immediate contiguity condition, and by non-reciprocity condition: one by co-nascence condition, one by dependence condition, one by kamma condition, one by result condition, one by nutriment condition, one by faculty condition, one by absorption condition, one by dissociation condition, one by presence condition, and one by non-disappearance condition (one in every case) …and so on….

Ekādasakaṃ

The Elevenfold

(Yāvāsevanā sabbaṃ sadisaṃ, nakamme gaṇite pañca pañhā honti.)

(Up to repetition condition, all is analogous. When non-kamma condition is counted, there are five questions.)

Dvādasakaṃ

The Twelvefold

Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā…pe… naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, āhāre [T 1.0071] ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

By non-root condition, by non-object condition… and so on… by non-repetition condition, and by non-kamma condition: one by co-nascence condition, one by dependence condition, one by nutriment condition, one by presence condition, and one by non-disappearance condition… and so on.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

234. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0075][M 1.0066] dhammaṃ sahajāto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto kusalo [T 1.0081] ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

234. Co-nascent with a wholesome phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by way of root condition: three aggregates are co-nascent with one wholesome aggregate; one aggregate is co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates are co-nascent with two aggregates. Co-nascent with a wholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind-originated matter is co-nascent with the wholesome aggregates. Co-nascent with a wholesome phenomenon, both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of root condition: three aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with one wholesome aggregate; one aggregate and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with two aggregates. (3)

235. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

235. Co-nascent with an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of root condition: three aggregates are co-nascent with one unwholesome aggregate; one aggregate is co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates are co-nascent with two aggregates. Co-nascent with an unwholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind-originated matter is co-nascent with the unwholesome aggregates. Co-nascent with an unwholesome phenomenon, both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of root condition: three aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with one unwholesome aggregate; one aggregate and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with two aggregates. (3)

236. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā [V 1.0076] kaṭattā [T 1.0082] ca rūpaṃ; khandhe sahajātaṃ vatthu, vatthuṃ sahajātā [M 1.0067] khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sahajātā tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte sahajātaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte sahajātā dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

236. Co-nascent with an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of root condition: in the case of resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate phenomena, three aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with one aggregate; one aggregate and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates and mind-originated matter are co-nascent with two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in the case of resultant-indeterminate phenomena, three aggregates and kamma-originated matter are co-nascent with one aggregate; one aggregate and kamma-originated matter are co-nascent with three aggregates; two aggregates and kamma-originated matter are co-nascent with two aggregates. The physical base is co-nascent with the aggregates; the aggregates are co-nascent with the physical base. Three great elements are co-nascent with one great element; one great element is co-nascent with three great elements; two great elements are co-nascent with two great elements. Mind-originated matter, kamma-originated matter, and derived matter are co-nascent with the great elements. (1)

237. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

237. Co-nascent with a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind-originated matter is co-nascent with the wholesome aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Co-nascent with an unwholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of root condition: mind-originated matter is co-nascent with the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Suddhaṃ

The Pure Section

238. Hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme nava, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava.

238. By root condition, nine; by object condition, three; by predominance condition, nine; by contiguity condition, three; by immediate contiguity condition, three; by co-nascence condition, nine; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, nine; by strong dependence condition, three; by pre-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, three; by kamma condition, nine; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by absorption condition, nine; by path condition, nine; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, three; by disappearance condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

Nahetupaccayo

The Non-Root Condition

239. Akusalaṃ [V 1.0077] dhammaṃ sahajāto akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe sahajāto vicikicchāsahagato [T 1.0083] uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

239. Co-nascent with an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition: the delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is co-nascent with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Abyākataṃ [M 1.0068] dhammaṃ sahajāto abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe sahajāto eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe sahajātā dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, khandhe sahajātaṃ vatthu, vatthuṃ sahajātā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sahajātā tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte sahajātaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte sahajātā dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte sahajātaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ sahajātā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte sahajātaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises co-nascent with an indeterminate phenomenon by non-root condition: one rootless resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is co-nascent with three aggregates and mind-originated materiality; three aggregates are co-nascent with one aggregate and mind-originated materiality; two aggregates are co-nascent with two aggregates and mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is co-nascent with three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality; three aggregates are co-nascent with one aggregate and kamma-originated materiality; two aggregates are co-nascent with two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality; the aggregates are co-nascent with the physical base; the physical base is co-nascent with the aggregates. One great element is co-nascent with three great elements; three great elements are co-nascent with one great element; two great elements are co-nascent with two great elements; the great elements are co-nascent with mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element is co-nascent with three great elements… and so on… the great elements are co-nascent with kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality. (1)

(Yathā paṭiccavāre, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition

243. Kusalaṃ [T 1.0085][V 1.0079] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

243. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by root condition: conditioned by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate arises; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by root condition: conditioned by wholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by root condition: conditioned by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

244. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti [M 1.0070] hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

244. Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by root condition: conditioned by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate arises; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by root condition: conditioned by unwholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by root condition: conditioned by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

245. Abyākataṃ [T 1.0086] dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ[V 1.0080]; khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte paccayā ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte paccayā dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā. (1)

245. Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by root condition: conditioned by one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated materiality arise; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, conditioned by one resultant-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise; conditioned by three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-originated materiality arise; conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise. Conditioned by the aggregates, the physical base arises; conditioned by the physical base, the aggregates arise. Conditioned by one great element, three great elements arise; conditioned by three great elements, one great element arises; conditioned by two great elements, two great elements arise. Conditioned by the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. Conditioned by the physical base, resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates arise. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates. (2)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: the physical base conditions unwholesome aggregates. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

Both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates; the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. (4)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

Both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: the physical base conditions unwholesome aggregates; the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. (5)

Kusalañca [T 1.0087] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[M 1.0071]. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

246. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: one wholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates; three aggregates and the physical base condition one aggregate; two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. An indeterminate phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: wholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. Both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise conditioned by a wholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: one wholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates; three aggregates and the physical base condition one aggregate; two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; wholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. (3)

247. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā [V 1.0081] eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā eko khandho[T 1.0088], dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

247. An unwholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an unwholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates; three aggregates and the physical base condition one aggregate; two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. An indeterminate phenomenon arises conditioned by an unwholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: unwholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. Both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise conditioned by an unwholesome and indeterminate phenomenon through root condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates; three aggregates and the physical base condition one aggregate; two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; unwholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality. Dominance Condition

253. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon through dominance condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions… three.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā.
