Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā.

An indeterminate state conditions a wholesome state by way of mutuality condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates.

(Yathā ārammaṇapaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(To be detailed as with the object condition.)

Nissayapaccayo

Dependence Condition

257. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati nissayapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā.

257. A wholesome state conditions a wholesome state by way of dependence condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions the other three aggregates.

(Yathā sahajātapaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(To be detailed as with the co-nascence condition.)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

258. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati upanissayapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā. (Ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

258. A wholesome state conditions a wholesome state by way of decisive support condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions another. (Similar to the object condition.)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

259. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0085] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

259. A wholesome state conditions a wholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition. One wholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ [T 1.0092] paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An unwholesome state conditions an unwholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe [M 1.0075] paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā.

An indeterminate state conditions an indeterminate state by way of pre-nascence condition: resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate, one aggregate conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates; the physical base is a pre-nascence condition; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates; the physical base is a pre-nascence condition.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā.

An indeterminate state conditions a wholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates; the physical base is a pre-nascence condition.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (3)

An indeterminate state conditions an unwholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition: the physical base conditions unwholesome aggregates; the physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (3)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

A wholesome and an indeterminate state condition a wholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An unwholesome and an indeterminate state condition an unwholesome state by way of pre-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

260. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0086] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā [T 1.0093] – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe….

260. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition. One wholesome aggregate conditions…

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe….

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition. One unwholesome aggregate conditions…

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā kiriyābyākatā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of repetition condition: one functionally indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates, three aggregates condition one aggregate, two aggregates condition two aggregates; the physical base conditions functionally indeterminate aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition: the physical base conditions unwholesome aggregates.

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā…pe….

Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena condition…

Akusalañca [M 1.0076] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe….

Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena condition an unwholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates…

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

261. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

261. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions… three.

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā… tīṇi.

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition… three.

Abyākataṃ [V 1.0087] dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ [T 1.0094] paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: resultant-indeterminate, functional-indeterminate. One aggregate… at the moment of rebirth-linking… one great element… for non-percipient beings, one great element… the great elements condition kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality; the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition: the physical base conditions wholesome aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā…pe…. (5)

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition: the physical base conditions unwholesome aggregates…

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo…pe… abyākato dhammo…pe… kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti kammapaccayā…pe….

Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena condition a wholesome phenomenon… an indeterminate phenomenon… wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of kamma condition…

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo…pe… abyākato dhammo…pe… akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti kammapaccayā, akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā…pe… akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.

Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena condition an unwholesome phenomenon… an indeterminate phenomenon… unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of kamma condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base condition… unwholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality.

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

262. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā. Vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā khandhā.

262. An indeterminate phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon by way of result condition. One resultant-indeterminate aggregate conditions… at the moment of rebirth-linking… one great element conditions… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant-indeterminate aggregates.

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

263. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0077][V 1.0088] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

263. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon by way of nutriment condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions three.

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions… three.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā [T 1.0095] khandhā. (Paripuṇṇaṃ.)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking… one nutriment-originated great element… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates. (Complete.)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

264. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati indriyapaccayā…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā.

264. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon by way of faculty condition… for non-percipient beings, one great element conditions… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates.

(Indriyapaccayā yathā kammapaccayā, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

Just as the kamma condition, so too should the faculty condition be explained in detail.

Jhāna-maggapaccayā

Jhāna and Path Conditions

265. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati jhānapaccayā…pe… maggapaccayā.

265. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon by way of jhāna condition… by way of path condition.

(Jhānapaccayāpi maggapaccayāpi yathā hetupaccayā, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

Just as the root condition, so too should the jhāna condition and the path condition be explained in detail.

Sampayuttapaccayo

Associated Condition

266. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0089] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati sampayuttapaccayā. (Ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ.)

266. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon by way of associated condition. (Similar to the object condition.)

Vippayuttapaccayo

The dissociated condition.

267. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā[M 1.0078]. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – kusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0096] rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

267. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition. Conditioned by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by wholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition. Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. (3)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition: conditioned by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base. Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition: conditioned by unwholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition. Conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon, unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of dissociated condition: conditioned by one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, kaṭattārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā, khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā[V 1.0090], vatthu khandhe vippayuttapaccayā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ [T 1.0097] paccayā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā; cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (1)

Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition. In the case of resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates: conditioned by one aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in the case of resultant-indeterminate aggregates: conditioned by one aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise… conditioned by two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced materiality arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for kamma-produced materiality. Conditioned by the aggregates, the base arises; conditioned by the base, the aggregates arise. The aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the base is a dissociated condition for the aggregates. Conditioned by one great element… conditioned by the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality arise; the aggregates are a dissociated condition. Conditioned by the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… conditioned by the body-base, body-consciousness arises. Conditioned by the base, resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates arise; the base is a dissociated condition. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (2)

Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by the base, wholesome aggregates arise; the base is a dissociated condition. (2)

Abyākataṃ [M 1.0079] dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by the base, unwholesome aggregates arise; the base is a dissociated condition. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (4)

Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by the base, wholesome aggregates arise; conditioned by the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. (4)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā akusalā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (5)

Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of dissociated condition—conditioned by the base, unwholesome aggregates arise; conditioned by the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. (5)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalañca abyākatañca [T 1.0098] dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā. Kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā, kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

Conditioned by a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition. Conditioned by one wholesome aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise; conditioned by three aggregates and the base, one aggregate arises; conditioned by two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise; the base is a dissociated condition. Conditioned by a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by way of dissociated condition. Conditioned by wholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition. Conditioned by a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon, wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by way of dissociated condition. Conditioned by one wholesome aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise; conditioned by three aggregates and the base, one aggregate arises; conditioned by two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise. Conditioned by wholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; the aggregates are a dissociated condition for the base, and the aggregates are a dissociated condition for mind-originated materiality. (3)

Akusalañca [V 1.0091] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti vippayuttapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhā, akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca [M 1.0080] paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, khandhā vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā, cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ khandhe vippayuttapaccayā. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon condition an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dissociated condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the base condition two aggregates; the base is related by way of the dissociated condition. An unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon condition an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dissociated condition: the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates are related by way of the dissociated condition. An unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon condition unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of the dissociated condition: one unwholesome aggregate and the base condition three aggregates... two aggregates; the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements condition mind-originated materiality; the aggregates are related to the base by way of the dissociated condition, and mind-originated materiality is related to the aggregates by way of the dissociated condition. (3)

Atthipaccayādi

Beginning with the Presence Condition

268. Kusalaṃ [T 1.0099] dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati atthipaccayā…pe… (atthipaccayā sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ kātabbaṃ. Natthipaccayā vigatapaccayā ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ, avigatapaccayā sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ.)

268. A wholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon through the presence condition... (The presence condition is similar to the co-nascence condition. The absence condition and the disappearance condition are similar to the object condition. The non-disappearance condition is similar to the co-nascence condition.)

By the root condition, seventeen; by the object condition, seven; by the predominance condition, seventeen; by the contiguity condition, seven; by the immediate contiguity condition, seven; by the co-nascence condition, seventeen; by the reciprocity condition, seven; by the dependence condition, seventeen; by the strong dependence condition, seven; by the pre-nascence condition, seven; by the repetition condition, seven; by the kamma condition, seventeen; by the result condition, one; by the nutriment condition, seventeen; by the faculty condition, seventeen; by the jhāna condition, seventeen; by the path condition, seventeen; by the association condition, seven; by the dissociation condition, seventeen; by the presence condition, seventeen; by the absence condition, seven; by the disappearance condition, seven; by the non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

By the root condition, by the object condition, by the predominance condition, by the contiguity condition, by the immediate contiguity condition, by the co-nascence condition, by the reciprocity condition, by the dependence condition, by the strong dependence condition, by the pre-nascence condition, by the repetition condition, in the kamma condition, seven; in the nutriment condition, seven... in the non-disappearance condition, seven...

By the root condition, by the object condition... by the pre-nascence condition, by the kamma condition, by the result condition, in the nutriment condition, one... in the non-disappearance condition, one.

Bāvīsakaṃ (savipākaṃ)

The Twenty-two (with Result)

Hetupaccayā [V 1.0093] ārammaṇapaccayā…pe… purejātapaccayā kammapaccayā vipākapaccayā āhārapaccayā…pe… vigatapaccayā avigate ekaṃ. Hetumūlakaṃ.

By the root condition, by the object condition... by the pre-nascence condition, by the kamma condition, by the result condition, by the nutriment condition... by the disappearance condition, in the non-disappearance condition, one. The Root-based Section.

273. Anantarapaccayā samanantarapaccayā hetuyā satta…pe….

273. By the contiguity condition, by the immediate contiguity condition, in the root condition, seven...

274. Sahajātapaccayā…pe… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā…pe….

Nahetupaccayo

The Non-Root Condition

277. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

277. An unwholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an unwholesome phenomenon through the non-root condition: delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises conditioned by the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ [V 1.0095] kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paccayā vatthu, vatthuṃ paccayā khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ [M 1.0083]… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0102]… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through the non-root condition: rootless resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates; one aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-produced materiality... two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced materiality; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and kamma-produced materiality... two aggregates condition two aggregates and kamma-produced materiality; aggregates condition the base, the base conditions aggregates; one great element conditions three great elements... great elements condition mind-produced materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality; external... nutriment-produced... temperature-produced... for non-percipient beings, one great element conditions three great elements... great elements condition kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality. The eye-base conditions eye-consciousness... the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the base conditions rootless resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon through the non-root condition: the base conditions delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (2)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon arises conditioned by an unwholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon through the non-root condition: the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness and the base condition delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

The Non-Object Condition

278. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0084] dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – kusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.

278. A wholesome phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the non-object condition: wholesome aggregates condition mind-produced materiality.

(Yathā paṭiccavāre naārammaṇapaccayā, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Just as in the Section on Dependence, the non-object condition should be elaborated.)

Naadhipatipaccayo

The Non-Predominance Condition

279. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

279. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of the non-predominance condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions… three.

Akusalaṃ [V 1.0096] dhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions… three.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… (abyākataṃ paripuṇṇaṃ kātabbaṃ). Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions… at the moment of rebirth-linking… (the indeterminate should be made complete). External… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… for non-percipient beings, one great element conditions… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness, the base conditions resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā, vatthuṃ paccayā [T 1.0103] kusalā khandhā…pe….

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of the non-predominance condition: the base conditions wholesome aggregates…

(Yathā anulome sahajātapaccayaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as in the forward order, the co-nascence condition should be reckoned.)

Naanantarādipaccayā

The Non-Immediacy Condition, etc.

280. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati naanantarapaccayā… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… napurejātapaccayā.

280. A wholesome phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the non-immediacy condition… the non-contiguity condition… the non-mutuality condition… the non-strong-dependence condition… the non-prenascence condition.

(Yathā paṭiccavāre, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(As in the Section on Dependence, so it should be elaborated.)

Napacchājātādipaccayā

The Non-Postnascence Condition, etc.

281. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā…pe… (napacchājātapaccayampi naāsevanapaccayampi paripuṇṇaṃ, sattarasa.)

281. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of the non-postnascence condition… by way of the non-repetition condition… the eye-base conditions… (the non-postnascence condition and the non-repetition condition are complete, seventeen).

(Yathā anulome sahajātapaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Just as in the forward order, the co-nascence condition should be elaborated.)

Nakammapaccayo

The Non-Kamma Condition

282. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kusale khandhe paccayā kusalā cetanā. (1)

282. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition: wholesome aggregates condition wholesome volition. (1)

Akusalaṃ [V 1.0097] dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – akusale khandhe paccayā akusalā cetanā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition: unwholesome aggregates condition unwholesome volition. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā, kiriyābyākate khandhe paccayā kiriyābyākatā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā kiriyābyākatā cetanā. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the non-kamma condition: functional-indeterminate aggregates condition functional-indeterminate volition; external… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… one great element conditions… derived materiality; the base conditions functional-indeterminate volition. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā cetanā. (2)

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of non-kamma condition: the base conditions wholesome volition. (2)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vatthuṃ [T 1.0104] paccayā akusalā cetanā. (3)

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an unwholesome phenomenon by way of non-kamma condition: the base conditions unwholesome volition. (3)

Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – kusale khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā kusalā cetanā. (1)

A wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon condition a wholesome phenomenon by way of non-kamma condition: wholesome aggregates and the base condition wholesome volition. (1)

Akusalañca [M 1.0085] abyākatañca dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – akusale khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā akusalā cetanā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon condition an unwholesome phenomenon by way of non-kamma condition: unwholesome aggregates and the base condition unwholesome volition. (1)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-Result Condition

283. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

283. A wholesome phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of non-result condition: one wholesome aggregate conditions… three.

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

An unwholesome phenomenon conditions… three.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā [V 1.0098] dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā kiriyābyākatā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions an indeterminate phenomenon by way of non-result condition: one functional indeterminate aggregate conditions three aggregates and mind-originated materiality… two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-originated materiality; one great element conditions three great elements… great elements condition mind-originated materiality and derived materiality; external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element conditions three great elements… great elements condition kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality; the base conditions functional indeterminate aggregates.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā kusalā khandhā.

An indeterminate phenomenon conditions a wholesome phenomenon by way of non-result condition: the base conditions wholesome aggregates.

(Vipākaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Excluding result, it should be elaborated everywhere.)

Naāhārādipaccayā

Non-Nutriment and Other Conditions

284. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā… naindriyapaccayā… najhānapaccayā…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. (Na [T 1.0105] jhāne idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ.) Namaggapaccayā… cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā ahetukavipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā. (Namagge idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ.)

284. Conditioned by an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises not by way of nutriment condition… not by way of faculty condition… not by way of jhāna condition… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. (This distinction does not apply in the case of jhāna.) Not by way of path condition… the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness. The base conditions rootless resultant indeterminate and functional indeterminate aggregates. (This distinction does not apply in the case of path.)

(Avasesaṃ yathā paṭiccavāre paccanīyaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(The remainder should be elaborated as in the negative section of the Dependent Origination Chapter.)

Nasampayuttādipaccayā

Non-Association and Other Conditions

285. Nasampayuttapaccayā [M 1.0086]… navippayuttapaccayā… nonatthipaccayā… kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato dhammo uppajjati novigatapaccayā – kusale khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.

285. Not by way of association condition… not by way of dissociation condition… not by way of absence condition… Conditioned by a wholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises not by way of disappearance condition—conditioned by wholesome aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises.

(Yathā paṭiccavāre, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

Najhānapaccayā nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

Not by jhāna condition, not by root condition, not by object condition: by co-nascence condition, one; by mutuality condition, one; by dependence condition, one; by kamma condition, one; by nutriment condition, one; by faculty condition, one; by presence condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.)

Namaggadukaṃ

The Non-Path Dyad.

326. Namaggapaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, purejāte [M 1.0105] ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

326. Not by path condition: by object condition, one; by proximity condition, one; by contiguity condition, one; by co-nascence condition, one; by mutuality condition, one; by dependence condition, one; by decisive support condition, one; by prenascent condition, one; by repetition condition, one; by kamma condition, one; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, one; by faculty condition, one; by jhāna condition, one; by association condition, one; by dissociation condition, one; by presence condition, one; by absence condition, one; by disappearance condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, one…pe….

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad.

Namaggapaccayā nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye [V 1.0121] ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, vippayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā [T 1.0126] ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

Not by path condition, not by root condition, not by object condition: by co-nascence condition, one; by mutuality condition, one; by dependence condition, one; by kamma condition, one; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, one; by faculty condition, one; by jhāna condition, one; by dissociation condition, one; by presence condition, one; by non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.)

Nasampayuttadukaṃ

The Non-Association Dyad.

327. Nasampayuttapaccayā hetuyā pañca, adhipatiyā pañca, sahajāte pañca, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye pañca, kamme pañca, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre pañca, indriye pañca, jhāne pañca, magge pañca, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā pañca, avigate pañca.

327. Not by association condition: by root condition, five; by dominance condition, five; by co-nascence condition, five; by mutuality condition, one; by dependence condition, five; by kamma condition, five; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, five; by faculty condition, five; by jhāna condition, five; by path condition, five; by dissociation condition, five; by presence condition, five; by non-disappearance condition, five.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Nasampayuttapaccayā nahetupaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

Not by association condition, not by root condition: by co-nascence condition, one… up to… by non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.)

Navippayuttadukaṃ

The Non-dissociated Dyad.

328. Navippayuttapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi.

328. By non-dissociation condition: three in root, three in object, three in dominance, three in immediate, three in contiguous, three in co-arising, three in mutuality, three in dependence, three in decisive support, three in repetition, three in kamma, one in result, three in nutriment, three in faculty, three in jhāna, three in path, three in association, three in presence, three in absence, three in disappearance, three in non-disappearance.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Navippayuttapaccayā nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe dve, anantare dve, samanantare dve, sahajāte dve, aññamaññe dve, nissaye dve, upanissaye dve, āsevane ekaṃ kamme dve, āhāre dve, indriye dve, jhāne [M 1.0106] dve, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte dve, atthiyā dve, natthiyā dve, vigate dve, avigate dve.

By non-dissociation condition, not by root condition: two in object, two in immediate, two in contiguous, two in co-arising, two in mutuality, two in dependence, two in decisive support, one in repetition, two in kamma, two in nutriment, two in faculty, two in jhāna, one in path, two in association, two in presence, two in absence, two in disappearance, two in non-disappearance.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad.

Navippayuttapaccayā [V 1.0122] nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, āhāre [T 1.0127] ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

By non-dissociation condition, not by root condition, not by object condition: one in co-nascence, one in mutuality, one in dependence, one in kamma, one in nutriment, one in faculty, one in presence, one in non-disappearance. (In brief.)

Nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā (naārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ).

Not by presence condition… not by disappearance condition (similar to not by object condition).

Paccayavāre paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The inverse-direct sequence in the chapter on conditions.

Paccayavāro.

The Chapter on Conditions.

1. The Section on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

329. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho, dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

329. Based on a wholesome phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise; based on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; based on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Based on a wholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on wholesome aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. Based on a wholesome phenomenon, both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise due to a root condition—based on one wholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; based on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated material form arise; based on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. (3)

330. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ [V 1.0123] khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ [M 1.0107] nissāya akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 1.0128] hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

330. Based on an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates arise…pe… based on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. Based on an unwholesome phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on unwholesome aggregates, mind-originated material form arises. Based on an unwholesome phenomenon, both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise due to a root condition—based on one unwholesome aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise…pe… based on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. (3)

331. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe nissāya vatthu, vatthuṃ nissāya khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ nissāya tayo mahābhūtā, tayo mahābhūte nissāya ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ, dve mahābhūte nissāya dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; vatthuṃ nissāya vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā. (1)

331. Based on an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; based on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated material form arise; based on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. At the moment of rebirth-linking, based on one resultant-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated material form arise; based on three aggregates, one aggregate and kamma-originated material form arise; based on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated material form arise. Based on aggregates, the base arises; based on the base, aggregates arise. Based on one great element, three great elements arise; based on three great elements, one great element arises; based on two great elements, two great elements arise. Based on the great elements, mind-originated material form, kamma-originated material form, and derived material form arise. Based on the base, resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates arise. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ nissāya kusalā khandhā. (2)

Based on an indeterminate phenomenon, a wholesome phenomenon arises due to a root condition: based on the physical base, wholesome aggregates arise. (2)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ nissāya akusalā khandhā. (3)

Based on an indeterminate phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises due to a root condition: based on the physical base, unwholesome aggregates arise. (3)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ nissāya kusalā khandhā, mahābhūte nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

Based on an indeterminate phenomenon, both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise due to a root condition—based on the physical base, wholesome aggregates arise, and based on the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (4)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ [T 1.0129] nissāya akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ nissāya akusalā khandhā, mahābhūte nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

Based on an indeterminate phenomenon, both unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise due to a root condition—based on the physical base, unwholesome aggregates arise, and based on the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (5)

332. Kusalañca [V 1.0124] abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca nissāya tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca nissāya dve khandhā. Kusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Kusalañca abyākatañca [M 1.0108] dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca nissāya tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca nissāya dve khandhā, kusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

332. Based on wholesome and indeterminate phenomena, a wholesome phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on one wholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe… based on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. Based on wholesome and indeterminate phenomena, an indeterminate phenomenon arises due to a root condition—based on wholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. Based on wholesome and indeterminate phenomena, both wholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise due to a root condition—based on one wholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise…pe… based on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise, and based on wholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (3)

Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca nissāya tayo khandhā …pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca nissāya dve khandhā. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Akusalañca abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca nissāya tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca nissāya dve [T 1.0130] khandhā, akusale khandhe ca mahābhūte ca nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by root condition—dependent on one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by root condition—dependent on unwholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon, unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena arise by root condition—dependent on one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise, and dependent on unwholesome aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (3)

(Yathā paccayavāre, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

333. Hetuyā sattarasa, ārammaṇe satta, adhipatiyā sattarasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte sattarasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye sattarasa, upanissaye satta, purejāte satta, āsevane satta, kamme sattarasa, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre sattarasa, indriye sattarasa, jhāne sattarasa, magge sattarasa, sampayutte satta, vippayutte sattarasa, atthiyā sattarasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate sattarasa.

333. By root condition, seventeen; by object condition, seven; by dominance condition, seventeen; by contiguity condition, seven; by proximity condition, seven; by co-nascence condition, seventeen; by mutuality condition, seven; by support condition, seventeen; by decisive support condition, seven; by pre-nascence condition, seven; by repetition condition, seven; by kamma condition, seventeen; by result condition, one; by nutriment condition, seventeen; by faculty condition, seventeen; by jhāna condition, seventeen; by path condition, seventeen; by association condition, seven; by dissociation condition, seventeen; by presence condition, seventeen; by absence condition, seven; by disappearance condition, seven; by non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Nahetupaccayo

Non-root Condition

334. Akusalaṃ [M 1.0109] dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe nissāya vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

334. Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by non-root condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness, delusion associated with doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, dve khandha nissāya dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe nissāya vatthu, vatthuṃ nissāya khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ nissāya tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ nissāya [T 1.0131] tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte nissāya kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; cakkhāyatanaṃ nissāya cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ nissāya kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ nissāya ahetukā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā. (1)

Dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon, an indeterminate phenomenon arises by non-root condition: dependent on one rootless resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate and mind-originated material form arises; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant-indeterminate aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced material form arise. Dependent on the aggregates, the physical base arises; dependent on the physical base, the aggregates arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated material form, kamma-produced material form, and derived material form arise. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise… dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced material form and derived material form arise. Dependent on the eye-base, eye-consciousness arises… dependent on the body-base, body-consciousness arises. Dependent on the physical base, rootless resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates arise. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vatthuṃ nissāya vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (2)

Dependent on an indeterminate phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by non-root condition: dependent on the physical base, delusion associated with doubt and restlessness arises. (2)

Akusalañca [V 1.0126] abyākatañca dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca vatthuñca nissāya vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Dependent on an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon, an unwholesome phenomenon arises by non-root condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and restlessness and the physical base, delusion associated with doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

(Yathā paccayavāre, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

Nahetuyā cattāri, naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā sattarasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca[M 1.0110], napurejāte satta, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane sattarasa, nakamme satta, navipāke sattarasa, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca.

335. Four by non-root condition, five by non-object condition, seventeen by non-dominance condition, five by non-contiguity condition, five by non-proximity condition, five by non-mutuality condition, five by non-decisive support condition, seven by non-pre-nascence condition, seventeen by non-post-nascence condition, seventeen by non-repetition condition, seven by non-kamma condition, seventeen by non-result condition, one by non-nutriment condition, one by non-faculty condition, one by non-jhāna condition, one by non-path condition, five by non-association condition, three by non-dissociation condition, five by non-absence condition, five by non-disappearance condition.

The Root Dyad

336. Hetupaccayā [T 1.0132] naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā sattarasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte sattarasa, naāsevane sattarasa, nakamme satta, navipāke sattarasa, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca. 336. Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

337. Nahetupaccayā [V 1.0127] ārammaṇe cattāri, anantare cattāri, samanantare cattāri, sahajāte cattāri, aññamaññe cattāri, nissaye cattāri, upanissaye cattāri, purejāte cattāri, āsevane cattāri, kamme cattāri, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, indriye cattāri, jhāne cattāri, magge tīṇi, sampayutte cattāri, vippayutte cattāri, atthiyā cattāri, natthiyā cattāri, vigate cattāri, avigate cattāri. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

337. By non-root condition: four by object, four by contiguity, four by proximity, four by co-nascence, four by mutuality, four by support, four by decisive support, four by pre-nascence, four by repetition, four by kamma, one by result, four by nutriment, four by faculty, four by jhāna, three by path, four by association, four by dissociation, four by presence, four by absence, four by disappearance, four by non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.)

Nissayavāre paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Positive Mode in the Section on Dependence.

(Paccayattaṃ nāma nissayattaṃ, nissayattaṃ nāma paccayattaṃ.)

That which is a condition is called a dependence; that which is a dependence is called a condition.

Nissayavāro.

The Section on Dependence.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

338. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0128][M 1.0111] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

338. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the root condition—three aggregates are associated with one wholesome aggregate; one aggregate is associated with three aggregates; two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Akusalaṃ [T 1.0133] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

An unwholesome state associated with an unwholesome state arises due to the root condition—three aggregates are associated with one unwholesome aggregate; one aggregate is associated with three aggregates; two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises due to the root condition—for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate states: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, for resultant-indeterminate states: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Ārammaṇādipaccayā

Object Condition and so forth.

339. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā… (adhipati paṭisandhikkhaṇe natthi.) Anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā. (Sabbāni padāni hetumūlakasadisāni).

339. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the object condition… the dominance condition… (Dominance does not occur at the moment of rebirth-linking.) …the immediately preceding condition… the immediately proximate condition… the conascence condition… the mutuality condition… the dependence condition… the strong dependence condition. (All cases are similar to that of the root condition.)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition.

340. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ [V 1.0129] saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

340. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the prenascence condition—three aggregates are associated with one wholesome aggregate; one aggregate is associated with three aggregates; two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; the physical base due to the prenascence condition. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An unwholesome state associated with an unwholesome state arises due to the prenascence condition—three aggregates are associated with one unwholesome aggregate; one aggregate is associated with three aggregates; two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; the physical base due to the prenascence condition. (1)

Abyākataṃ [M 1.0112] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato [T 1.0134] dhammo uppajjati purejātapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā. (1)

An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises due to the prenascence condition—for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate states: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; the physical base due to the prenascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition.

341. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe… akusalaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā…pe….

341. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the repetition condition… an unwholesome state… an indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises due to the repetition condition—for functional-indeterminate states: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate… and so on.

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition.

342. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā…pe… akusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe… abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe….

342. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the kamma condition… an unwholesome state associated with an unwholesome state arises due to the kamma condition… an indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises due to the kamma condition.

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition.

343. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ…pe….

343. An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises due to the result condition—for resultant-indeterminate states… and so on.

Āhārādipaccayā

Nutriment Condition and so forth.

344. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā [V 1.0130]… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā. (Imāni padāni hetupaccayasadisāni.)

344. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the nutriment condition… the faculty condition… the absorption condition… the path condition… the association condition. (These cases are similar to that of the root condition.)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition.

345. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā.

345. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the dissociation condition—three aggregates are associated with one wholesome aggregate… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; the physical base due to the dissociation condition.

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā.

An unwholesome state… and so on; the physical base due to the dissociation condition.

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā.

An indeterminate state… and so on; the physical base due to the dissociation condition.

Atthiādipaccayā

Presence Condition and so forth.

346. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0113] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā (hetupaccayasadisaṃ).

346. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises due to the presence condition… the absence condition… the disappearance condition… the non-disappearance condition. (Similar to the root condition.)

Āsevanapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi. By repetition condition: in root condition, three; in object condition, three; in dominance condition, three; in contiguity condition, three; in immediate contiguity condition, three; in co-nascence condition, three; in reciprocity condition, three; in dependence condition, three; in strong dependence condition, three; in pre-nascence condition, three; in kamma condition, three; in nutriment condition, three; in faculty condition, three; in jhāna condition, three; in path condition, three; in association condition, three; in dissociation condition, three; in presence condition, three; in absence condition, three; in disappearance condition, three; in non-disappearance condition, three. 350. Vipākapaccayā hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, adhipatiyā ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, purejāte ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, āhāre [M 1.0114] ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

351. Akusalaṃ [T 1.0136] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

351. An unwholesome state associated with an unwholesome state arises by non-root condition: delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1)

Abyākataṃ [V 1.0132] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises by non-root condition: three aggregates are associated with one rootless resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, three aggregates are associated with one resultant-indeterminate aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Naadhipatiādipaccayā

Non-Dominance, etc., Conditions

352. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā… napurejātapaccayā – arūpe āruppe (sabbattha) kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… abyākataṃ dhammaṃ…pe….

352. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises not by dominance condition… not by pre-nascence condition—in the immaterial realm, three wholesome aggregates are associated with one aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. An unwholesome state… and so on… an indeterminate state… and so on.

Napacchājāta-naāsevanapaccayā

Non-Post-Nascence and Non-Repetition Conditions

353. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā… tīṇi. Naāsevanapaccayā… tīṇi.

353. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises not by post-nascence condition… three. Not by repetition condition… three.

Nakammapaccayo

Non-Kamma Condition

354. Kusalaṃ [M 1.0115] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Kusale khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā kusalā cetanā. (1)

354. A wholesome state associated with a wholesome state arises not by kamma condition. Wholesome volition is associated with wholesome aggregates. (1)

Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Akusale khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā akusalā cetanā. (1)

An unwholesome state associated with an unwholesome state arises not by kamma condition. Unwholesome volition is associated with unwholesome aggregates. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Kiriyābyākate [T 1.0137] khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā kiriyābyākatā cetanā. (1)

An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises not by kamma condition. Functional indeterminate volition is associated with functional indeterminate aggregates. (1)

Navipākapaccayo

Non-Result Condition

355. Kusalaṃ [V 1.0133] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe… akusalaṃ dhammaṃ…pe… abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ.

355. A wholesome state associated with… and so on… an unwholesome state… and so on… an indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises not by result condition—one functional indeterminate aggregate.

(Saṃsaṭṭhavāre paccanīyavibhaṅge nakamme ca navipāke ca paṭisandhi natthi; avasesesu sabbattha atthi.)

In the Section on Association, in the analysis of negative conditions, there is no rebirth-linking in the case of non-kamma and non-result; in all the remaining cases, there is.

Najhānapaccayo

Non-Jhāna Condition

356. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

356. An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises not by jhāna condition: three aggregates are associated with one aggregate accompanied by the five consciousnesses, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Namaggapaccayo

Non-Path Condition

357. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

357. An indeterminate state associated with an indeterminate state arises not by path condition: three aggregates are associated with one rootless resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on…. (1)

Navippayuttapaccayo

Non-Dissociation Condition

358. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

358. A wholesome phenomenon associated with a wholesome phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, one wholesome aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Akusalaṃ [M 1.0116] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon associated with an unwholesome phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, one unwholesome aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vipākābyākataṃ [V 1.0134] kiriyābyākataṃ [T 1.0138] ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (Navippayutte paṭisandhi natthi.) (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon associated with an indeterminate phenomenon arises not by way of dissociation condition: in the immaterial realm, one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (In the non-dissociation condition, rebirth-linking does not occur.) (1)

Pure

359. Nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, na āsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte tīṇi.

359. Not by root condition, two; not by dominance condition, three; not by prenascence condition, three; not by postnascence condition, three; not by repetition condition, three; not by kamma condition, three; not by result condition, three; not by jhāna condition, one; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, three.

The Non-Root Pair

360. Nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā dve, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve.

360. Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, two; not by prenascence condition, two; not by postnascence condition, two; not by repetition condition, two; not by kamma condition, one; not by result condition, two; not by jhāna condition, one; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, two.

Tikaṃ

The Triad

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejāte dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve.

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, two; not by postnascence condition, two; not by repetition condition, two; not by kamma condition, one; not by result condition, two; not by jhāna condition, one; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, two.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke dve, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve…pe….

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, not by postnascence condition, two; not by repetition condition, two; not by kamma condition, one; not by result condition, two; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, two… and so on.

Chakkaṃ

The Hexad

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke dve, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve.

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, not by postnascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, one; not by result condition, two; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, two.

Sattakaṃ

The Heptad

Nahetupaccayā [V 1.0135][M 1.0117] naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā navipāke ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ…pe….

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, not by postnascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, not by result condition, one; not by path condition, one; not by dissociation condition, one… and so on.
