Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

392. Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā dve khandhā. (1)

392. A wholesome phenomenon, conjoined with a wholesome phenomenon, arises by root condition: one wholesome aggregate is conjoined with three aggregates, three aggregates are conjoined with one aggregate, and two aggregates are conjoined with two aggregates. (1)

393. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā dve khandhā. (1)

393. An unwholesome phenomenon, conjoined with an unwholesome phenomenon, arises by root condition: one unwholesome aggregate is conjoined with three aggregates, three aggregates are conjoined with one aggregate, and two aggregates are conjoined with two aggregates. (1)

394. Abyākataṃ [M 1.0130] dhammaṃ sampayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā [T 1.0152] dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā [V 1.0151] tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā dve khandhā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) (1)

394. An indeterminate phenomenon, conjoined with an indeterminate phenomenon, arises by root condition: for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate states, one aggregate is conjoined with three aggregates, three aggregates with one aggregate, and two aggregates with two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, for a resultant-indeterminate state, one aggregate is conjoined with three aggregates, three aggregates with one aggregate, and two aggregates with two aggregates. (In brief.) (1)

Pure

395. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi.

395. By root condition, three; by object condition, three; by dominance condition, three; by contiguity condition, three; by immediate contiguity condition, three; by co-nascence condition, three; by reciprocity condition, three; by dependence condition, three; by strong dependence condition, three; by pre-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, three; by kamma condition, three; by resultant condition, one; by nutriment condition, three; by faculty condition, three; by jhāna condition, three; by path condition, three; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, three; by presence condition, three; by absence condition, three; by disappearance condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, three.

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

396. Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe sampayutto vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

396. An unwholesome phenomenon associated with an unwholesome phenomenon arises by non-root condition: delusion accompanied by doubt or by restlessness, associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt or by restlessness. (1)

397. Abyākataṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākābyākataṃ kiriyābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe sampayutto eko khandho, dve khandhe sampayuttā dve khandhā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) (1)

397. An indeterminate phenomenon associated with an indeterminate phenomenon arises by non-root condition: for rootless resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate states, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, three aggregates with one aggregate, and two aggregates with two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, for a resultant-indeterminate state, one aggregate is associated with three aggregates, three aggregates with one aggregate, and two aggregates with two aggregates. (In brief.) (1)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conditional Relations (Forward Order).

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. Section on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

Root Condition.

401. Kusalo [T 1.0154][M 1.0132] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kusalā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kusalā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – kusalā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

401. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of root condition: wholesome roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of root condition: wholesome roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of root condition: wholesome roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

402. Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – akusalā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – akusalā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – akusalā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

402. An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of root condition: unwholesome roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of root condition: unwholesome roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of root condition: unwholesome roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

403. Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena [V 1.0154] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena [T 1.0155] paccayo. (1)

403. An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of root condition: resultant indeterminate and functional indeterminate roots are conditions for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant indeterminate roots are conditions for the associated aggregates and kamma-originated materiality by way of root condition. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

404. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, sekkhā maggā [M 1.0133] vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena kusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

404. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of object condition: having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that; one reflects upon past good deeds; emerging from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna; the trainees reflect upon the change-of-lineage consciousness; they reflect upon purification; emerging from the path, the trainees reflect upon the path; whether trainees or ordinary people, they contemplate the wholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; through mind-penetrating knowledge, they know the mind of one endowed with wholesome consciousness. The wholesome base of infinite space is a condition for the wholesome base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The wholesome base of nothingness is a condition for the wholesome base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. The wholesome aggregates are conditions for knowledge of psychic potency, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of beings passing away and arising according to their actions, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (1)

405. Kusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha [T 1.0156] rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. Jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

405. A wholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of object condition: having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in that; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, or displeasure arises. One savors and delights in past good deeds; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, or displeasure arises. Emerging from jhāna, one savors and delights in the jhāna; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, or agitation arises. When one has declined from jhāna, displeasure arises for the remorseful one. (2)

406. Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhati; pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati; kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vippassati; cetopariyañāṇena kusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, kusale niruddhe vipāko [V 1.0155] tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Kusalaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati, akusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanavipākassa ca, kiriyassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanavipākassa ca, kiriyassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

406. A wholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of object condition: an arahant, having emerged from the path, reviews the path; one reviews past good deeds; one contemplates the wholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one knows the mind of one endowed with wholesome consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge. Trainees or ordinary people contemplate the wholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; when the wholesome has ceased, resultant consciousness arises taking that as its object. One savors and delights in the wholesome; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises; when the unwholesome has ceased, resultant consciousness arises taking that as its object. The wholesome base of infinite space is a condition for the resultant and functional base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The wholesome base of nothingness is a condition for the resultant and functional base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. Wholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of beings passing away and arising according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and adverting by way of object condition. (3)

407. Akusalo [M 1.0134] dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati[T 1.0157]. Diṭṭhiṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vicikicchaṃ ārabbha vicikicchā uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Uddhaccaṃ ārabbha uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Domanassaṃ ārabbha domanassaṃ uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati. (1)

407. An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of object condition: one savors and delights in lust; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. One savors and delights in wrong view; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. Dependent on doubt, doubt arises, wrong view arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. Dependent on agitation, agitation arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, displeasure arises. Dependent on displeasure, displeasure arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises. (1)

408. Akusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā pahīne kilese pahīnakilese (syā.) paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese vikkhambhitakilese (syā.) paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena akusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Akusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

408. An unwholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of object condition: trainees review abandoned defilements, review suppressed defilements, know previously accumulated defilements; trainees or ordinary people contemplate the unwholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one knows the mind of one endowed with unwholesome consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge. Unwholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of beings passing away and arising according to their actions, and knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

409. Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā pahīne kilese paccavekkhati, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānāti, akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena akusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti, sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti[T 1.0158], kusale niruddhe [V 1.0156] vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Akusalaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Akusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Akusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

409. An unwholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of object condition: an arahant reviews the abandoned defilements, knows the defilements previously accumulated, contemplates the unwholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one knows the mind of one endowed with unwholesome consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge; trainees or ordinary people contemplate the unwholesome as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; when the wholesome consciousness has ceased, a resultant consciousness taking that as object arises. One savors and delights in the unwholesome; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, and displeasure arises. When the unwholesome consciousness has ceased, a resultant consciousness taking that as object arises. Unwholesome aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of beings passing away and arising according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and adverting. (3)

410. Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā phalaṃ paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ phalassa āvajjanāya [M 1.0135] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena vipākābyākatakiriyābyākatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakiriyaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa… gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa… rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa [T 1.0159]… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Abyākatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

410. An indeterminate state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of object condition: an arahant reviews the fruition, reviews Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object condition for the adverting of fruition. An arahant contemplates the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. The ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the heart-base… resultant indeterminate and functional indeterminate aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. One sees forms with the divine eye, hears sounds with the divine ear-element, knows the mind of one endowed with resultant indeterminate or functional indeterminate consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge. The functional consciousness of the base of infinite space is a condition by way of object condition for the functional consciousness of the base of infinite consciousness. The functional consciousness of the base of nothingness is a condition by way of object condition for the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. The form base is a condition by way of object condition for eye-consciousness. The sound base is a condition by way of object condition for ear-consciousness… the odor base for nose-consciousness… the taste base for tongue-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness. The indeterminate aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for knowledge of psychic potency, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, knowledge of the future, and adverting. (1)

411. Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vippassanti. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti, cetopariyañāṇena vipākābyākatakiriyābyākatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Abyākatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa [V 1.0157] cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.

411. An indeterminate state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of object condition: trainees review the fruition, review Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition by way of object condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, and the path consciousness. Trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. The ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the heart-base… resultant indeterminate and functional indeterminate aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. They see forms with the divine eye, hear sounds with the divine ear-element, know the mind of one endowed with resultant indeterminate or functional indeterminate consciousness through mind-penetrating knowledge. The indeterminate aggregates are a condition by way of object condition for knowledge of psychic potency, mind-penetrating knowledge, knowledge of the recollection of past lives, and knowledge of the future.

412. Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe assādeti abhinandati[T 1.0160]; taṃ ārabbha rāgo [M 1.0136] uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. (3)

412. An indeterminate state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of object condition: one savors and delights in the eye; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. The ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the heart-base… one savors and delights in the resultant indeterminate and functional indeterminate aggregates; dependent on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, agitation arises, displeasure arises. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

413. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sekkhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – kusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

413. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance and conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on that, regarding it as important; one reflects on past good deeds, regarding them as important; having emerged from jhāna, one reflects on the jhāna, regarding it as important. Trainees reflect on the change-of-lineage consciousness, regarding it as important; they reflect on purification consciousness, regarding it as important. Trainees, having emerged from the path, reflect on the path, regarding it as important. Conascent-dominance: a wholesome dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

414. Kusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

414. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one relishes and delights in that, regarding it as important; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. One relishes and delights in past good deeds, regarding them as important; regarding them as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having emerged from jhāna, one relishes and delights in the jhāna, regarding it as important; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises.

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati[V 1.0158]. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati [T 1.0161] – kusalādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance and conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: an arahant, having emerged from the path, reflects on the path, regarding it as important. Conascent-dominance: a wholesome dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (3)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – kusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of dominance condition. Conascent-dominance: a wholesome dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (4)

415. Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo [M 1.0137] uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – akusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

415. An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance and conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: regarding lust as important, one relishes and delights in it; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Regarding wrong view as important, one relishes and delights in it; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascent-dominance: an unwholesome dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – akusalādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascent-dominance: an unwholesome dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa adhipati paccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – akusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of dominance condition. Conascent-dominance: an unwholesome dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (3)

416. Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – vipākābyākatakiriyābyākatādhipati [T 1.0162] sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

416. An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance and conascent-dominance. Object-dominance: an arahant reflects on the fruit, regarding it as important; reflects on Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Conascent-dominance: a resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominance condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sekkhā [V 1.0159] phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: trainees reflect on the fruit, regarding it as important; they reflect on Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage consciousness, purification consciousness, and the path by way of dominance condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (3)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: regarding the eye as important, one relishes and delights in it; regarding it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. So too with the ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangibles… the physical base… regarding the resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates as important, one relishes and delights in them; regarding them as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediacy Condition

417. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena [M 1.0138] paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

417. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of immediacy condition: preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition for succeeding wholesome aggregates by way of immediacy condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification… change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of immediacy condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… maggo phalassa… anulomaṃ sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ [T 1.0163] phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of immediacy condition. A wholesome state is a condition for emergence… the path is a condition for the fruit… conformity is a condition for the fruition-attainment of a trainee… for one emerging from cessation, the wholesome consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of immediacy condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of immediacy condition: preceding unwholesome aggregates are a condition for succeeding unwholesome aggregates by way of immediacy condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Akusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of immediacy condition. An unwholesome state is a condition for emergence by way of immediacy condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ [V 1.0160] khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the contiguity condition: preceding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for succeeding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of the contiguity condition. The life-continuum is a condition for adverting... the functional state for emergence... the conformity of an arahant for the attainment of fruition... the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception for one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of the contiguity condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of the contiguity condition: adverting is a condition for wholesome aggregates by way of the contiguity condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of the contiguity condition: adverting is a condition for unwholesome aggregates by way of the contiguity condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

Proximity Condition

418. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ [T 1.0164] gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo.

418. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of the proximity condition: preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition for succeeding wholesome aggregates by way of the proximity condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage... conformity is a condition for purification... change-of-lineage is a condition for the path... purification is a condition for the path by way of the proximity condition.

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo. Kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… maggo phalassa… anulomaṃ sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā [M 1.0139] vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the proximity condition. The wholesome state is a condition for emergence... the path for the fruit... conformity for the fruition-attainment of a trainee... the wholesome consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception for one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of the proximity condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of the proximity condition: preceding unwholesome aggregates are a condition for succeeding unwholesome aggregates by way of the proximity condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – akusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the proximity condition: the unwholesome state is a condition for emergence by way of the proximity condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vipākābyākatā [V 1.0161] kiriyābyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the proximity condition: preceding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for succeeding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of the proximity condition. The life-continuum is a condition for adverting... the functional state for emergence... the conformity of an arahant for the attainment of fruition... the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception for one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition by way of the proximity condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of the proximity condition: adverting is a condition for wholesome aggregates by way of the proximity condition. (2)

Abyākato [T 1.0165] dhammo akusalassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of the proximity condition: adverting is a condition for unwholesome aggregates by way of the proximity condition. (3)

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

419. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

419. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of the co-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the co-nascence condition: wholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa [M 1.0140] cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state and an indeterminate state by way of the co-nascence condition: one wholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. (3)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwhome state by way of the co-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the co-nascence condition. (1)

Akusalo [V 1.0162] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0166] – akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of the co-nascence condition: unwholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state and an indeterminate state by way of the co-nascence condition: one unwholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the co-nascence condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākato kiriyābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo[T 1.0167]. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa [M 1.0141] sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā [V 1.0163] dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the conascence condition—one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the conascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of the conascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of the conascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of the conascence condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for kamma-produced materiality by way of the conascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of the conascence condition. The aggregates are a condition for the base by way of the conascence condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates by way of the conascence condition. One great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the conascence condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the conascence condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the conascence condition. The great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality, kamma-produced materiality, and derived materiality by way of the conascence condition. Externally, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the conascence condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the conascence condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the conascence condition. The great elements are a condition for derived materiality by way of the conascence condition. Nutriment-originated, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the conascence condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the conascence condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the conascence condition. The great elements are a condition for derived materiality by way of the conascence condition. Temperature-originated, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the conascence condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the conascence condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the conascence condition. The great elements are a condition for derived materiality by way of the conascence condition. For non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the conascence condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the conascence condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the conascence condition. The great elements are a condition for kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality by way of the conascence condition. (1)

Kusalo [T 1.0168] ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the conascence condition—the wholesome aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the conascence condition. (1)

Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the conascence condition—the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of the conascence condition. (1)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutual Condition

420. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

420. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of the mutual condition—one wholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the mutual condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the mutual condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the mutual condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the mutual condition—one unwholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the mutual condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the mutual condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the mutual condition. (1)

Abyākato [M 1.0142] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākato kiriyābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ [T 1.0169] khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena [V 1.0164] paccayo; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the mutual condition—one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the mutual condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the mutual condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the mutual condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for the base by way of the mutual condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for the base by way of the mutual condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for the base by way of the mutual condition. The aggregates are a condition for the base by way of the mutual condition. The base is a condition for the aggregates by way of the mutual condition. One great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the mutual condition. Three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the mutual condition. Two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the mutual condition; externally… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the mutual condition… two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the mutual condition. (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Dependence Condition

421. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

421. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one wholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—wholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. (2)

Kusalo [T 1.0170] dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one wholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. (3)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo [M 1.0143] khandhā ekassa khandhassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one unwholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—unwholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo [V 1.0165] khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one unwholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0171] – vipākābyākato kiriyābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ, kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ, upādārūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ [T 1.0172] …pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of the dependence condition. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of the dependence condition. One great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the dependence condition; three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the dependence condition; two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the dependence condition. The great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena, kamma-originated material phenomena, and derived material phenomena by way of the dependence condition; externally… food-originated… temperature-originated… For non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition for three great elements by way of the dependence condition; three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of the dependence condition; two great elements are a condition for two great elements by way of the dependence condition. The great elements are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena and derived material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of the dependence condition. The ear-base…pe… the nose-base…pe… the tongue-base …pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of the dependence condition. The physical base is a condition for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of the dependence condition.

Abyākato [M 1.0144] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—the physical base is a condition for wholesome aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—the physical base is a condition for unwholesome aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (3)

422. Kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – kusalo [V 1.0166] eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ca vatthu ca ekassa khandhassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

422. A wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon are conditions for a wholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one wholesome aggregate and the physical base are conditions for three aggregates by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates and the physical base are conditions for one aggregate by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (1)

Kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon are conditions for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—wholesome aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the dependence condition. (2)

Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ca vatthu ca ekassa khandhassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon are conditions for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of the dependence condition—one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base are conditions for three aggregates by way of the dependence condition; three aggregates and the physical base are conditions for one aggregate by way of the dependence condition; two aggregates and the physical base are conditions for two aggregates by way of the dependence condition. (1)

Akusalo [T 1.0173] ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dependence condition—the unwholesome aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of dependence condition. (2)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

423. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

423. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, sekkhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti.

Object decisive support: having given a gift, undertaken virtuous behavior, performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon it with respect; having previously done good deeds, one reflects upon them with respect; having emerged from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna with respect; trainees reflect upon change-of-lineage with respect; they reflect upon purification with respect; trainees, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path with respect.

Anantarūpanissayo [M 1.0145] – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity decisive support: the preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition for the succeeding wholesome aggregates by way of decisive support condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification… change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0167] – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sīlaṃ…pe… sutaṃ…pe… cāgaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissaya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā [T 1.0174]… saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Natural decisive support: Supported by faith, one gives alms, undertakes virtuous behavior, observes the Uposatha, develops jhāna, develops insight, develops the path, develops direct knowledge, develops attainment. Supported by virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, one gives alms, undertakes virtuous behavior, observes the Uposatha, develops jhāna, develops insight, develops the path, develops direct knowledge, develops attainment. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom is a condition for faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom by way of decisive support condition.

Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyassa jhānassa parikammaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyassa jhānassa parikammaṃ tatiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Catutthassa jhānassa parikammaṃ catutthassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Viññāṇañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ catutthassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ dibbassa cakkhussa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbāya sotadhātuyā parikammaṃ dibbāya sotadhātuyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Iddhividhañāṇassa parikammaṃ iddhividhañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo[M 1.0146]. Cetopariyañāṇassa parikammaṃ cetopariyañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa [T 1.0175] parikammaṃ pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Yathākammūpagañāṇassa parikammaṃ yathākammūpagañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbacakkhu dibbāya sotadhātuyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbasotadhātu iddhividhañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena [V 1.0168] paccayo. Iddhividhañāṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Cetopariyañāṇaṃ pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ yathākammūpagañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyassa maggassa parikammaṃ dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyassa maggassa parikammaṃ tatiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyo maggo tatiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpajjanti, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Maggo sekkhānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya[T 1.0176], dhammappaṭisambhidāya, niruttippaṭisambhidāya, paṭibhānappaṭisambhidāya, ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a condition for the first jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the second jhāna is a condition for the second jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the third jhāna is a condition for the third jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the fourth jhāna is a condition for the fourth jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the base of the infinitude of space is a condition for the base of the infinitude of space by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the base of the infinitude of consciousness is a condition for the base of the infinitude of consciousness by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of nothingness by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of decisive support condition. The first jhāna is a condition for the second jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The second jhāna is a condition for the third jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The third jhāna is a condition for the fourth jhāna by way of decisive support condition. The fourth jhāna is a condition for the base of the infinitude of space by way of decisive support condition. The base of the infinitude of space is a condition for the base of the infinitude of consciousness by way of decisive support condition. The base of the infinitude of consciousness is a condition for the base of nothingness by way of decisive support condition. The base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the divine eye is a condition for the divine eye by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the divine ear element is a condition for the divine ear element by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power is a condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the knowledge of the minds of others is a condition for the knowledge of the minds of others by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives is a condition for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma is a condition for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the knowledge of the future is a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of decisive support condition. The divine eye is a condition for the divine ear element by way of decisive support condition. The divine ear element is a condition for the knowledge of the kinds of psychic power by way of decisive support condition. The knowledge of the kinds of psychic power is a condition for the knowledge of the minds of others by way of decisive support condition. The knowledge of the minds of others is a condition for the knowledge of the recollection of past lives by way of decisive support condition. The knowledge of the recollection of past lives is a condition for the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma by way of decisive support condition. The knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma is a condition for the knowledge of the future by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the first path is a condition for the first path by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the second path is a condition for the second path by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the third path is a condition for the third path by way of decisive support condition. The preliminary work for the fourth path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. The first path is a condition for the second path by way of decisive support condition. The second path is a condition for the third path by way of decisive support condition. The third path is a condition for the fourth path by way of decisive support condition. Trainees, supported by the path, generate unarisen attainments, attain to those that have arisen, and contemplate formations as impermanent, suffering, and not-self. The path is a condition, by way of decisive support condition, for the trainees’ analytical knowledge of meaning, analytical knowledge of the Dhamma, analytical knowledge of expression, analytical knowledge of ready wit, and skill in what is possible and what is impossible.

Kusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

Object decisive support: having given a gift, undertaken virtuous behavior, performed the Uposatha observance, one delights in it and rejoices in it, treating it as important. By treating it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having previously done good deeds, one delights in them and rejoices in them, treating them as important. By treating them as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Having emerged from jhāna, one delights in the jhāna and rejoices in it, treating it as important. By treating it as important, lust arises, wrong view arises.

Pakatūpanissayo [M 1.0147] – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ…pe… sutaṃ…pe… cāgaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural decisive support: Supported by faith, one indulges in conceit, clings to views. Supported by virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, one indulges in conceit, clings to views. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom are conditions for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… views… longing by way of decisive support condition.

Kusalo [V 1.0169] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati.

Object decisive support: an arahant, having emerged from the path, reflects upon the path, treating it as important.

Anantarūpanissayo – kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… maggo phalassa… anulomaṃ sekkhāya phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity decisive support: wholesome is a condition for emergence… the path is a condition for fruition… conformity is a condition for the fruition attainment for a trainee… for one emerging from cessation, the wholesome state of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo [T 1.0177] – saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Sīlaṃ…pe… sutaṃ…pe… cāgaṃ…pe… paññaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arahā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Maggo arahato atthappaṭisambhidāya, dhammappaṭisambhidāya, niruttippaṭisambhidāya, paṭibhānappaṭisambhidāya, ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support: Supported by faith, one torments and afflicts oneself, experiencing suffering rooted in searching. Supported by virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, one torments and afflicts oneself, experiencing suffering rooted in searching. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom are conditions for physical pleasure… physical pain… fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition. Wholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of decisive support condition. An arahant, supported by the path, generates the unarisen functional attainment, attains the arisen one, and contemplates formations as impermanent, suffering, and not-self. The path is a condition for the arahant's analytical knowledge of meaning, analytical knowledge of the Dhamma, analytical knowledge of expression, analytical knowledge of ready wit, and skill in what is possible and what is impossible by way of decisive support condition. The path is a condition for fruition attainment by way of decisive support condition.

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

An unwholesome state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

Object decisive support: Having made lust weighty, one savors and welcomes it. Having made that weighty, lust arises, and wrong view arises. Having made wrong view weighty, one savors and welcomes it. Having made that weighty, lust arises, and wrong view arises.

Anantarūpanissayo – purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity decisive support: The preceding unwholesome aggregates are a condition for the succeeding unwholesome aggregates by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0170] – rāgaṃ [M 1.0148] upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ [T 1.0178] chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti, mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeti, duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeti, saṅghaṃ bhindati. Dosaṃ upanissāya…pe… mohaṃ upanissāya…pe… mānaṃ upanissāya…pe… diṭṭhiṃ upanissāya…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati.
