Rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto adinnādānassa…pe… kāmesumicchācārassa…pe… musāvādassa…pe… pisuṇāya vācāya…pe… pharusāya vācāya…pe… samphappalāpassa…pe… abhijjhāya…pe… byāpādassa…pe… micchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Adinnādānaṃ adinnādānassa… kāmesumicchācārassa… musāvādassa… (saṃkhittaṃ) micchādiṭṭhiyā… pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.) Kāmesumicchācāro…pe… musāvādo…pe… pisuṇavācā…pe… pharusavācā…pe… samphappalāpo…pe… abhijjhā…pe… byāpādo…pe… micchādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Micchādiṭṭhi pāṇātipātassa… adinnādānassa… kāmesumicchācārassa… musāvādassa… pisuṇāya vācāya… pharusāya vācāya… samphappalāpassa… abhijjhāya… byāpādassa upanissayapaccayena [T 1.0179] paccayo. Mātughātikammaṃ mātughātikammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Mātughātikammaṃ pitughātikammassa upanissaya…pe… arahantaghātikammassa… ruhiruppādakammassa… saṅghabhedakammassa… niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pitughātikammaṃ pitughātikammassa… arahantaghātikammassa… ruhiruppādakammassa… saṅghabhedakammassa… niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā… mātughātikammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arahantaghātikammaṃ arahantaghātikammassa… ruhiruppādakammassa…pe… ruhiruppādakammaṃ ruhiruppādakammassa…pe… saṅghabhedakammaṃ saṅghabhedakammassa…pe… niyatamicchādiṭṭhi niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Niyatamicchādiṭṭhi mātughātikammassa upanissaya…pe… arahantaghātikammassa… ruhiruppādakammassa… [M 1.0149] saṅghabhedakammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (Cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ.) (1)

Natural decisive support: Based on lust, one kills living beings, takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks divisively, speaks harshly, indulges in idle chatter, breaks into a house, plunders, commits single-handed burglary, lies in ambush on the highways, goes to another's wife, commits village slaughter, commits town slaughter, deprives one's mother of life, deprives one’s father of life, deprives an arahant of life, with a malicious mind sheds the Tathāgata’s blood, and causes schism in the Saṅgha. Based on hatred… based on delusion… based on conceit… based on wrong view… based on longing, one kills living beings… causes schism in the Saṅgha. Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing by way of decisive support condition. Killing living beings is a condition for killing living beings by way of decisive support condition. Killing living beings is a condition for taking what is not given… sexual misconduct… false speech… divisive speech… harsh speech… idle chatter… covetousness… ill will… wrong view by way of decisive support condition. Taking what is not given is a condition for taking what is not given… sexual misconduct… false speech… (abbreviated) wrong view… killing living beings by way of decisive support condition. (The cycle should be completed.) Sexual misconduct… false speech… divisive speech… harsh speech… idle chatter… covetousness… ill will… wrong view is a condition for wrong view by way of decisive support condition. Wrong view is a condition for killing living beings… taking what is not given… sexual misconduct… false speech… divisive speech… harsh speech… idle chatter… covetousness… ill will by way of decisive support condition. The act of matricide is a condition for the act of matricide by way of decisive support condition. The act of matricide is a condition for the act of patricide… the act of killing an arahant… the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood… the act of causing schism in the Saṅgha… fixed wrong view by way of decisive support condition. The act of patricide is a condition for the act of patricide… the act of killing an arahant… the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood… the act of causing schism in the Saṅgha… fixed wrong view… the act of matricide by way of decisive support condition. The act of killing an arahant is a condition for the act of killing an arahant… the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood… (abbreviated) the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood is a condition for the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood… (abbreviated) the act of causing schism in the Saṅgha is a condition for the act of causing schism in the Saṅgha… (abbreviated) fixed wrong view is a condition for fixed wrong view by way of decisive support condition. Fixed wrong view is a condition for the act of matricide… (abbreviated) the act of killing an arahant… the act of shedding the Buddha’s blood… the act of causing schism in the Saṅgha by way of decisive support condition. (The cycle should be completed.)

Akusalo [V 1.0171] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Dosaṃ…pe… mohaṃ…pe… mānaṃ…pe… diṭṭhiṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa [T 1.0180]… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇaṃ hantvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Adinnaṃ ādiyitvā…pe… musā bhaṇitvā…pe… pisuṇaṃ bhaṇitvā…pe… pharusaṃ bhaṇitvā…pe… samphaṃ palapitvā…pe… sandhiṃ chinditvā…pe… nillopaṃ haritvā…pe… ekāgārikaṃ karitvā…pe… paripanthe ṭhatvā…pe… paradāraṃ gantvā…pe… gāmaghātaṃ karitvā…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karitvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mātaraṃ jīvitā voropetvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti. Pitaraṃ jīvitā voropetvā…pe… arahantaṃ jīvitā voropetvā…pe… duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādetvā…pe… saṅghaṃ bhinditvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti. (2)

An unwholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of decisive support condition. Natural decisive support: Based on lust, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses direct knowledge, arouses attainment. Based on hatred… based on delusion… based on conceit… based on wrong view… based on longing, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses direct knowledge, arouses attainment. Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition for faith… for virtue… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom by way of decisive support condition. Having killed a living being, for the sake of counteracting that act, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses direct knowledge, arouses attainment. Having taken what was not given… having spoken falsely… having spoken divisively… having spoken harshly… having engaged in idle chatter… having broken into a house… having plundered… having committed a lone burglary… having lain in wait on the highways… having gone to another's wife… having committed village slaughter… having committed town slaughter, for the sake of counteracting that act, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses direct knowledge, arouses attainment. Having deprived one’s mother of life, for the sake of counteracting that act, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha. Having deprived one’s father of life… having deprived an arahant of life… having with wicked intent shed the Tathāgata’s blood… having caused a schism in the Saṅgha, for the sake of counteracting that act, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha. (2)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

An unwholesome state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of decisive support condition: contiguity decisive support and natural decisive support.

Anantarūpanissayo – akusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity decisive support: An unwholesome state is a condition for emergence by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Dosaṃ…pe… mohaṃ…pe… mānaṃ [M 1.0150]…pe… diṭṭhiṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ [T 1.0181] ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Rāgo… doso [V 1.0172]… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā kāyikassa sukhassa… kāyikassa dukkhassa… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Akusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support: Based on lust, one torments oneself, distresses oneself, and experiences suffering rooted in seeking. Based on hatred… based on delusion… based on conceit… based on wrong view… based on longing, one torments oneself, distresses oneself, and experiences suffering rooted in seeking. Lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… longing is a condition for bodily pleasure… for bodily pain… for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Unwholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

An indeterminate state is a condition for an indeterminate state by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, and natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – arahā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ phalassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Object decisive support: An arahant reviews the fruition, holding it in high regard; they review Nibbāna, holding it in high regard. Nibbāna is a condition for the fruition by way of decisive support condition.

Anantarūpanissayo – purimā purimā vipākābyākatā, kiriyābyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity decisive support: The preceding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for the succeeding resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of decisive support condition. The life-continuum is a condition for adverting… functional consciousness is a condition for emergence… the Arahant's adaptation is a condition for fruition-attainment… for one emerging from cessation, the functional consciousness of the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Utu kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Bhojanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa [T 1.0182] dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Natural decisive support: Bodily pleasure is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Bodily pain is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Climate is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Food is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Lodging is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging is a condition for bodily pleasure, for bodily pain, and for fruition-attainment by way of decisive support condition. Fruition-attainment is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of decisive support condition.

Arahā kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Kāyikaṃ [M 1.0151] dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ [V 1.0173]… senāsanaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. (1)

An Arahant, relying on bodily pleasure, generates unarisen functional attainment, enters into arisen attainment, and contemplates conditioned phenomena as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. Relying on bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, they generate unarisen functional attainment, enter into arisen attainment, and contemplate conditioned phenomena as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

An indeterminate state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, and natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – sekkhā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa… vodānassa… maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Object Decisive Support: Trainees review the fruit, treating it as important; they review Nibbāna, treating it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage… purification… the path by way of decisive support condition.

Anantarūpanissayo – āvajjanā kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity Decisive Support: Adverting is a condition for wholesome aggregates by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ [T 1.0183] uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural Decisive Support: Relying on bodily pleasure, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha precepts, develops jhāna, develops insight, develops the path, develops direct knowledge, and develops attainment. Relying on bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one gives gifts, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha precepts, develops jhāna, develops insight, develops the path, develops direct knowledge, and develops attainment. Bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging is a condition for faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, and natural decisive support.

Ārammaṇūpanissayo – cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… vipākābyākate kiriyābyākate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

Object Decisive Support: One savors and delights in the eye, treating it as important; by treating it as important, lust arises and wrong view arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangibles… the physical base… the resultant-indeterminate and the functional-indeterminate aggregates—one savors and delights in them, treating them as important; by treating them as important, lust arises and wrong view arises.

Anantarūpanissayo [V 1.0174] – āvajjanā akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

Contiguity Decisive Support: Adverting is a condition for unwholesome aggregates by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ [M 1.0152] chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti, mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeti, duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeti, saṅghaṃ bhindati.

Natural Decisive Support: Relying on bodily pleasure, one kills living beings, takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks maliciously, speaks harshly, engages in idle chatter, breaks into houses, plunders, raids single houses, waylays, goes to another’s wife, destroys villages, destroys towns, deprives one's mother of life, deprives one's father of life, deprives an Arahant of life, with a corrupted mind draws blood from a Tathāgata, or causes a schism in the Saṅgha.

Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ…pe… utuṃ…pe… bhojanaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati… (saṃkhittaṃ.) Saṅghaṃ bhindati.

Relying on bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one kills living beings… (abbreviated)… or causes a schism in the Saṅgha.

Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging are a condition for lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… wrong view… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Prenascence Condition

424. Abyākato [T 1.0184] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ.

424. An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence.

Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa…pe… rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo.

Object Prenascence: An arahant contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, and as not-self. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangibles… the physical base—he contemplates them as impermanent, as suffering, and as not-self. With the divine eye, he sees forms. With the divine ear element, he hears sounds. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. The sound-base is a condition for ear-consciousness… the smell-base is a condition for nose-consciousness… the taste-base is a condition for tongue-consciousness… the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition.

Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa [V 1.0175] …pe… ghānāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Base Prenascence: The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. The ear-base is a condition for ear-consciousness… the nose-base is a condition for nose-consciousness… the tongue-base is a condition for tongue-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of prenascence condition. The physical base is a condition for resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence.

Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ [M 1.0153] – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti. Dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti.

Object Prenascence: Trainees or ordinary persons contemplate the eye as impermanent, as suffering, and as not-self. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangibles… the physical base—they contemplate them as impermanent, as suffering, and as not-self. With the divine eye, they see forms. With the divine ear element, they hear sounds.

Vatthupurejātaṃ [T 1.0185] – vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Base Prenascence: The physical base is a condition for wholesome aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of prenascence condition: object prenascence and base prenascence. Object Prenascence: One savors and delights in the eye, and taking it as an object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, and displeasure arises. The ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tangibles… the physical base—one savors and delights in them, and taking them as an object, lust arises… displeasure arises.

Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Base Prenascence: The physical base is a condition for unwholesome aggregates by way of prenascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

425. Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

425. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen wholesome aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Akusalo [V 1.0176] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā akusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen unwholesome aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

426. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0186] – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 1.0154] āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

426. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition. The earlier wholesome aggregates are a condition for the later wholesome aggregates by way of repetition condition. Conformity is a condition for change-of-lineage… conformity is a condition for purification… change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of repetition condition. The preceding unwholesome aggregates are a condition for the succeeding unwholesome aggregates by way of repetition condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kiriyābyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of repetition condition. The earlier functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for the later functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

427. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – kusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

427. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Wholesome volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā nānākhaṇikā (ka.). Sahajātā – kusalā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo.

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments. Co-nascent: wholesome volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition.

Nānākkhaṇikā [V 1.0177] – kusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

At different moments: wholesome volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – kusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Wholesome volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Akusalo [T 1.0187] dhammo akusalassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – akusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Unwholesome volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – akusalā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – akusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent and at different moments. Co-nascent: unwholesome volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At different moments: unwholesome volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Akusalo [M 1.0155] dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – akusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Unwholesome volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ, cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Cetanā vatthussa kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant-indeterminate volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. Volition is a condition for the base by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

428. Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa [T 1.0188] khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato [V 1.0178] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

428. An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of result condition. One resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of result condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of result condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of result condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of result condition. The aggregates are a condition for the base by way of result condition. (1)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

429. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

429. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Wholesome nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kusalā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Wholesome nutriments are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – kusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Wholesome nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (3)

Akusalo [M 1.0156] dhammo akusalassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – akusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo.

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Unwholesome nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of nutriment condition.

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – akusalā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena [T 1.0189] paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Unwholesome nutriments are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – akusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of nutriment condition. Unwholesome nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo[V 1.0179]. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of nutriment condition. Resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant-indeterminate nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. Physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

430. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – kusalā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

430. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Wholesome faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – kusalā indriyā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Wholesome faculties are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – kusalā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of faculty condition. Wholesome faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (3)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0190] – akusalā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Unwholesome faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – akusalā indriyā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Unwholesome faculties are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (2)

Akusalo [M 1.0157] dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – akusalā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of faculty condition. Unwholesome faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Sotindriyaṃ sotaviññāṇassa [V 1.0180] …pe… ghānindriyaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa…pe… jivhindriyaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of faculty condition. Resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant-indeterminate faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. The eye-faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition. The ear-faculty is a condition for ear-consciousness… the nose-faculty is a condition for nose-consciousness… the tongue-faculty is a condition for tongue-consciousness… the body-faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. The material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (1)

Jhānapaccayo

Jhāna Condition

431. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

431. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of jhāna condition. Wholesome jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of jhāna condition. (1)

Kusalo [T 1.0191] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni jhānaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of jhāna condition. Wholesome jhāna factors are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of jhāna condition. Wholesome jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. (3)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of jhāna condition. Unwholesome jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of jhāna condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni jhānaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of jhāna condition. Unwholesome jhāna factors are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of jhāna condition. Unwholesome jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. (3)

Abyākato [M 1.0158] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatāni kiriyābyākatāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo[V 1.0181]. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of jhāna condition. Resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant-indeterminate jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and kamma-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition. (1)

Maggapaccayo

Path Condition

432. Kusalo [T 1.0192] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (1)

432. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of path condition. Wholesome path factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of path condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni maggaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of path condition. Wholesome path factors are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – kusalāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of path condition. Wholesome path factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. (3)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of path condition. Unwholesome path factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of path condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni maggaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of path condition. Unwholesome path factors are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – akusalāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon and for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of path condition. Unwholesome path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākatāni kiriyābyākatāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 1.0193] vipākābyākatāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of path condition. Resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant-indeterminate path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of path condition. (1)

Sampayuttapaccayo

Association Condition

433. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho [V 1.0182] tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Tayo [M 1.0159] khandhā ekassa khandhassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

433. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of association condition. One wholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of association condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of association condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of association condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of association condition. One unwholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of association condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of association condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of association condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – vipākābyākato kiriyābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of association condition. A resultant-indeterminate or a functional-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of association condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of association condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of association condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, a resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of association condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of association condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of association condition. (1)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

434. Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0194] – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

434. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: The wholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: The wholesome aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – akusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: The unwholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: The unwholesome aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākatā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [V 1.0183] paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo[M 1.0160]. Ghānāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Jivhāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ [T 1.0195] khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: The resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, the resultant-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of dissociation condition. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The ear base is a condition for ear-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The nose base is a condition for nose-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The tongue base is a condition for tongue-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The body base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The physical base is a condition for the resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: The resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The physical base is a condition for the wholesome aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ vatthu akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: The physical base is a condition for the unwholesome aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

435. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

435. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of presence condition. One wholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: The wholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Postnascence: The wholesome aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa [T 1.0196] khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for wholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of presence condition. One wholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (3)

Akusalo [V 1.0184] dhammo akusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of presence condition. One unwholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Akusalo [M 1.0161] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – akusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: the unwholesome aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. Postnascence: the unwholesome aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena by way of presence condition. One unwholesome aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (3)

Abyākato dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – vipākābyākato kiriyābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ [T 1.0197] cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākābyākato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, faculty. Conascence: one resultant-indeterminate or functional-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of presence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant-indeterminate aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate and for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The two aggregates are a condition for the two aggregates and for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical base by way of presence condition. The physical base is a condition for the aggregates by way of presence condition. One great element is a condition for the three great elements by way of presence condition. The three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of presence condition. The two great elements are a condition for the two great elements by way of presence condition. The great elements are a condition for mind-originated materiality, for kamma-originated materiality, and for derived materiality by way of presence condition. External… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition for the three great elements by way of presence condition. The three great elements are a condition for one great element by way of presence condition. The two great elements are a condition for the two great elements by way of presence condition. The great elements are a condition for kamma-originated materiality and for derived materiality by way of presence condition.

Purejātaṃ [V 1.0185][M 1.0162] – arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati… sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe [T 1.0198] …pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa…pe… jivhāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipākābyākatānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākābyākatā kiriyābyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Prenascence: an arahant sees with insight the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… the ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the physical base as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; with the divine eye one sees forms; with the divine ear-element one hears sounds. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition. The sound-base… the tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence condition. The ear-base is a condition for ear-consciousness… the nose-base is a condition for nose-consciousness… the tongue-base is a condition for tongue-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. The physical base is a condition for the resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates by way of presence condition. Postnascence: the resultant-indeterminate and functional-indeterminate aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. Physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of presence condition. The material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-originated materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti… sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti. Vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascence: trainees or ordinary people see with insight the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self… the ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the physical base as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; with the divine eye they see forms; with the divine ear-element they hear sounds. The physical base is a condition for the wholesome aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo [T 1.0199] – purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ assādeti, abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… ghānaṃ…pe… jivhaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ…pe… rūpe…pe… sadde…pe… gandhe…pe… rase…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ assādeti, abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthu akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate state is a condition for an unwholesome state by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent—one delights in the eye, welcomes it; taking that as an object, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, displeasure arises. The ear... the nose... the tongue... the body... forms... sounds... odors... tastes... tangibles... one delights in the physical base, welcomes it; taking that as an object, lust arises... displeasure arises. The physical base is a condition for the unwholesome aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

Kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ[V 1.0186]. Sahajāto – kusalo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Wholesome and indeterminate states are a condition for a wholesome state by way of presence condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent—one wholesome aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates by way of presence condition... two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Kusalo [M 1.0163] ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – kusalā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā kusalā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Wholesome and indeterminate states are a condition for an indeterminate state by way of presence condition—co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent—wholesome aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—wholesome aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—wholesome aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – akusalo eko [T 1.0200] khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ca vatthu ca ekassa khandhassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Unwholesome and indeterminate states are a condition for an unwholesome state by way of presence condition—co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent—one unwholesome aggregate and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates by way of presence condition. Three aggregates and the physical base are a condition for one aggregate by way of presence condition. Two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – akusalā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – akusalā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Unwholesome and indeterminate states are a condition for an indeterminate state by way of presence condition—co-nascent, post-nascent, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent—unwholesome aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—unwholesome aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Post-nascent—unwholesome aggregates and the material life-faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (2)

Natthipaccayo

Absence Condition

436. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa natthipaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ natthipaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

436. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of absence condition: preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition for subsequent wholesome aggregates by way of absence condition. (In brief.)

(Yathā anantarapaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(This should be elaborated in the same way as the contiguity condition.)

Vigatapaccayo

Disappearance Condition

437. Kusalo [V 1.0187] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa vigatapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vigatapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

437. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of disappearance condition: preceding wholesome aggregates are a condition for subsequent wholesome aggregates by way of disappearance condition. (In brief.)

(Yathā anantarapaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(This should be elaborated in the same way as the contiguity condition.)

Avigatapaccayo

Non-disappearance Condition

438. Kusalo [M 1.0164] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa avigatapaccayena paccayo – kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ avigatapaccayena paccayo[T 1.0201]. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa avigatapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ avigatapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

438. A wholesome state is a condition for a wholesome state by way of non-disappearance condition: one wholesome aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of non-disappearance condition. Three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of non-disappearance condition. Two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of non-disappearance condition. (In brief.)

(Yathā atthipaccayaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(This should be elaborated in the same way as the presence condition.)

Pañhāvārassa vibhaṅgo.

439. Hetuyā satta, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā dasa, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme satta, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre satta, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate terasa.

439. In root condition, seven; in object, nine; in predominance, ten; in contiguity, seven; in immediate contiguity, seven; in co-nascence, nine; in mutuality, three; in support, thirteen; in decisive support, nine; in pre-nascence, three; in post-nascence, three; in repetition, three; in kamma, seven; in result, one; in nutriment, seven; in faculty, seven; in jhāna, seven; in path, seven; in association, three; in dissociation, five; in presence, thirteen; in absence, seven; in disappearance, seven; in non-disappearance, thirteen.

Hetusabhāgaṃ

Section Related to Root

440. Hetupaccayā [V 1.0188] adhipatiyā cattāri, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye satta, vipāke ekaṃ, indriye cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, avigate satta. (11)

440. In root condition: with predominance, four; with co-nascence, seven; with mutuality, three; with support, seven; with result, one; with faculty, four; with path, four; with association, three; with dissociation, three; with presence, seven; with non-disappearance, seven. (11)

Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. (Savipākaṃ – 5)

Root, co-nascence, support, result, presence, and non-disappearance—one. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, result, presence, and non-disappearance—one. Two with Root, Co-nascence, Mutuality, Dependence, Faculty, Path, Association, Presence, and Non-disappearance. Two with Root, Co-nascence, Dependence, Faculty, Path, Dissociation, Presence, and Non-disappearance. (Non-resultant—4)

Hetu-sahajāta-aññamaññanissaya-vipāka-indriya-magga-sampayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipākaindriya-magga-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. Hetumūlakaṃ.

Root-based.

527. Kusalo [T 1.0227] dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

527. A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong support condition.

Kusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of strong support condition.

Kusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo.

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong support condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition.

Kusalo [V 1.0217] dhammo kusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A wholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (4)

528. Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

528. An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong support condition.

Akusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of strong support condition.

Akusalo dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo.

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong support condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition.

Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca abyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

An unwholesome phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon and an indeterminate phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (4)

529. Abyākato [M 1.0190] dhammo abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo.

529. An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of strong support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition.

Abyākato dhammo kusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 1.0228] paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo.

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of strong support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition.

Abyākato dhammo akusalassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An indeterminate phenomenon is a condition for an unwholesome phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of strong support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

530. Kusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ.

530. Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for a wholesome phenomenon by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence.

Kusalo [V 1.0218] ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

Wholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (2)

531. Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ.

Akusalo ca abyākato ca dhammā abyākatassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

Unwholesome and indeterminate phenomena are a condition for an indeterminate phenomenon by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (2)

Natthi-vigatadukāni

The Dyads of Absence and Disappearance.

629. Natthipaccayā nahetuyā satta…pe… vigatapaccayā nahetuyā satta…pe…. (Natthipaccayampi vigatapaccayampi anantarapaccayasadisaṃ.)

629. By the absence condition, not by way of root, seven… and so on… by the disappearance condition, not by way of root, seven… and so on…. (The absence condition and the disappearance condition are similar to the immediacy condition.)

Avigatadukaṃ

The Non-Disappearance Dyad.

630. Avigatapaccayā nahetuyā terasa…. (Yathā atthipaccayo vitthārito evaṃ avigatapaccayo vitthāretabbo.)

630. By the non-disappearance condition, not by way of root, thirteen… and so on…. (As the presence condition is detailed, so should the non-disappearance condition be detailed.)

Napacchājātapaccayā [V 1.0321] nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā nasahajātapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, kamme dve, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, vippayutte tīṇi[T 1.0350], atthiyā tīṇi, avigate tīṇi.

Not by postnascence condition, not by root condition, not by object condition, not by dominance condition, not by contiguity condition, not by immediate contiguity condition, not by conascence condition, not by reciprocity condition: in dependence condition, three; in decisive support condition, nine; in prenascence condition, three; in kamma condition, two; in nutriment condition, one; in faculty condition, one; in dissociation condition, three; in presence condition, three; in non-disappearance condition, three.

Nakammapaccayā nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā nasahajātapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye nava, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā satta, avigate satta (saṃkhittaṃ).
