Bāvīsakaṃ (saindriyaṃ)

The Group of Twenty-Two (with faculty).

Navippayuttapaccayā nahetupaccayā (mūlakaṃ saṃkhittaṃ) naindriyapaccayā najhānapaccayā namaggapaccayā nasampayuttapaccayā nonatthipaccayā novigatapaccayā āhāre ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.

By non-dissociation condition, by not-root condition (root section abbreviated), by not-faculty condition, by not-jhāna condition, by not-path condition, by not-association condition, by not-absence condition, by not-disappearance condition: by nutriment, one; by presence, one; by non-disappearance, one.

Navippayuttamūlakaṃ.

The non-dissociation root.

Noatthidukaṃ

The Not-Presence Dyad.

650. Noatthipaccayā [T 1.0357] ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā satta, anantare satta, samanantare satta, upanissaye nava, āsevane tīṇi, kamme dve, natthiyā satta, vigate satta…pe….

650. By not-presence condition: by object, nine; by dominance, seven; by contiguity, seven; by immediacy, seven; by strong support, nine; by repetition, three; by kamma, two; by absence, seven; by disappearance, seven; and so on.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad.

Noatthipaccayā [M 1.0292] nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā anantare satta, samanantare satta, upanissaye nava, āsevane tīṇi, kamme dve, natthiyā satta, vigate satta…pe….

By not-presence condition, by not-root condition, by not-object condition: by contiguity, seven; by immediacy, seven; by strong support, nine; by repetition, three; by kamma, two; by absence, seven; by disappearance, seven; and so on.

Sattakaṃ

The Heptad.

Noatthipaccayā [V 1.0329] nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā upanissaye nava, kamme dve…pe….

By not-presence condition, by not-root condition, by not-object condition, by not-dominance condition, by not-contiguity condition, by not-immediacy condition: by strong support, nine; by kamma, two; and so on.

Catuvīsakaṃ (saupanissayaṃ)

The Group of Twenty-Four (with strong support).

Noatthipaccayā nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā nasahajātapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā nanissayapaccayā naupanissayapaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā navipākapaccayā naāhārapaccayā naindriyapaccayā najhānapaccayā namaggapaccayā nasampayuttapaccayā navippayuttapaccayā nonatthipaccayā novigatapaccayā noavigatapaccayā kamme dve.

By not-presence condition, by not-root condition, by not-object condition, by not-dominance condition, by not-contiguity condition, by not-immediacy condition, by not-co-nascence condition, by not-mutuality condition, by not-dependence condition, by not-strong support condition, by not-pre-nascence condition, by not-post-nascence condition, by not-repetition condition, by not-result condition, by not-nutriment condition, by not-faculty condition, by not-jhāna condition, by not-path condition, by not-association condition, by not-dissociation condition, by not-absence condition, by not-disappearance condition, by not-non-disappearance condition: by kamma, two.

Catuvīsakaṃ (sakammaṃ)

The Twenty-four (with kamma).

Noatthipaccayā nahetupaccayā naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā nasahajātapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā nanissayapaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā [T 1.0358] naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā navipākapaccayā naāhārapaccayā naindriyapaccayā najhānapaccayā namaggapaccayā nasampayuttapaccayā navippayuttapaccayā nonatthipaccayā novigatapaccayā noavigatapaccayā upanissaye nava.

Not by the presence condition, not by the root condition, not by the object condition, not by the dominance condition, not by the contiguity condition, not by the immediate contiguity condition, not by the co-nascence condition, not by the mutuality condition, not by the dependence condition, not by the pre-nascence condition, not by the post-nascence condition, not by the repetition condition, not by the kamma condition, not by the result condition, not by the nutriment condition, not by the faculty condition, not by the jhāna condition, not by the path condition, not by the association condition, not by the dissociation condition, not by the absence condition, not by the disappearance condition, not by the non-disappearance condition; by decisive support, nine.

Noatthimūlakaṃ.

The Root of Non-Presence.

Nonatthidukaṃ

The Non-Absence Dyad.

651. Nonatthipaccayā hetuyā satta…pe… avigate terasa.

651. Not by the absence condition: by root, seven… (Abbreviated.)… by non-disappearance, thirteen.

(Yathā nahetumūlakaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Just as the Root of Non-Root, so should it be elaborated.)

Nonatthimūlakaṃ.

The Root of Non-Absence.

Novigatadukaṃ

The Non-Disappearance Dyad.

652. Novigatapaccayā [V 1.0330][M 1.0293] hetuyā satta…pe… avigate terasa.

652. Not by the disappearance condition: by root, seven… (Abbreviated.)… by non-disappearance, thirteen.

(Yathā nahetumūlakaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Just as the Root of Non-Root, so should it be elaborated.)

Novigatamūlakaṃ.

The Root of Non-Disappearance.

Noavigatadukaṃ

The Non-Non-Disappearance Dyad.

653. Noavigatapaccayā ārammaṇe nava…pe… natthiyā satta, vigate satta.

653. Not by the non-disappearance condition: by object, nine… (Abbreviated.)… by absence, seven; by disappearance, seven.

(Yathā noatthimūlakaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

(Just as the Root of Non-Presence, so should it be elaborated.)

Noavigatamūlakaṃ.

The Root of Non-Non-Disappearance.

Pañhāvārassa paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Reverse-Forward Order of the Question Section.

Kusalattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Wholesome Triad is finished.

2. Vedanāttikaṃ

2. The Triad of Feeling.

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Section on Dependence.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Forward Order of Conditions.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section of Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

1. Sukhāya [T 1.0359][V 1.0331][M 1.0294] vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

1. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A phenomenon associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with painful feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Ārammaṇapaccayādi

The Object Condition, etc.

2. Sukhāya [V 1.0332] vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā… adhipatipaccayā [T 1.0360] (adhipatiyā paṭisandhi natthi)… anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… sahajātapaccayā… aññamaññapaccayā… nissayapaccayā… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Vatthuṃ purejātapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

2. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition… by way of dominance condition (there is no dominance at rebirth-linking)… by way of contiguity condition… by way of immediate contiguity condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of mutuality condition… by way of dependence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The physical base is a pre-nascence condition. (Abbreviated.)

Āsevanapaccayādi

The Repetition Condition, etc.

3. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā… kammapaccayā… vipākapaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho[M 1.0295]; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

3. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of repetition condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of result condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A phenomenon associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of result condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by painful feeling and accompanied by body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca [T 1.0361] eko khandho.

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of result condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Āhārapaccayādi

Nutriment Condition, etc.

4. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā… vippayuttapaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko [V 1.0333] khandho; vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā.

4. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition... by way of jhāna condition... by way of path condition... by way of association condition... by way of dissociation condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The base is a condition by way of dissociation. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The base is a condition by way of dissociation.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā.

A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with painful feeling by way of dissociation condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with painful feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The base is a condition by way of dissociation.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati vippayuttapaccayā – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho. Vatthuṃ vippayuttapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of dissociation condition. Dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The base is a condition by way of dissociation. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. The base is a condition by way of dissociation (abbreviated).

Atthipaccayādi

Presence Condition, etc.

5. Atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā….

5. By way of presence condition... by way of absence condition... by way of disappearance condition... by way of non-disappearance condition...

Suddhaṃ

Pure

6. Hetuyā [T 1.0362][M 1.0296] tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.

6. By way of root condition, three; by way of object condition, three... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Hetuādidukāni

Pairs Beginning with Root Condition

7. Hetupaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… vipāke dve…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

7. By way of root condition, by way of object condition, three... and so on... by way of result condition, two... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Ārammaṇapaccayā [V 1.0334] adhipatipaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… vipāke dve…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of object condition, by way of dominance condition, by way of root condition, three... and so on... by way of result condition, two... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Āsevanapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… kamme tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of repetition condition, by way of root condition, three... and so on... by way of kamma condition, three; by way of nutriment condition, three... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Vipākapaccayā hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā dve…pe… purejāte tīṇi, kamme tīṇi…pe… jhāne dve, magge dve…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of result condition: by way of root condition, two; by way of object condition, three; by way of dominance condition, two... and so on... by way of pre-nascence condition, three; by way of kamma condition, three... and so on... by way of jhāna condition, two; by way of path condition, two... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Jhānapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… vipāke dve…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of jhāna condition: by way of root condition, three... and so on... by way of result condition, two... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Maggapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… vipāke dve…pe… avigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of path condition: by way of root condition, three... and so on... by way of result condition, two... and so on... by way of non-disappearance condition, three... and so on.

Avigatapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi…pe….

By way of non-disappearance condition: by way of root condition, three... and so on... by way of absence condition, three; by way of disappearance condition, three... and so on.

(Yathā kusalattikassa paccayagaṇanā, evaṃ vitthāretabbā).

(Just as the enumeration of conditions for the wholesome triad, so it should be expanded.)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Reverse Method of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

Non-Root Condition

8. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

8. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of non-root condition. Dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati [V 1.0335] nahetupaccayā – dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with painful feeling by way of non-root condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by painful body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya [M 1.0297] vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya [T 1.0363] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of non-root condition. Dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. Dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises.

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-Dominance Condition

9. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (nādhipati paripuṇṇaṃ paṭisandhikaṃ).

9. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of non-dominance condition (the full explanation includes the rebirth-linking case).

Napurejātapaccayo

Non-Pre-nascence Condition

10. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

10. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of non-pre-nascence condition. In the formless realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho; paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve [T 1.0364] khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by non-pre-nascence condition. In the formless realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise, and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise, and dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Napacchājāta-naāsevanapaccayā

By non-post-nascence and non-repetition conditions.

11. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati [V 1.0336] napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā (napacchājātampi naāsevanampi paripuṇṇaṃ paṭisandhikaṃ).

11. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by non-post-nascence condition… by non-repetition condition (Both non-post-nascence and non-repetition are complete at rebirth-linking).

Nakammapaccayo

By non-kamma condition.

12. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā.

12. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by non-kamma condition. Dependent on aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, volition associated with pleasant feeling arises.

Dukkhāya [M 1.0298] vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā.

A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with painful feeling by non-kamma condition. Dependent on aggregates associated with painful feeling, volition associated with painful feeling arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by non-kamma condition. Dependent on aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, volition associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises.

Navipāka-najhānapaccayā

By non-result and non-absorption conditions.

13. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā… najhānapaccayā – sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve [T 1.0365] khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

13. A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by non-result condition… by non-absorption condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by pleasant feeling and accompanied by body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with painful feeling by non-absorption condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by painful feeling and accompanied by body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – catuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by non-absorption condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by the four consciousnesses, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Namaggapaccayo

By non-path condition.

14. Sukhāya [V 1.0337] vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

14. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by non-path condition. Dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with painful feeling arises dependent on a state associated with painful feeling by non-path condition. Dependent on one aggregate accompanied by painful feeling and body-consciousness, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā[T 1.0366], dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho[M 1.0299]; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by non-path condition. Dependent on one rootless aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Navippayuttapaccayo

By non-dissociation condition.

15. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

15. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with pleasant feeling by non-dissociation condition. In the formless realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca dve khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca eko khandho.

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by non-dissociation condition. In the formless realm, dependent on one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, two aggregates arise; dependent on two aggregates, one aggregate arises.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

16. Nahetuyā tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane [V 1.0338] tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, najhāne tīṇi, namagge tīṇi, navippayutte dve.

16. By non-root condition, three; by non-dominance condition, three; by non-pre-nascence condition, two; by non-post-nascence condition, three; by non-repetition condition, three; by non-kamma condition, three; by non-result condition, three; by non-absorption condition, three; by non-path condition, three; by non-dissociation condition, two.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

17. Nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne tīṇi, namagge tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ…pe….

17. By non-root condition: with non-dominance condition, three; with non-pre-nascence condition, one; with non-post-nascence condition, three; with non-repetition condition, three; with non-kamma condition, two; with non-result condition, two; with non-absorption condition, three; with non-path condition, three; with non-dissociation condition, one… and so on.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ…pe….

By non-root condition, non-dominance condition, and non-pre-nascence condition: in combination with non-post-nascence condition, one; in combination with non-repetition condition, one; in combination with non-kamma condition, one; in combination with non-result condition, one; in combination with non-path condition, one; in combination with non-dissociation condition, one… and so on.

Navakaṃ

The Nonad

Nahetupaccayā [T 1.0367] naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā navipākapaccayā namaggapaccayā navippayutte ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

By non-root condition, non-dominance condition, non-pre-nascence condition, non-post-nascence condition, non-repetition condition, non-kamma condition, non-result condition, non-path condition, and non-dissociation condition: one (abbreviated).

Naadhipatidukaṃ

The Non-Dominance Dyad

18. Naadhipatipaccayā [M 1.0300] nahetuyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, najhāne tīṇi, namagge tīṇi, navippayutte dve (saṃkhittaṃ).

18. Non-domination condition, non-root condition: three; non-prenascence condition: two; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-kamma condition: three; non-result condition: three; non-jhāna condition: three; non-path condition: three; non-dissociation condition: two (abbreviated).

Napurejātadukaṃ

The Non-Prenascence Dyad.

19. Napurejātapaccayā nahetuyā ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte dve.

19. Non-prenascence condition, non-root condition: one; non-domination condition: two; non-postnascence condition: two; non-repetition condition: two; non-kamma condition: two; non-result condition: two; non-path condition: one; non-dissociation condition: two.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Napurejātapaccayā [V 1.0339] nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā ekaṃ, napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Non-prenascence condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition: one; non-postnascence condition: one; non-repetition condition: one; non-kamma condition: one; non-result condition: one; non-path condition: one; non-dissociation condition: one (abbreviated).

Napacchājātādidukāni

The Non-Postnascence Dyad and Others.

20. Napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, namagge dve, navippayutte dve.

20. Non-postnascence condition... non-repetition condition... non-kamma condition, non-root condition: two; non-domination condition: three; non-prenascence condition: two; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-result condition: three; non-path condition: two; non-dissociation condition: two.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Nakammapaccayā nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā dve, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, navipāke dve, namagge dve, navippayutte ekaṃ…pe….

Non-kamma condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition: two; non-prenascence condition: one; non-postnascence condition: two; non-repetition condition: two; non-result condition: two; non-path condition: two; non-dissociation condition: one...and so on.

Pañcakaṃ

The Pentad.

Nakammapaccayā nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā [T 1.0368] napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Non-kamma condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition, non-prenascence condition, non-postnascence condition: one; non-repetition condition: one; non-result condition: one; non-path condition: one; non-dissociation condition: one (abbreviated).

Navipākadukaṃ

The Non-Result Dyad.

21. Navipākapaccayā [M 1.0301] nahetuyā dve, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, namagge dve, navippayutte dve.

21. Non-result condition, non-root condition: two; non-domination condition: three; non-prenascence condition: two; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-kamma condition: three; non-path condition: two; non-dissociation condition: two.

Navipākapaccayā (nakammapaccayasadisaṃ).

Non-result condition (similar to the non-kamma condition).

Najhānadukaṃ

The Non-Jhāna Dyad.

22. Najhānapaccayā nahetuyā tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, namagge tīṇi…pe….

22. Non-jhāna condition, non-root condition: three; non-domination condition: three; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-path condition: three...and so on.

Chakkaṃ

The Hexad.

Najhānapaccayā [V 1.0340] nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā namagge tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

Non-jhāna condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition, non-postnascence condition, non-repetition condition, non-path condition: three (abbreviated).

Namaggadukaṃ

The Non-Path Dyad.

23. Namaggapaccayā nahetuyā tīṇi, naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ.

23. Non-path condition, non-root condition: three; non-domination condition: three; non-prenascence condition: one; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-kamma condition: two; non-result condition: two; non-jhāna condition: three; non-dissociation condition: one.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Namaggapaccayā nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ…pe….

Non-path condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition: three; non-prenascence condition: one; non-postnascence condition: three; non-repetition condition: three; non-kamma condition: two; non-result condition: two; non-jhāna condition: three; non-dissociation condition: one...and so on.

Pañcakaṃ

The Pentad.

Namaggapaccayā nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, navippayutte ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Non-path condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition, non-prenascence condition, non-postnascence condition: one; non-repetition condition: one; non-kamma condition: one; non-result condition: one; non-dissociation condition: one (abbreviated).

Navippayuttadukaṃ

The Non-Dissociation Dyad.

24. Navippayuttapaccayā nahetuyā ekaṃ, naadhipatiyā dve, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte dve, naāsevane dve, nakamme dve, navipāke [T 1.0369] dve, namagge ekaṃ.

24. Non-dissociation condition, non-root condition: one; non-domination condition: two; non-prenascence condition: two; non-postnascence condition: two; non-repetition condition: two; non-kamma condition: two; non-result condition: two; non-path condition: one.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Navippayuttapaccayā [M 1.0302] nahetupaccayā naadhipatiyā ekaṃ, napurejāte ekaṃ, napacchājāte ekaṃ, naāsevane ekaṃ, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ…pe….

Non-dissociation condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition: one; non-prenascence condition: one; non-postnascence condition: one; non-repetition condition: one; non-kamma condition: one; non-result condition: one; non-path condition: one...and so on.

Navakaṃ

The Nonad.

Navippayuttapaccayā [V 1.0341] nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā navipākapaccayā namagge ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Non-dissociation condition, non-root condition, non-domination condition, non-prenascence condition, non-postnascence condition, non-repetition condition, non-kamma condition, non-result condition, non-path condition: one (abbreviated).

Paccanīyagaṇanā.

Negative Enumeration.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. Positive-Negative Enumeration of Conditions.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad.

25. Hetupaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, navippayutte dve.

25. By root condition, not by dominance condition: three; not by prenascence condition: two; not by postnascence condition: three; not by repetition condition: three; not by kamma condition: three; not by result condition: three; not by dissociation condition: two.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Hetupaccayā ārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte dve, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, navipāke tīṇi, navippayutte dve.

By root condition, by object condition, not by dominance condition: three; not by prenascence condition: two; not by postnascence condition: three; not by repetition condition: three; not by kamma condition: three; not by result condition: three; not by dissociation condition: two.

(Yathā kusalattikaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(As with the wholesome triad, so it should be reckoned.)

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

Positive-Negative.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. Negative-Positive Enumeration of Conditions.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Not-Root Dyad.

26. Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe [V 1.0342] tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre [M 1.0303] tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne dve, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi[T 1.0370], vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi.

26. Not by root condition, by object condition: three; by proximity condition: three; by contiguity condition: three; by conascence condition: three; by mutuality condition: three; by dependence condition: three; by strong dependence condition: three; by prenascence condition: three; by repetition condition: two; by kamma condition: three; by result condition: three; by nutriment condition: three; by faculty condition: three; by jhāna condition: two; by path condition: one; by association condition: three; by dissociation condition: three; by presence condition: three; by absence condition: three; by disappearance condition: three; by non-disappearance condition: three.

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne dve, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi.

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, by object condition: three; by proximity condition: three; by contiguity condition: three; by conascence condition: three; by mutuality condition: three; by dependence condition: three; by strong dependence condition: three; by prenascence condition: three; by repetition condition: two; by kamma condition: three; by result condition: three; by nutriment condition: three; by faculty condition: three; by jhāna condition: two; by path condition: one; by association condition: three; by dissociation condition: three; by presence condition: three; by absence condition: three; by disappearance condition: three; by non-disappearance condition: three.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad.

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, vippayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by conascence condition: one; by mutuality condition: one; by dependence condition: one; by strong dependence condition: one; by repetition condition: one; by kamma condition: one; by result condition: one; by nutriment condition: one; by faculty condition: one; by jhāna condition: one; by path condition: one; by association condition: one; by dissociation condition: one; by presence condition: one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: one… and so on.

Sattakaṃ

The Septad.

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by prenascence condition, not by postnascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by conascence condition: one; by mutuality condition: one; by dependence condition: one; by strong dependence condition: one; by nutriment condition: one; by faculty condition: one; by jhāna condition: one; by association condition: one; by presence condition: one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: one… and so on.

Dasakaṃ

The Decad.

Nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā…pe… nakammapaccayā [T 1.0371] navipākapaccayā namaggapaccayā navippayuttapaccayā [V 1.0343] ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ).

Not by root condition, not by dominance condition… and so on… not by kamma condition, not by result condition, not by path condition, not by dissociation condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by conascence condition: one; by mutuality condition: one; by dependence condition: one; by strong dependence condition: one; by nutriment condition: one; by faculty condition: one; by jhāna condition: one; by association condition: one; by presence condition: one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: one (abbreviated).

Nahetumūlakaṃ.

Based on the Not-Root Condition.

Naadhipatidukaṃ

The Not-Dominance Dyad.

27. Naadhipatipaccayā [M 1.0304] hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

27. Not by dominance condition, by root condition: three… and so on… by non-disappearance condition: three (abbreviated).

Napurejātadukaṃ

The Not-Prenascence Dyad.

28. Napurejātapaccayā hetuyā dve…pe… avigate dve (saṃkhittaṃ).

28. Not by prenascence condition, by root condition: two… and so on… by non-disappearance condition: two (abbreviated).

Napacchājātādidukāni

The Not-Postnascence and Other Dyads.

29. Napacchājātapaccayā… naāsevanapaccayā… nakammapaccayā… navipākapaccayā hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

29. Not by postnascence condition… not by repetition condition… not by kamma condition… not by result condition, by root condition: three… and so on… by non-disappearance condition: three (abbreviated).

Najhānadukaṃ

The Not-Jhāna Dyad.

30. Najhānapaccayā ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

30. Not by jhāna condition, by object condition: three; by proximity condition: three; by contiguity condition: three; by conascence condition: three; by mutuality condition: three; by dependence condition: three; by strong dependence condition: three; by prenascence condition: three; by kamma condition: three; by result condition: three; by nutriment condition: three; by faculty condition: three; by association condition: three; by dissociation condition: three; by presence condition: three; by absence condition: three; by disappearance condition: three; by non-disappearance condition: three (abbreviated).

Namaggadukaṃ

The Not-Path Dyad.

31. Namaggapaccayā [V 1.0344] ārammaṇe tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi…pe… āsevane ekaṃ, kamme tīṇi…pe… jhāne dve…pe… avigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

31. Not by path condition, by object condition: three; by proximity condition: three; by contiguity condition: three… and so on… by repetition condition: one; by kamma condition: three… and so on… by jhāna condition: two… and so on… by non-disappearance condition: three (abbreviated).

Navippayuttadukaṃ

The Dyad of the Not-Dissociated Condition.

32. Navippayuttapaccayā hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā dve, anantare dve, samanantare dve, sahajāte dve, aññamaññe dve, nissaye dve, upanissaye dve, āsevane dve, kamme dve, vipāke dve, āhāre dve, indriye dve, jhāne dve, magge dve, sampayutte dve, atthiyā dve, natthiyā dve, vigate [T 1.0372] dve, avigate dve.

32. By not-dissociated condition, by root condition: two; by object condition: two; by dominance condition: two; by proximity condition: two; by contiguity condition: two; by co-nascence condition: two; by mutuality condition: two; by dependence condition: two; by strong dependence condition: two; by repetition condition: two; by kamma condition: two; by result condition: two; by nutriment condition: two; by faculty condition: two; by jhāna condition: two; by path condition: two; by association condition: two; by presence condition: two; by absence condition: two; by disappearance condition: two; by non-disappearance condition: two.

Tikaṃ

The Triad.

Navippayuttapaccayā nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye [M 1.0305] ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, kamme ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ…pe….

By not-dissociated condition, not by root condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by co-nascence condition: one; by mutuality condition: one; by dependence condition: one; by strong dependence condition: one; by repetition condition: one; by kamma condition: one; by nutriment condition: one; by faculty condition: one; by jhāna condition: one; by path condition: one; by association condition: one; by presence condition: one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: one…and so on.

Dasakaṃ

The Decad.

Navippayuttapaccayā nahetupaccayā naadhipatipaccayā napurejātapaccayā napacchājātapaccayā naāsevanapaccayā nakammapaccayā navipākapaccayā namaggapaccayā ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ, samanantare ekaṃ, sahajāte ekaṃ, aññamaññe ekaṃ, nissaye ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, āhāre ekaṃ, indriye ekaṃ, jhāne ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, atthiyā ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.

By not-dissociated condition, not by root condition, not by dominance condition, not by pre-nascence condition, not by post-nascence condition, not by repetition condition, not by kamma condition, not by result condition, not by path condition, by object condition: one; by proximity condition: one; by contiguity condition: one; by co-nascence condition: one; by mutuality condition: one; by dependence condition: one; by strong dependence condition: one; by nutriment condition: one; by faculty condition: one; by jhāna condition: one; by association condition: one; by presence condition: one; by absence condition: one; by disappearance condition: one; by non-disappearance condition: one.

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Affirmative of the Negative.

Paṭiccavāro.

The Section on Conditional Relations.

34. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition...

35. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya…pe….

35. Depending on a state associated with pleasant feeling...

36. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho…pe….

36. A state associated with pleasant feeling is combined with...

37. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ sampayuttā dve khandhā, dve khandhe sampayutto eko khandho (saṃkhittaṃ).

37. A state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition, being associated with a state associated with pleasant feeling: one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling is associated with two aggregates, and two aggregates are associated with one aggregate (abbreviated).

Sampayuttavāro.

The Association Section.
