7. The Question Section.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Affirmative Method of Conditions.

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

38. Sukhāya [V 1.0346][M 1.0306] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

38. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of root condition. Roots associated with pleasant feeling are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, roots associated with pleasant feeling are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of root condition. Roots associated with painful feeling are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena [T 1.0374] paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition; roots associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, roots associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition.

39. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti[V 1.0347], pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; sukhāya [M 1.0307] vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

39. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition: with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one reflects after giving alms, undertaking precepts, or performing the uposatha observance. Having emerged from jhāna, the path, or fruition associated with pleasant feeling, one reflects with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Noble ones, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, reflect on the defilements associated with pleasant feeling that have been abandoned, reflect on the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements formerly accumulated. With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one contemplates the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, savors them, and delights in them; taking that as object, lust and wrong view associated with pleasant feeling arise; taking the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling as object, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (1)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte [T 1.0375] jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of object condition: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, displeasure due to regret arises. When a jhāna associated with pleasant feeling is lost, displeasure due to regret arises. Based on aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (2)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo[T 1.0376]. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of object condition: having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed Uposatha duties with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews that with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Emerging from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews that with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Noble ones, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, reflect on the defilements associated with pleasant feeling that have been abandoned, reflect on the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements formerly accumulated. One contemplates the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one relishes and delights in that. Based on that, lust associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises. Through telepathy, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. The aggregates associated with pleasant feeling are a condition by way of object condition for telepathy, past-life recollection knowledge, knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and advertence. Based on aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise. (3)

40. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena [V 1.0348] paccayo – dosaṃ ārabbha doso uppajjati, moho uppajjati; dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ mohaṃ ārabbha moho uppajjati, doso uppajjati; dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ ārabbha [M 1.0308] doso uppajjati, moho uppajjati; dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

40. A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of object condition: based on hatred, hatred arises, delusion arises; based on delusion associated with painful feeling, delusion arises, hatred arises; based on body-consciousness accompanied by painful feeling, hatred arises, delusion arises; based on aggregates associated with painful feeling, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (1)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of object condition: noble ones, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, reflect on the defilements associated with painful feeling that have been abandoned, reflect on the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements previously accumulated. With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one contemplates the aggregates associated with painful feeling as impermanent, as suffering, as non-self; based on aggregates associated with painful feeling, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (2)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte [T 1.0377] pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; cetopariyañāṇena dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of object condition: noble ones, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, reflect on the defilements associated with painful feeling that have been abandoned, reflect on the defilements that have been suppressed, and know the defilements previously accumulated. With a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one contemplates the aggregates associated with painful feeling as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. Through telepathy, one knows the mind of one endowed with a mind associated with painful feeling. The aggregates associated with painful feeling are a condition by way of object condition for telepathy, past-life recollection knowledge, knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their actions, knowledge of the future, and advertence. Based on aggregates associated with painful feeling, aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise. (3)

41. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati; ariyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese [V 1.0349] paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena [M 1.0309] cittena [T 1.0378] aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati; cetopariyañāṇena adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (1)

41. A phenomenon associated with neutral feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neutral feeling by way of the object condition. Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with neutral feeling, one reviews it with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with neutral feeling, one reviews them with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Noble Ones, with a mind associated with neutral feeling, review the abandoned and suppressed defilements associated with neutral feeling, and know the defilements previously accumulated. With a mind associated with neutral feeling, one contemplates the aggregates associated with neutral feeling as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one savors them and delights in them. Taking them as object, lust associated with neutral feeling arises, views arise, doubt arises, and restlessness arises. Through mind-reading knowledge, one knows the mind of a person endowed with a mind associated with neutral feeling. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness by way of the object condition. The base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of the object condition. The aggregates associated with neutral feeling are a condition for advertence to the knowledge of psychic powers, mind-reading knowledge, past-life recollection knowledge, knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings, and knowledge of the future by way of the object condition. Taking the aggregates associated with neutral feeling as object, aggregates associated with neutral feeling arise. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena paccavekkhati. Ariyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti[T 1.0379], vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (2)

A phenomenon associated with neutral feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of the object condition. Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with neutral feeling, one reviews it with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with neutral feeling, one reviews them with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Noble Ones, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, review the abandoned and suppressed defilements associated with neutral feeling, and know the defilements previously accumulated. With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one contemplates the aggregates associated with neutral feeling as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; one savors them and delights in them. Taking them as object, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, and views arise; taking the aggregates associated with neutral feeling as object, aggregates associated with pleasant feeling arise. (2)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya [V 1.0350] sampayutte jhāne parihīne vippaṭisārissa domanassaṃ uppajjati, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe ārabbha dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti. (3)

A phenomenon associated with neutral feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of the object condition. Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with neutral feeling, sorrow arises for one who is regretful. When a jhāna associated with neutral feeling has fallen away, sorrow arises for one who is regretful. Taking the aggregates associated with neutral feeling as object, aggregates associated with painful feeling arise. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

The Dominance Condition

42. Sukhāya [M 1.0310] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati.

42. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of the dominance condition: object dominance, co-nascence dominance.

Ārammaṇādhipati – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā [T 1.0380] sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

Object dominance: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it, making it weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews them, making them weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. One savors and delights in the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, making them weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Making them weighty, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, and views arise.

Sahajātādhipati – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Co-nascence dominance: Dominance associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the dominance condition. (1)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neutral feeling by way of the dominance condition.

Ārammaṇādhipati – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

Object dominance: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews it, making it weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with pleasant feeling, one reviews them, making them weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. One savors and delights in the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, making them weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Making them weighty, lust associated with neutral feeling arises, wrong view arises. (2)

43. Dukkhāya [V 1.0351] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo.

43. A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of dominance condition.

Sahajātādhipati – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena [T 1.0381] paccayo. (1)

Conascence dominance: Dominance associated with painful feeling is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

44. Adukkhamasukhāya [M 1.0311] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati.

44. A phenomenon associated with neutral feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neutral feeling by way of dominance condition: object dominance, conascence dominance.

Ārammaṇādhipati – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.

Object dominance: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with neutral feeling, one reviews it, making it weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with neutral feeling, one reviews them, making them weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. One savors and delights in the aggregates associated with neutral feeling, making them weighty, with a mind associated with neutral feeling. Making them weighty, lust associated with neutral feeling arises, wrong view arises.

Sahajātādhipati – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Conascence dominance: Dominance associated with neutral feeling is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon associated with neutral feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of dominance condition.

Ārammaṇādhipati – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, phalā vuṭṭhahitvā [T 1.0382] sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutte khandhe sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena garuṃ katvā assādeti [V 1.0352] abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

Object dominance: Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance with a mind associated with neutral feeling, one reviews it, making it weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Having emerged from jhānas, paths, or fruits associated with neutral feeling, one reviews them, making them weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. One savors and delights in the aggregates associated with neutral feeling, making them weighty, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling. Making them weighty, lust associated with pleasant feeling arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

45. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ [M 1.0312] anulomaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo, anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulomaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

45. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition – preceding aggregates associated with pleasant feeling are a condition for succeeding aggregates associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition. Adaptation associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for change-of-lineage associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition, adaptation for purification… change-of-lineage for the path… purification for the path… the path for fruition… fruition for fruition… adaptation is a condition for the attainment of fruition associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition. The aggregates associated with pleasant feeling are a condition for emergence associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ cuticittaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ [T 1.0383] vipākamanodhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ kusalākusalaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neutral feeling by way of contiguity condition – the death-consciousness associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the rebirth-linking consciousness associated with neutral feeling by way of contiguity condition. The life-continuum associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for adverting by way of contiguity condition. Body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition for the resultant mind-element by way of contiguity condition. The resultant mind-consciousness-element associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the functional mind-consciousness-element by way of contiguity condition. The life-continuum associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the life-continuum associated with neutral feeling by way of contiguity condition. A wholesome or unwholesome state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for emergence associated with neutral feeling by way of contiguity condition… a functional state for emergence… a fruition state for emergence. (2)

46. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

46. A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of contiguity condition – preceding aggregates associated with painful feeling are a condition for succeeding aggregates associated with painful feeling by way of contiguity condition. (1)

Dukkhāya [V 1.0353] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ vipākamanodhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition – body-consciousness accompanied by painful feeling is a condition for the resultant mind-element by way of immediately proximate condition. The aggregates associated with painful feeling are conditions for emergence associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. (2)

47. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena [T 1.0384] paccayo[M 1.0313]. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ anulomaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa gotrabhussa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

47. A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition – the preceding aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are conditions for the succeeding aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. The adaptation associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for the change-of-lineage associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. Adaptation for purification… change-of-lineage for the path… purification for the path… the path for fruition… fruition for fruition… adaptation for fruition-attainment… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception for one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. The aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are conditions for emergence associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ cuticittaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa upapatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Vipākamanodhātu sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ bhavaṅgaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa bhavaṅgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ kusalākusalaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa vuṭṭhānassa… kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition – the death-consciousness associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for the rebirth-linking consciousness associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. Adverting is a condition for the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. The resultant mind-element is a condition for the resultant mind-consciousness-element associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. The life-continuum associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for the life-continuum associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. A wholesome or unwholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for emergence associated with pleasant feeling… a functional state for emergence… a fruition for emergence… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception for one emerging from cessation is a condition for the attainment of fruition associated with pleasant feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. (2)

Adukkhamasukhāya [T 1.0385] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of immediately proximate condition – adverting is a condition for the aggregates associated with painful feeling by way of immediately proximate condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

48. Sukhāya [V 1.0354] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarapaccayasadisaṃ).

48. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of contiguity condition (similar to the immediately proximate condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

49. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto [M 1.0314] eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

49. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of co-nascence condition. One aggregate associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. (1)

50. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttapaṭisandhi na labbhati.) (1)

50. A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of co-nascence condition. One aggregate associated with painful feeling is a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. (Rebirth-linking associated with painful feeling does not occur.) (1)

51. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – adukkhamasukhāya [T 1.0386] vedanāya sampayutto eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto eko khandho dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

51. A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of co-nascence condition. One aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one aggregate associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for two aggregates by way of co-nascence condition. Two aggregates are a condition for one aggregate by way of co-nascence condition. (1)

Aññamañña-nissayapaccayā

Mutual and Support Conditions

52. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo (aññamaññampi nissayampi sahajātapaccayasadisaṃ).

52. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of mutual condition... by way of support condition. (The mutual condition and the support condition are similar to the co-nascence condition.)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

53. Sukhāya [V 1.0355] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

53. A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, immediate decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ [M 1.0315] uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti (saddhāpañcamakesu “mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhātī”ti kātabbaṃ, avasesesu [T 1.0387] na kātabbaṃ). Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa… sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses attainment, boasts with conceit, or grasps a view. Relying on virtue... learning... generosity... wisdom... lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms... arouses attainment (in the case of the five beginning with faith, "boasts with conceit, grasps a view" should be included; in the remaining cases, it should not). With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks divisively, indulges in idle chatter, breaks into houses, commits robbery, plunders, lies in wait on highways, commits adultery, destroys villages, or destroys towns. Faith associated with pleasant feeling... virtue... learning... generosity... wisdom... lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition for faith associated with pleasant feeling... for virtue... for learning... for generosity... for wisdom... for lust... for delusion... for conceit... for a view... for aspiration... for body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure... and for the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati[V 1.0356], pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe [T 1.0388] tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti, mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeti, duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeti, saṅghaṃ bhindati. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ dosassa… mohassa… dukkhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa… dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with pleasant feeling, one torments and afflicts oneself, and experiences suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on virtue... learning... generosity... wisdom associated with pleasant feeling, one torments and afflicts oneself, and experiences suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, one kills living beings. With a mind associated with painful feeling, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks divisively, speaks harshly, engages in idle chatter, breaks into houses, commits robbery, commits burglary, lies in ambush, commits adultery, destroys villages, destroys towns, deprives one’s mother of life, deprives one’s father of life, deprives an arahant of life, with a malevolent mind draws blood from the Tathāgata, or causes schism in the Sangha. Faith associated with pleasant feeling... virtue... learning... generosity... wisdom... lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition for hatred... for delusion... for body-consciousness accompanied by suffering... and for the aggregates associated with painful feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Sukhāya [M 1.0316] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximity decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati[T 1.0389], musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati (sī. syā.), sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā… sukhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya… adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms, undertakes virtue, observes the Uposatha, arouses jhāna, arouses insight, arouses the path, arouses direct knowledge, arouses attainment, boasts with conceit, or grasps a view. Relying on virtue associated with pleasant feeling... learning... generosity... wisdom... lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms... arouses attainment. With a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given, speaks falsely, speaks divisively, engages in idle chatter, breaks into houses, commits robbery, commits burglary, lies in ambush, commits adultery, destroys villages, or destroys towns. Faith associated with pleasant feeling... virtue... learning... generosity... wisdom... lust... delusion... conceit... view... aspiration... or body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure is a condition for faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling... for virtue... for learning... for generosity... for wisdom... for lust... for delusion... for conceit... for a view... for aspiration... and for the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (3)

54. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

54. A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of decisive support condition—proximity decisive support, natural decisive support... and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0357] – dosaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Mohaṃ, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Doso… moho… dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ dosassa… mohassa… dukkhasahagatassa [M 1.0317] kāyaviññāṇassa… dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Natural decisive support—relying on hatred, one kills a living being; with a mind associated with painful feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one causes schism in the Sangha. Relying on delusion, or body-consciousness accompanied by suffering, one kills a living being; with a mind associated with painful feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one causes schism in the Sangha. Hatred… delusion… body-consciousness accompanied by suffering are a condition for hatred… delusion… body-consciousness accompanied by suffering, and for the aggregates associated with painful feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition.

Pakatūpanissayo – dosaṃ [T 1.0390] upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Mohaṃ, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Doso… moho… dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya…pe… sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural decisive support—relying on hatred, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one attains meditative absorption. With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one commits village destruction. Relying on delusion, or body-consciousness accompanied by suffering, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one commits village destruction. Hatred… delusion… body-consciousness accompanied by suffering are a condition for faith associated with pleasant feeling… and so on… for body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, and for the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A phenomenon associated with painful feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition—proximate decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – dosaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Mohaṃ, dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Doso… moho… dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support—relying on hatred, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one commits village destruction. Relying on delusion, or body-consciousness accompanied by suffering, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one commits village destruction. Hatred… delusion… body-consciousness accompanied by suffering are a condition for faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling… and so on… for aspiration, and for the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (3)

55. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa [V 1.0358] upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo[T 1.0391], anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

55. A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximate decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya [M 1.0318] sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā… adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one adopts a view. Relying on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one attains meditative absorption. With a mind associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one commits village destruction. Faith… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for faith… and so on… for aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, and for the aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling by way of decisive support condition—object decisive support, proximate decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena [T 1.0392] adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… nigamaghātaṃ karoti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā…pe… patthanā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttāya saddhāya…pe… patthanāya… sukhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one adopts a view. Relying on virtue… and so on… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, with a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one gives alms… and so on… one attains meditative absorption. With a mind associated with pleasant feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one commits village destruction. Faith… and so on… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for faith… and so on… for aspiration associated with pleasant feeling, for body-consciousness accompanied by pleasure, and for the aggregates associated with pleasant feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a phenomenon associated with painful feeling by way of decisive support condition—proximate decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti [V 1.0359] paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ sīlaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttena cittena adinnaṃ ādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā saddhā…pe… patthanā… dosassa… mohassa… dukkhasahagatassa kāyaviññāṇassa… dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support—relying on faith associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one torments and afflicts oneself, experiencing suffering rooted in searching. Relying on virtue… and so on… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, one kills a living being. With a mind associated with painful feeling, one takes what is not given… and so on… one splits the Sangha. Faith… and so on… aspiration associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for hatred… delusion… body-consciousness accompanied by suffering, and for the aggregates associated with painful feeling, by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

56. Sukhāya [M 1.0319] vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu [T 1.0393] maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

56. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates associated with pleasant feeling are a condition for the succeeding aggregates associated with pleasant feeling by way of repetition condition. Conformity associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification; change-of-lineage is a condition for the path; and purification is a condition for the path, by way of repetition condition. (1)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates associated with painful feeling are a condition for the succeeding aggregates associated with painful feeling by way of repetition condition. (1)

Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of repetition condition. The preceding aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling are a condition for the succeeding aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of repetition condition. Conformity associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification; change-of-lineage is a condition for the path; and purification is a condition for the path, by way of repetition condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

57. Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā nānākhaṇikā (ka.). Sahajātā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

57. A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition—simultaneously and at different times. Simultaneously—volition associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on. At different times—volition associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the resultant aggregates associated with pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition. (1)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā [V 1.0360] – sukhāya vedanāya [T 1.0394] sampayuttā cetanā [M 1.0320] vipākānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of kamma condition. At different times—volition associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the resultant aggregates associated with painful feeling by way of kamma condition. (2)

Sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A state associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition. At different times—volition associated with pleasant feeling is a condition for the resultant aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition. (3)

58. Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

58. A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with painful feeling by way of kamma condition—simultaneously and at different times. Simultaneously—volition associated with painful feeling is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. At different times—volition associated with painful feeling is a condition for the resultant aggregates associated with painful feeling by way of kamma condition. (1)

Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A state associated with painful feeling is a condition for a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition. At different times—volition associated with painful feeling is a condition for the resultant aggregates associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of kamma condition. (2)

59. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Nānākkhaṇikā [T 1.0395] – adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)
