Noavigatapaccayā [V 1.0376] nahetupaccayā…pe… nanissayapaccayā napurejātapaccayā…pe… nakammapaccayā…pe… [T 1.0409] novigatapaccayā upanissaye nava.

Not by non-disappearance condition, not by root condition... not by dependence condition, not by pre-nascence condition... not by kamma condition... not by disappearance condition: in decisive dependence, nine.

(Yathā kusalattikassa paccanīyānulomagaṇanā sajjhāyamaggena gaṇitā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the reverse-direct enumeration of the wholesome triad was calculated by the method of recitation, so should it be calculated here.)

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Reverse-Direct Order

Vedanāttikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Feeling Triad is concluded.

3. Vipākattikaṃ

3. The Resultant Triad

1. Paṭiccavāro

1. The Section on Conditions

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Direct Order of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

1. Vipākaṃ [T 1.0410][V 1.0377][M 1.0334] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

1. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of relinking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipāke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on resultant aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of relinking, in dependence on resultant aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises, and in dependence on aggregates, the base arises. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (3)

Resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor result-producing arise in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of relinking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise. (3)

2. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ [V 1.0378] paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

2. A result-producing phenomenon arises in dependence on a result-producing phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on one result-producing aggregate, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing arises in dependence on a result-producing phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on result-producing aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0411] ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Result-producing phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor result-producing arise in dependence on a result-producing phenomenon by way of root condition: in dependence on one result-producing aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. (3)

3. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

3. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing arises in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: in dependence on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor result-producing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on two great elements, two great elements arise; in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [M 1.0335] paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: at the moment of relinking, in dependence on the base, resultant aggregates arise. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor result-producing arise in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: at the moment of relinking, in dependence on the base, resultant aggregates arise; and in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

4. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

4. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: at the moment of relinking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati [V 1.0379] hetupaccayā [T 1.0412] – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: in dependence on resultant aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of relinking, in dependence on resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (2)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor result-producing arise in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: at the moment of relinking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate and the base, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates and the base, two aggregates arise; and in dependence on resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

5. Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

5. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing arises in dependence on a result-producing phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by way of root condition: in dependence on result-producing aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

6. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

6. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of object condition: three aggregates arise in dependence on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates arise in dependence on two aggregates; at the moment of relinking, three aggregates arise in dependence on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates arise in dependence on two aggregates. (1)

7. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

7. A result-producing phenomenon arises in dependence on a result-producing phenomenon by way of object condition: three aggregates arise in dependence on one result-producing aggregate... two aggregates arise in dependence on two aggregates. (1)

8. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā[T 1.0413]. (1)

8. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of object condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [M 1.0336] paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the resultant aggregates arise dependent on the physical base. (2)

9. Vipākañca [V 1.0380] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

9. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of object condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant aggregate and the physical base... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates and the physical base. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

10. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

10. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates. (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipāke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: mind-originated material form arises dependent on resultant aggregates. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of dominance condition: three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise dependent on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise dependent on two aggregates. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca tīṇi.

Dependent on a resultant-producing phenomenon, three [cases].

11. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ[T 1.0414]. (1)

11. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of dominance condition: three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing... two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise dependent on two aggregates; three great elements arise dependent on one great element... mind-originated material form and derived material form arise dependent on the great elements. (1)

12. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

12. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of dominance condition: mind-originated material form arises dependent on resultant aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a resultant-producing phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of dominance condition: mind-originated material form arises dependent on the resultant-producing aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Anantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, and so on.

13. Vipākaṃ [V 1.0381][M 1.0337] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati anantarapaccayā… samanantarapaccayā… (ārammaṇapaccayasadisaṃ) sahajātapaccayā… (sahajātaṃ sabbaṃ hetupaccayasadisaṃ).

13. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of proximity condition... by way of contiguity condition... (similar to object condition)... by way of co-nascence condition... (all [cases of] co-nascence are similar to the root condition).

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati sahajātapaccayā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ (sahajāte idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ).

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of co-nascence condition... externally... nutriment-originated [material form]... temperature-originated [material form]... for non-percipient beings (in co-nascence, this is the distinction).

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutuality Condition

14. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

14. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of mutuality condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates. (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base arises dependent on the resultant aggregates. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti [T 1.0415] aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā vatthu ca…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā vatthu ca. (3)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates and the physical base arise dependent on one resultant aggregate... two aggregates and the physical base arise dependent on two aggregates. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A resultant-producing phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of mutuality condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant-producing aggregate... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates. (1)

15. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… ekaṃ [V 1.0382] mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

15. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of mutuality condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing... one great element... externally... nutriment-originated [material form]... temperature-originated [material form]... for non-percipient beings, one great element... (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the resultant aggregates arise dependent on the physical base. (2)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant aggregate and the physical base... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates and the physical base. (1)

Nissayapaccayādi

Dependence Condition, etc.

16. Vipākaṃ [M 1.0338] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati nissayapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… upanissayapaccayā… purejātapaccayā.

16. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon by way of dependence condition (in brief)... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition.

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

17. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve [T 1.0416] khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā.

17. A resultant-producing phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of repetition condition: three aggregates arise dependent on one resultant-producing aggregate... two aggregates arise dependent on two aggregates.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Repetition Condition. One aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing conditions three aggregates... two aggregates condition two aggregates.

Kamma-vipākapaccayā

By way of Kamma and Result Conditions

18. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati kammapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… vipākapaccayā… tīṇi.

18. In dependence on a resultant phenomenon, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of Kamma Condition (in brief)... by way of Result Condition... three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [V 1.0383] paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

In dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing, a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises by way of Result Condition. In dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

In dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of Result Condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on the physical base, the resultant aggregates arise. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti vipākapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

In dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing, both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise by way of Result Condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on the physical base, the resultant aggregates arise; in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā…pe… nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati vipākapaccayā. Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti vipākapaccayā…pe….

In dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of Result Condition... a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises by way of Result Condition. Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise by way of Result Condition...

Āhārapaccayādi

By way of Nutriment Condition, etc.

19. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati āhārapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ)… indriyapaccayā… jhānapaccayā… maggapaccayā… sampayuttapaccayā [T 1.0417]… vippayuttapaccayā… atthipaccayā… natthipaccayā… vigatapaccayā… avigatapaccayā.

19. In dependence on a resultant phenomenon, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of Nutriment Condition (in brief)... by way of Faculty Condition... by way of Jhāna Condition... by way of Path Condition... by way of Association Condition... by way of Dissociation Condition... by way of Presence Condition... by way of Absence Condition... by way of Disappearance Condition... by way of Non-Disappearance Condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Positive Exposition of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Enumeration Chapter

Suddhaṃ

The Pure Section

20. Hetuyā [M 1.0339] terasa, ārammaṇe pañca, adhipatiyā nava, anantare pañca, samanantare pañca, sahajāte terasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye terasa, upanissaye pañca, purejāte tīṇi[V 1.0384], āsevane dve, kamme terasa, vipāke nava, āhāre terasa, indriye terasa, jhāne terasa, magge terasa, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte terasa, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā pañca, vigate pañca, avigate terasa.

20. In Root Condition, thirteen; in Object, five; in Dominance, nine; in Contiguity, five; in Immediate Contiguity, five; in Co-nascence, thirteen; in Reciprocity, seven; in Dependence, thirteen; in Strong-Dependence, five; in Pre-nascence, three; in Repetition, two; in Kamma, thirteen; in Result, nine; in Nutriment, thirteen; in Faculty, thirteen; in Jhāna, thirteen; in Path, thirteen; in Association, five; in Dissociation, thirteen; in Presence, thirteen; in Absence, five; in Disappearance, five; in Non-Disappearance, thirteen.

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

21. Hetupaccayā ārammaṇe pañca…pe… avigate terasa…pe….

21. By way of Root Condition: in Object, five... in Non-Disappearance, thirteen...

(Yathā kusalattikassa gaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(The enumeration should be done as for the Wholesome Triplet.)

Āsevanadukaṃ

The Repetition Dyad

22. Āsevanapaccayā hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā dve, anantare dve, samanantare dve, sahajāte dve, aññamaññe dve, nissaye dve, upanissaye dve, purejāte dve, kamme dve, āhāre dve, indriye dve, jhāne dve, magge dve, sampayutte dve, vippayutte dve, atthiyā dve, natthiyā dve, vigate dve, avigate dve…pe….

22. By way of Repetition Condition: in Root, two; in Object, two; in Dominance, two; in Contiguity, two; in Immediate Contiguity, two; in Co-nascence, two; in Reciprocity, two; in Dependence, two; in Strong-Dependence, two; in Pre-nascence, two; in Kamma, two; in Nutriment, two; in Faculty, two; in Jhāna, two; in Path, two; in Association, two; in Dissociation, two; in Presence, two; in Absence, two; in Disappearance, two; in Non-Disappearance, two...

Vipākadukaṃ

The Resultant Dyad

23. Vipākapaccayā hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe cha, nissaye nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte ekaṃ, kamme nava, āhāre [T 1.0418] nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava (saṃkhittaṃ).

23. By way of Result Condition: in Root, nine; in Object, three; in Dominance, five; in Contiguity, three; in Immediate Contiguity, three; in Co-nascence, nine; in Reciprocity, six; in Dependence, nine; in Strong-Dependence, three; in Pre-nascence, one; in Kamma, nine; in Nutriment, nine; in Faculty, nine; in Jhāna, nine; in Path, nine; in Association, three; in Dissociation, nine; in Presence, nine; in Absence, three; in Disappearance, three; in Non-Disappearance, nine (in brief).

Anulomagaṇanā.

The Positive Enumeration.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Exposition of Conditions

1. Vibhaṅgavāro

1. The Chapter of Analysis

Nahetupaccayo

By way of Non-Root Condition

24. Vipākaṃ [V 1.0385][M 1.0340] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paṭicca eko khandho, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

24. In dependence on a resultant phenomenon, a resultant phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on one rootless resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise; in dependence on three aggregates, one aggregate arises; in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke vipāke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (2)

In dependence on a resultant phenomenon, a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on rootless resultant aggregates, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on resultant aggregates, kamma-originated materiality arises; in dependence on the aggregates, the physical base arises. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (3)

In dependence on a resultant phenomenon, both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on one rootless resultant aggregate, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality arise. (3)

25. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

25. In dependence on a resultant-producing phenomenon, a resultant-producing phenomenon arises by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [T 1.0419] paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… dve mahābhūte paṭicca dve mahābhūtā, mahābhūte paṭicca [V 1.0386] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on one rootless aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise; in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on two great elements, two great elements arise; in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise; external... food-originated... temperature-originated... for non-percipient beings, in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on the physical base, the resultant aggregates arise. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [M 1.0341] paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on the physical base, the resultant aggregates arise; in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

26. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

26. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0420] rūpaṃ; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. In dependence on the rootless resultant aggregates and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on the resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (2)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā, vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arise in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Root Condition. At the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise; and in dependence on the resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-originated materiality arises. (3)

Naārammaṇapaccayo

Non-Object Condition

27. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā [V 1.0387] – vipāke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ, khandhe paṭicca vatthu. (1)

27. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of Non-Object Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant aggregates, and the physical base arises in dependence on the aggregates. (1)

28. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

28. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of Non-Object Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant-producing aggregates. (1)

29. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

29. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Object Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the aggregates that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing; in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise; external... food-originated... temperature-originated... for non-percipient beings, in dependence on one great element, three great elements arise... in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

30. Vipākañca [T 1.0421][M 1.0342] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (1)

30. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Object Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant aggregates and the great elements; at the moment of rebirth-linking, kamma-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant aggregates and the great elements. (1)

31. Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naārammaṇapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

31. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant-producing phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Non-Object Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant-producing aggregates and the great elements. (1)

Naadhipatipaccayo

Non-Dominance Condition

32. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ. Yathā anulomaṃ sahajātasadisaṃ.)

32. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of Non-Dominance Condition. (In brief. As in the positive enumeration, similar to the conascence section.)

Naanantarapaccayādi

Non-Contiguity Condition, etc.

33. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naanantarapaccayā [V 1.0388]… nasamanantarapaccayā… naaññamaññapaccayā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ, asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ (idaṃ nānattaṃ) naaññamaññapaccayā… naupanissayapaccayā… (saṃkhittaṃ).

33. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of Non-Contiguity Condition... by way of Non-Immediate Contiguity Condition... by way of Non-Mutuality Condition... in dependence on the great elements, mind-originated materiality, kamma-originated materiality, and derived materiality arise; external... food-originated... temperature-originated... for non-percipient beings, in dependence on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise (this is the difference); by way of Non-Mutuality Condition... by way of Non-Decisive Support Condition... (in brief).

Napurejātapaccayo

Non-Prenascence Condition

34. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

34. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of Non-Prenascence Condition: in the immaterial realm, in dependence on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates arise... in dependence on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, in dependence on one resultant aggregate... (in brief). (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – vipāke khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ[T 1.0422], paṭisandhikkhaṇe (saṃkhittaṃ). (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by way of Non-Prenascence Condition: mind-originated materiality arises in dependence on the resultant aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking... (in brief). (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. (3)

Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arise dependent on a resultant phenomenon, by the non-prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-born material form arise... (etc.)... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-born material form arise. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ [M 1.0343] paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

A kamma-producing phenomenon arises dependent on a kamma-producing phenomenon, by the non-prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one kamma-producing aggregate, three aggregates arise... (etc.)... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arises dependent on a kamma-producing phenomenon, by the non-prenascence condition: dependent on the kamma-producing aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. (2)

35. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – arūpe nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ [V 1.0389] rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe…. (1)

35. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: in the immaterial realm, dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, three aggregates arise... (etc.)... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise; dependent on the aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing, mind-produced material form arises; dependent on one great element, three great elements arise... (etc.)... external... nutriment-produced... temperature-produced... for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element... (etc.). (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā. (2)

A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, resultant aggregates arise. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe [T 1.0423] vatthuṃ paṭicca vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arise dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the physical base, resultant aggregates arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-born material form arises. (3)

36. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

36. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... (etc.)... dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: dependent on the resultant aggregates and the great elements, mind-produced material form arises; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on the resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-born material form arises. (2)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paṭicca dve khandhā; vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

Both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arise dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the physical base, three aggregates arise... (etc.)... dependent on two aggregates and the physical base, two aggregates arise; dependent on the resultant aggregates and the great elements, kamma-born material form arises. (3)

37. Vipākadhammadhammañca [M 1.0344] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ.

37. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing arises dependent on a kamma-producing phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing, by the non-prenascence condition: dependent on the kamma-producing aggregates and the great elements, mind-produced material form arises.

Napacchājātapaccayādi

Not by the post-nascence condition, etc.

38. Vipākaṃ [V 1.0390] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā…pe… naāsevanapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

38. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by the post-nascence condition… (etc.) … not by the repetition condition (in brief).

Nakammapaccayo

The Non-Kamma Condition

39. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe [T 1.0424] paṭicca vipākadhammadhammā cetanā.

39. A phenomenon productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by the kamma condition: dependent on aggregates productive of result, volition productive of result arises.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā cetanā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by the kamma condition: dependent on aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result, volition that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises; external… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… dependent on one great element, three great elements arise… (etc.) …dependent on the great elements, derived material form arises.

Navipākapaccayo

The Non-Resultant Condition

40. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

40. A phenomenon productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by the resultant condition: dependent on one aggregate productive of result, three aggregates arise… (etc.) …dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by the resultant condition: dependent on aggregates productive of result, mind-produced material form arises. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti navipākapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arise dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by the resultant condition: dependent on one aggregate productive of result, three aggregates and mind-produced material form arise… (etc.) …dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form arise. (3)

41. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca [V 1.0391] rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ[T 1.0425]; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ [M 1.0345] mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

41. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the result condition—dependent on one aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result, three aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated materiality arise. Dependent on one great element, three great elements arise…pe… dependent on the great elements, mind-originated materiality and derived materiality arise; external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise…pe… dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the result condition—dependent on aggregates productive of result and the great elements, mind-originated materiality arises. (1)

Naāhārapaccayo

The non-nutriment condition

42. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naāhārapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

42. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the nutriment condition—external… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements arise…pe… dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality arise.

Naindriyapaccayo

The non-faculty condition

43. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati naindriyapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ.

43. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the faculty condition—external… food-originated… temperature-originated—dependent on one great element, three great elements arise…pe… for non-percipient beings, dependent on the great elements, the material life faculty arises.

Najhānapaccayo

The non-jhāna condition

44. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā.

44. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by way of the jhāna condition—dependent on one aggregate accompanied by fivefold consciousness, three aggregates arise…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates arise.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati najhānapaccayā – bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe….

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the jhāna condition—external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element…pe….

Namaggapaccayo

The non-path condition

45. Vipākaṃ [T 1.0426][V 1.0392] dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

45. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by way of the path condition—dependent on one rootless resultant aggregate… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca… tīṇi.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the path condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result… three.

Vipākañca [M 1.0346] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati namaggapaccayā – ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paṭicca… tīṇi.

A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the path condition—at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one resultant aggregate and the physical base… three.

Nasampayuttapaccayo

The non-concomitant condition

46. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nasampayuttapaccayā… dve.

46. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by way of the concomitant condition… two.

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nasampayuttapaccayā… dve.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by way of the concomitant condition… two.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca… ekaṃ.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result… one.

Navippayuttapaccayo

The non-dissociation condition

47. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vipāke ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā.

47. A resultant phenomenon arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by way of the dissociation condition—in immaterial resultants, dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates.

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā – arūpe vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā.

A phenomenon productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon productive of result, not by way of the dissociation condition—in immaterial phenomena productive of result, dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati navippayuttapaccayā [V 1.0393] – arūpe nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [T 1.0427] ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā; bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result, not by way of the dissociation condition—in immaterial phenomena that are neither resultant nor productive of result, dependent on one aggregate, three aggregates…pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates; external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element, three great elements…pe… dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality and derived materiality.

Nonatthi-novigatapaccayā

The non-presence and non-disappearance conditions

48. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nonatthipaccayā… novigatapaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).

48. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result arises dependent on a resultant phenomenon, not by way of the presence condition… not by way of the disappearance condition (in brief).

Suddhaṃ

The Pure

49. Nahetuyā dasa, naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā terasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte [M 1.0347] dvādasa, napacchājāte terasa, naāsevane terasa, nakamme dve, navipāke pañca, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne dve, namagge nava, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca.

49. By way of non-root condition, ten; by way of non-object condition, five; by way of non-dominance condition, thirteen; by way of non-contiguity condition, five; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, five; by way of non-mutuality condition, five; by way of non-strong dependence condition, five; by way of non-pre-nascence condition, twelve; by way of non-post-nascence condition, thirteen; by way of non-repetition condition, thirteen; by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-result condition, five; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, two; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-concomitant condition, five; by way of non-dissociation condition, three; by way of non-presence condition, five; by way of non-disappearance condition, five.

Nahetudukaṃ

The Dyad of Non-Root Condition

50. Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇe tīṇi, naadhipatiyā dasa, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye tīṇi, napurejāte dasa, napacchājāte dasa, naāsevane dasa, nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke dve, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne dve, namagge nava, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte dve, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.

50. By way of non-root condition: by way of non-object condition, three; by way of non-dominance condition, ten; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, three; by way of non-mutuality condition, three; by way of non-strong dependence condition, three; by way of non-pre-nascence condition, ten; by way of non-post-nascence condition, ten; by way of non-repetition condition, ten; by way of non-kamma condition, one; by way of non-result condition, two; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, two; by way of non-path condition, nine; by way of non-concomitant condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, two; by way of non-presence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three.

Tikaṃ

The Triad

Nahetupaccayā [V 1.0394] naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatiyā tīṇi, naanantare tīṇi, nasamanantare tīṇi…pe… nakamme ekaṃ, navipāke ekaṃ, naāhāre ekaṃ, naindriye ekaṃ, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ, nonatthiyā tīṇi, novigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

By way of non-root condition, non-object condition, and non-dominance condition, three; by way of non-contiguity condition, three; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, three… and so on… by way of non-kamma condition, one; by way of non-resultant condition, one; by way of non-nutriment condition, one; by way of non-faculty condition, one; by way of non-jhāna condition, one; by way of non-path condition, three; by way of non-association condition, three; by way of non-dissociation condition, one; by way of non-absence condition, three; by way of non-disappearance condition, three (in brief).

Nahetumūlakaṃ.

The Non-Root-Based

(Yathā [T 1.0428] kusalattike sajjhāyamaggena gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ idhāpi gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration was calculated in the wholesome triad by the method of recitation, so too should it be calculated here.)

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

51. Hetupaccayā naārammaṇe pañca, naadhipatiyā terasa, naanantare pañca, nasamanantare pañca, naaññamaññe pañca, naupanissaye pañca, napurejāte dvādasa, napacchājāte terasa, naāsevane terasa, nakamme dve, navipāke [M 1.0348] pañca, nasampayutte pañca, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā pañca, novigate pañca.

51. By way of root condition and non-object condition, five; by way of non-dominance condition, thirteen; by way of non-contiguity condition, five; by way of non-immediate contiguity condition, five; by way of non-mutuality condition, five; by way of non-strong dependence condition, five; by way of non-prenascence condition, twelve; by way of non-postnascence condition, thirteen; by way of non-repetition condition, thirteen; by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-resultant condition, five; by way of non-association condition, five; by way of non-dissociation condition, three; by way of non-absence condition, five; by way of non-disappearance condition, five.

Tikaṃ

The Triad

Hetupaccayā ārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatiyā pañca, napurejāte pañca, napacchājāte pañca, naāsevane pañca, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, navippayutte tīṇi.

By way of root condition, object condition, and non-dominance condition, five; by way of non-prenascence condition, five; by way of non-postnascence condition, five; by way of non-repetition condition, five; by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-resultant condition, two; by way of non-dissociation condition, three.

Catukkaṃ

The Tetrad

Hetupaccayā [V 1.0395] ārammaṇapaccayā adhipatipaccayā napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, navippayutte tīṇi…pe….

By way of root condition, object condition, dominance condition, and non-prenascence condition, three; by way of non-postnascence condition, three; by way of non-repetition condition, three; by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-resultant condition, two; by way of non-dissociation condition, three… and so on…

Ekādasakaṃ

The Elevenfold

Hetupaccayā ārammaṇapaccayā adhipatipaccayā anantarapaccayā (mūlakaṃ saṃkhittaṃ) purejātapaccayā napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve (saṃkhittaṃ).

By way of root condition, object condition, dominance condition, contiguity condition (the root, in brief), and by way of prenascence condition, there are: by way of non-postnascence condition, three; by way of non-repetition condition, three; by way of non-kamma condition, two; by way of non-resultant condition, two (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike anulomapaccanīyagaṇanā gaṇitā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration of the affirmative-negative was calculated in the wholesome triad, so too should it be calculated here.)

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative of Conditions

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

52. Nahetupaccayā [T 1.0429] ārammaṇe pañca, anantare pañca, samanantare pañca, sahajāte dasa, aññamaññe satta, nissaye dasa, upanissaye pañca, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme dasa, vipāke nava, āhāre dasa, indriye dasa, jhāne dasa, magge ekaṃ, sampayutte pañca, vippayutte dasa, atthiyā dasa, natthiyā pañca, vigate pañca, avigate dasa.

52. Not by root condition, but by object condition, five; by contiguity, five; by immediate contiguity, five; by conascence, ten; by mutuality, seven; by dependence, ten; by strong dependence, five; by prenascence, three; by repetition, two; by kamma, ten; by resultant, nine; by nutriment, ten; by faculty, ten; by jhāna, ten; by path, one; by association, five; by dissociation, ten; by presence, ten; by absence, five; by disappearance, five; by non-disappearance, ten.

Tikaṃ

The Triad

Nahetupaccayā [M 1.0349] naārammaṇapaccayā sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe dve, nissaye tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, avigate tīṇi…pe….

Not by root condition, not by object condition: by conascence, three; by mutuality, two; by dependence, three; by kamma, three; by resultant, three; by nutriment, three; by faculty, three; by jhāna, three; by dissociation, three; by presence, three; by non-disappearance, three… and so on.

Sattakaṃ

The Heptad

Nahetupaccayā [V 1.0396] naārammaṇapaccayā naadhipatipaccayā naanantarapaccayā nasamanantarapaccayā naaññamaññapaccayā sahajāte tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, vipāke tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, avigate tīṇi (saṃkhittaṃ).

Not by root condition, not by object condition, not by dominance condition, not by contiguity condition, not by immediate contiguity condition, not by mutuality condition: by conascence, three; by dependence, three; by kamma, three; by resultant, three; by nutriment, three; by faculty, three; by jhāna, three; by dissociation, three; by presence, three; by non-disappearance, three (in brief).
