Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition.

58. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

58. A resultant phenomenon arises in dependence on a resultant phenomenon by root condition: one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates, three aggregates are a condition for one aggregate, two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (1)

Vipākaṃ [V 1.0398] dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipāke khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ…pe…. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor result-producing by root condition: resultant aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates are a condition for kamma-originated matter…pe…. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon, which arise by root condition: one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated matter…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [T 1.0431] – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

A result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a result-producing phenomenon by root condition: one result-producing aggregate is a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by root condition: result-producing aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ [M 1.0351] paccayā vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

A result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a result-producing phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon, which arise by root condition: one result-producing aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated matter…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and mind-originated matter. (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (1)

A neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by root condition: one neither-resultant-nor-result-producing aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and mind-originated matter…pe… two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and mind-originated matter; one great element is a condition for…pe… great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter, kamma-originated matter, and derived matter; the physical base is a condition for neither-resultant-nor-result-producing aggregates. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā. (2)

A neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by root condition: the physical base is a condition for resultant aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for resultant aggregates. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (3)

A neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a result-producing phenomenon by root condition: the physical base is a condition for result-producing aggregates. (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti [V 1.0399] hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā[T 1.0432], mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ. (4)

A neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon, which arise by root condition: the physical base is a condition for resultant aggregates, and great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for resultant aggregates, and great elements are a condition for kamma-originated matter. (4)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

A neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for a result-producing phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon, which arise by root condition: the physical base is a condition for result-producing aggregates, and great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter. (5)

59. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

59. A resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are a condition for a resultant phenomenon by root condition: one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates. (1)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0400] uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ. (2)

A resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by root condition: resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-originated matter. (2)

Vipākañca [M 1.0352] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā[T 1.0433], vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā kaṭattārūpaṃ. (3)

A resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are a condition for a resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon, which arise by root condition: one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates, and resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…pe… two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates, and resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-originated matter. (3)

60. Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

60. A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for a phenomenon productive of result by root condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…and so on…two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by root condition: aggregates productive of result and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced material form. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for phenomena productive of result and phenomena that are neither resultant nor productive of result by root condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base are a condition for three aggregates…and so on…two aggregates and the physical base are a condition for two aggregates, aggregates productive of result and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced material form. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

61. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

61. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by object condition: one resultant aggregate conditions three aggregates... two aggregates condition two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking... (1)

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon productive of result conditions a phenomenon productive of result by object condition: one aggregate productive of result conditions three aggregates... two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhamma-dhammo [T 1.0434] uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā, vatthuṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by object condition: one aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions three aggregates... two aggregates condition two aggregates; the physical base conditions the aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ paccayā sotaviññāṇaṃ[M 1.0353], ghānāyatanaṃ paccayā ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ paccayā jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ; vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a resultant phenomenon by object condition: the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness, the ear-base conditions ear-consciousness, the nose-base conditions nose-consciousness, the tongue-base conditions tongue-consciousness, the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions resultant aggregates. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon productive of result by object condition: the physical base conditions aggregates productive of result. (3)

Vipākañca [V 1.0401] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā, sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāya… vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a resultant phenomenon by object condition: one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the eye-base condition two aggregates; ear... nose... tongue... body... one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ [T 1.0435] paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon productive of result by object condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

62. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā… tīṇi (adhipatiyā paṭisandhikkhaṇe natthi).

62. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by dominance condition: a resultant aggregate conditions... three (there is no dominance at rebirth-linking).

Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā… tīṇi.

A phenomenon productive of result conditions... three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: one aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions three aggregates and mind-produced matter... two aggregates condition two aggregates and mind-produced matter; one great element conditions three great elements... the great elements condition mind-produced matter and derived matter; the physical base conditions aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a resultant phenomenon by dominance condition: the physical base conditions resultant aggregates. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon productive of result by dominance condition: the physical base conditions aggregates productive of result. (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [V 1.0402][M 1.0354] paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (4)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: the physical base conditions resultant aggregates; the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (4)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [T 1.0436] paccayā vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā, mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (5)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions phenomena productive of result and phenomena that are neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: the physical base conditions aggregates productive of result; the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (5)

63. Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

63. A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a resultant phenomenon by dominance condition: one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: resultant aggregates and the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (2)

Vipākañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vipāke khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; resultant aggregates and the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (3)

64. Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

64. A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon productive of result by dominance condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0403] uppajjati adhipatipaccayā – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā [T 1.0437] cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: aggregates productive of result and the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti adhipatipaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā, vipākadhammadhamme khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (3)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by dominance condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base condition three aggregates... two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; aggregates productive of result and the great elements condition mind-produced matter. (3)

65. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by proximity condition… by contiguity condition (similar to object condition).

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutuality Condition

66. Sahajātapaccayā…pe… aññamaññapaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

66. By conascence condition… by mutuality condition—one resultant aggregate conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāke khandhe paccayā vatthu. (2)

A resultant phenomenon conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by mutuality condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates condition the physical base. (2)

Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā uppajjanti aññamaññapaccayā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā vatthu ca…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā vatthu ca. (3)

A resultant phenomenon conditions both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by mutuality condition—at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate conditions three aggregates and the physical base… two aggregates condition two aggregates and the physical base. (3)

67. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

67. A phenomenon productive of result conditions a phenomenon productive of result by mutuality condition: one aggregate productive of result conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ [T 1.0438][V 1.0404] paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā, ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paccayā tayo mahābhūtā…pe… dve mahābhūte paccayā dve mahābhūtā; vatthuṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by mutuality condition—one aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions three aggregates… two aggregates condition two aggregates; one great element conditions three great elements… external… nutriment-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element conditions three great elements… two great elements condition two great elements; the physical base conditions the aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ, vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā vipākā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a resultant phenomenon by way of mutuality condition: the eye-base conditions eye-consciousness… the body-base conditions body-consciousness; the physical base conditions resultant aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base conditions resultant aggregates. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result conditions a phenomenon productive of result by way of mutuality condition—the physical base conditions the aggregates productive of result. (3)

Vipākañca [M 1.0356] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipāko dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca cakkhāyatanañca paccayā dve khandhā, sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāya…pe… vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā [T 1.0439] dve khandhā. (1)

A resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a resultant phenomenon by mutuality condition—one aggregate associated with eye-consciousness and the eye-base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the eye-base condition two aggregates; ear… nose… tongue… body… one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammañca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammañca dhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhañca vatthuñca paccayā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe ca vatthuñca paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result condition a phenomenon productive of result by way of mutuality condition: one aggregate productive of result and the physical base condition three aggregates… two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. (1)

70. Vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – vipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe paccayā eko khandho, dve khandhe paccayā dve khandhā. (1)

70. A resultant-producing phenomenon conditions a resultant-producing phenomenon by Repetition Condition: one resultant-producing aggregate conditions three aggregates; three aggregates condition one aggregate; two aggregates condition two aggregates. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe… vatthuṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing conditions a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of Repetition Condition. One aggregate that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing conditions… the physical base conditions the aggregates that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati āsevanapaccayā – vatthuṃ paccayā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing conditions a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of Repetition Condition. The physical base conditions the resultant-producing aggregates. (2)

(1)

A resultant-producing phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing condition a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of Repetition Condition—one resultant-producing aggregate and the physical base condition three aggregates; three aggregates and the physical base condition one aggregate; two aggregates and the physical base condition two aggregates. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā…pe…. (1)

The Root Condition.

83. Vipākaṃ [T 1.0444][V 1.0411] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā. (Saṃkhittaṃ. Sabbāni padāni vitthāretabbāni.)

83. A resultant phenomenon associated with a resultant phenomenon arises by way of root condition—three aggregates associated with one resultant aggregate. (In brief. All terms should be expanded.)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Conditional Affirmative.

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. The Section on Enumeration.

Suddhaṃ

Pure.

84. Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme tīṇi, vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge tīṇi, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā tīṇi, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate tīṇi. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

84. By way of root condition: three; by way of object condition: three; by way of dominance condition: three; by way of contiguity condition: three; by way of immediate contiguity condition: three; by way of co-nascence condition: three; by way of mutuality condition: three; by way of dependence condition: three; by way of decisive support condition: three; by way of pre-nascence condition: three; by way of repetition condition: two; by way of kamma condition: three; by way of result condition: one; by way of nutriment condition: three; by way of faculty condition: three; by way of jhāna condition: three; by way of path condition: three; by way of association condition: three; by way of dissociation condition: three; by way of presence condition: three; by way of absence condition: three; by way of disappearance condition: three; by way of non-disappearance condition: three. (In brief.)

(Yathā kusalattike gaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration in the wholesome triad, so should it be reckoned.)

Anulomaṃ.

The Affirmative.

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Conditional Negative.

85. Vipākaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho vipāko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ vipākaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (Sabbāni padāni vibhajitabbāni.)

85. A resultant phenomenon associated with a resultant phenomenon arises by way of non-root condition—three aggregates associated with one rootless resultant aggregate… two aggregates associated with two aggregates. (All terms should be analyzed.)

86. Nahetuyā [V 1.0412][M 1.0362] tīṇi, na adhipatiyā tīṇi, napurejāte tīṇi, napacchājāte tīṇi, naāsevane tīṇi, nakamme dve, navipāke dve, najhāne ekaṃ, namagge dve, navippayutte tīṇi.

86. By way of non-root condition: three; by way of non-dominance condition: three; by way of non-pre-nascence condition: three; by way of non-post-nascence condition: three; by way of non-repetition condition: three; by way of non-kamma condition: two; by way of non-result condition: two; by way of non-jhāna condition: one; by way of non-path condition: two; by way of non-dissociation condition: three.

87. Hetupaccayā [T 1.0445] naadhipatiyā tīṇi…pe… navippayutte tīṇi.

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

90. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā hetū sappayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

90. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of root condition—resultant roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa hetupaccayena [T 1.0446] paccayo – vipākā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ [V 1.0414] rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā hetū kaṭattārūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of root condition—resultant roots are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant roots are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of root condition. (2)

Vipāko dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for resultant phenomena and for phenomena that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of root condition—resultant roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and kamma-produced material phenomena by way of root condition. (3)

91. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

91. A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of root condition—kamma-producing roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of root condition—kamma-producing roots are a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of root condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0364] vipākadhammadhammassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca hetupaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for kamma-producing phenomena and for phenomena that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of root condition—kamma-producing roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of root condition. (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of root condition—roots that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-produced material phenomena by way of root condition.

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

92. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0447] – vipāke khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati, kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. (1)

92. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of object condition—one contemplates the resultant aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, enjoys them, and welcomes them; based on that, lust arises, wrong view arises, doubt arises, restlessness arises, sorrow arises; when wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, resultant registering consciousness arises. (1)

Vipāko [V 1.0415] dhammo vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, vipāke khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena vipākacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Vipākā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of object condition—trainees review the fruition, contemplate the resultant aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, relish them, and welcome them; based on that, lust arises… sorrow arises; they know the mind of one endowed with resultant consciousness with the knowledge of others' minds. The resultant aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, and the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (2)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā phalaṃ paccavekkhati, vipāke khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena vipākacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Vipākā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of object condition—an arahant reviews the fruition, contemplates the resultant aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, and knows the mind of one endowed with resultant consciousness with the knowledge of others' minds. The resultant aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and advertence by way of object condition. (3)

93. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti[T 1.0448], sekkhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, sekkhā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti[M 1.0365], pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, vipākadhammadhamme khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena vipākadhammadhammacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Vipākadhammadhammā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

93. A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of object condition—one reflects on having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance; one reflects on past good deeds; one emerges from jhāna and reflects on the jhāna; trainees reflect on the lineage-transcending consciousness, on purification; trainees emerge from a path and reflect on the path; trainees reflect on abandoned defilements, on suppressed defilements; they know previously accumulated defilements; they contemplate the aggregates that are kamma-producing phenomena as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; they relish and delight in them. Based on that, lust arises… sorrow arises; they know the mind of one endowed with kamma-producing consciousness with the knowledge of others' minds. The wholesome consciousness of the base of infinite space is a condition for the wholesome consciousness of the base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The wholesome consciousness of the base of nothingness is a condition for the wholesome consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. The aggregates that are kamma-producing phenomena are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, and the knowledge of the future by way of object condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhamme khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanavipākassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo[V 1.0416]. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanavipākassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of object condition—one contemplates the aggregates that are kamma-producing phenomena as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, relishes them, and delights in them; based on that, lust arises… sorrow arises; when wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, resultant registering consciousness arises. The wholesome consciousness of the base of infinite space is a condition for the resultant consciousness of the base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The wholesome consciousness of the base of nothingness is a condition for the resultant consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati. Arahā pahīne [T 1.0449] kilese paccavekkhati, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānāti, vipākadhammadhamme khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena vipākadhammadhammacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Vipākadhammadhammā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of object condition—an arahant, having arisen from the path, reviews the path; they review previously practiced good deeds. An arahant reviews abandoned defilements; they know previously accumulated defilements; they contemplate the aggregates that are kamma-producing phenomena as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; with the knowledge of others' minds, they know the mind of one endowed with a kamma-producing mind. The wholesome consciousness of the base of infinite space is a condition for the functional consciousness of the base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The wholesome consciousness of the base of nothingness is a condition for the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. The aggregates that are kamma-producing phenomena are a condition for the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the destiny of beings according to their actions, the knowledge of the future, and for advertence, by way of object condition. (3)

94. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – arahā nibbānaṃ paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase [M 1.0366]… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakiriyaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa[T 1.0450], anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

94. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing by way of object condition. An arahant reviews Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for advertence by way of object condition. An arahant contemplates the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. The ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… smells… tastes… touches… the heart-basis… the aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds; with the knowledge of others' minds, one knows the mind of one endowed with a consciousness that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing. The functional consciousness of the base of infinite space is a condition for the functional consciousness of the base of infinite consciousness by way of object condition. The functional consciousness of the base of nothingness is a condition for the functional consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. The aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for advertence, by way of object condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme [V 1.0417] khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of object condition. Nibbāna is a condition for fruition by way of object condition. Trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, savor it, and delight in it; dependent on that, lust arises…sorrow arises. When wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, resultant registering consciousness arises. The ear…nose…tongue…body…forms…sounds…smells…tastes…touches…the heart-basis…the aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, savor them, and delight in them; dependent on that, lust arises…sorrow arises. When wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, resultant registering consciousness arises. The visible object base is a condition for eye-consciousness…the tangible object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ [T 1.0451] suṇanti, cetopariyañāṇena nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of object condition. Trainees review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, and the path by way of object condition. Trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, savor it, and delight in it; dependent on that, lust arises…sorrow arises. The ear…the aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing as impermanent, suffering, and non-self, savor them, and delight in them…with the divine eye, they see forms; with the divine ear-element, they hear sounds; with the knowledge of others' minds, they know the mind of one endowed with a consciousness that is neither resultant nor kamma-producing. The aggregates that are neither resultant nor kamma-producing are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of others' minds, the knowledge of past lives, and the knowledge of the future, by way of object condition. (3)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

95. Vipāko [M 1.0367] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – vipākādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

95. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: A resultant dominance factor is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Vipāko dhammo vipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sekkhā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vipāke khandhe garuṃ katvā assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: Trainees review fruition, regarding it as important; they savor and delight in the resultant aggregates, regarding them as important; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (2)

Vipāko [V 1.0418] dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati – vipākādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dominant condition: object dominant condition, conascent dominant condition. Object dominant condition: An arahant reviews fruition, regarding it as important. Conascent dominant condition: The resultant dominant condition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominant condition. (3)

Vipāko dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – vipākādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (4)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon and for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dominant condition. Conascent dominant condition: The resultant dominant condition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominant condition. (4)

96. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati[T 1.0452], pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, sekkhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vipākadhammadhamme khandhe garuṃ katvā assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati,. Sahajātādhipati – vipākadhammadhammādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

96. A phenomenon productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon productive of result by way of dominant condition: object dominant condition, conascent dominant condition. Object dominant condition: Having given a gift, undertaken the precepts, performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews that, regarding it as important; one reviews past good actions, regarding them as important; having emerged from jhana, one reviews jhana, regarding it as important; trainees review change-of-lineage, regarding it as important; they review purification, regarding it as important; trainees, having emerged from the path, review the path, regarding it as important; they savor and delight in the aggregates productive of result, regarding them as important. Regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascent dominant condition: The dominant condition that is a phenomenon productive of result is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of dominant condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati – vipākadhammadhammādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dominant condition: object dominant condition, conascent dominant condition. Object dominant condition: An arahant, having emerged from the path, reviews the path, regarding it as important. Conascent dominant condition: The dominant condition that is a phenomenon productive of result is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dominant condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0368] vipākadhammadhammassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – vipākadhammadhammādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon productive of result and for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dominant condition. Conascent dominant condition: The dominant condition that is a phenomenon productive of result is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominant condition. (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – arahā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Sahajātādhipati – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dominant condition: object dominant condition, conascent dominant condition. Object dominant condition: An arahant reviews Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Conascent dominant condition: The dominant condition that is a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated materiality by way of dominant condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0453][V 1.0419] vipākassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of dominant condition. Object dominant condition: Nibbāna is a condition for fruition by way of dominant condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – sekkhā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, maggassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… nevavipākanavipākadhammadhamme khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon productive of result by way of dominant condition. Object dominant condition: Trainees review Nibbāna, regarding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, purification, and the path by way of dominant condition. Regarding the eye as important, one savors and delights in it; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. The ear…regarding the aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result as important, one savors and delights in them; regarding that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediately Contiguous Condition

97. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vipākā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Pañcaviññāṇaṃ vipākamanodhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. Vipākamanodhātu vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

97. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition: preceding resultant aggregates are a condition for subsequent resultant aggregates by way of immediately contiguous condition. The five sense-consciousnesses are a condition for the resultant mind-element by way of immediately contiguous condition. The resultant mind-element is a condition for the resultant mind-consciousness element by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of immediately contiguous condition. The life-continuum is a condition for adverting by way of immediately contiguous condition. The resultant mind-consciousness element is a condition for the functional mind-consciousness element by way of immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa [T 1.0454]… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon productive of result by way of immediately contiguous condition: preceding aggregates productive of result are a condition for subsequent aggregates productive of result by way of immediately contiguous condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification… change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0369] vipākassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā [V 1.0420] vuṭṭhānassa… maggo phalassa… sekkhānaṃ anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon productive of result is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of immediately contiguous condition: aggregates productive of result are a condition for emergence… the path is a condition for fruition… for trainees, adaptation is a condition for fruition-attainment… for one emerging from cessation, the wholesome consciousness of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of immediately contiguous condition: preceding aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for subsequent aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result by way of immediately contiguous condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa, arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the immediately contiguous condition: adverting conditions the five sense-consciousnesses by the immediately contiguous condition. Neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active aggregates condition emergence… for an arahant, adaptation conditions fruition-attainment… for one emerging from cessation, the functional base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception conditions fruition-attainment by the immediately contiguous condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a kammically active phenomenon by the immediately contiguous condition: adverting conditions the kammically active aggregates by the immediately contiguous condition. (3)

Samanantarapaccayo

Immediately Contiguous Condition

98. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarasadisaṃ).

98. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the immediately contiguous condition (same as for the immediately contiguous condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

99. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho…pe… tīṇi.

99. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: one resultant aggregate… and so on… three.

Vipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0455] vipākadhammadhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A kammically active phenomenon conditions a kammically active phenomenon by the co-nascence condition… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo eko khandho…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: one neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active aggregate… and so on… one great element… and so on… external… food-originated… temperature-originated… for non-percipient beings, one great element… and so on. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0421][M 1.0370] vipākassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates by the co-nascence condition. (2)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

Resultant and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a resultant phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base are conditions for the three other aggregates… and so on. (1)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vipākā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Resultant and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: resultant aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates and the great elements are conditions for kamma-produced material phenomena by the co-nascence condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Kammically active and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the co-nascence condition: kammically active aggregates and the great elements are conditions for mind-originated material phenomena by the co-nascence condition. (1)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutuality Condition

100. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

100. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the mutuality condition: one resultant aggregate… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa [T 1.0456] aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā khandhā vatthussa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon conditions a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates are a condition for the physical base by the mutuality condition. (2)

Vipāko dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (3)

A resultant phenomenon conditions both a resultant phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate is a condition for the three other aggregates and the physical base by the mutuality condition… and so on. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A kammically active phenomenon conditions a kammically active phenomenon by the mutuality condition: one kammically active aggregate is a condition for the three other aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are conditions for two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0422] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the mutuality condition: one neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active aggregate is a condition for the three other aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are conditions for two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0371] vipākassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (2)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the mutuality condition: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates… and so on. (2)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca…pe…. (1) (Satta pañhā).

Resultant and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a resultant phenomenon… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base… and so on. (1) (Seven questions).

Nissayapaccayo

Dependence Condition

101. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa… tīṇi.

101. A resultant phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the dependence condition… three. A kammically active phenomenon conditions a kammically active phenomenon by the dependence condition… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa…pe…. (1)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the dependence condition… and so on. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa [T 1.0457] nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (2)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a resultant phenomenon by the dependence condition… and so on… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by the dependence condition… and so on… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness, the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates… and so on. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (3)

A neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon conditions a kammically active phenomenon by the dependence condition: the physical base is a condition for the kammically active aggregates… and so on. (3)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca kāyāyatanañca…pe… vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca…pe…. (1)

Resultant and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a resultant phenomenon by the dependence condition: one aggregate conascent with eye-consciousness and the eye-base… and so on… one aggregate conascent with body-consciousness and the body-base… and so on… one resultant aggregate and the physical base are conditions for the three other aggregates… and so on… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base… and so on. (1)

Vipāko [V 1.0423] ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa…pe… vipākā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca…pe… (saṃkhittaṃ) paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (2)

Resultant and neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomena are conditions for a neither-resultant-nor-kammically-active phenomenon by the dependence condition… and so on… resultant aggregates and the great elements… and so on… (in brief) at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākadhammadhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammo eko khandho ca vatthu ca…pe…. (1)

A kamma-producing phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon are a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Dependence Condition—a kamma-producing one aggregate and the physical base… (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ…. (2) (Terasa pañhā).

A kamma-producing phenomenon and a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon are a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Dependence Condition—kamma-producing aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena… (2) (Thirteen questions).

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

102. Vipāko [M 1.0372] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

102. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena [T 1.0458] paccayo. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Natural Decisive Support—bodily happiness is a decisive support condition for bodily happiness, for bodily suffering, and for the attainment of fruition. Bodily suffering is a decisive support condition for bodily happiness, for bodily suffering, and for the attainment of fruition. The attainment of fruition is a decisive support condition for bodily happiness. (1)

Vipāko dhammo vipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—object decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural Decisive Support—relying on bodily happiness, one gives alms, undertakes virtue… splits the Saṅgha. Relying on bodily suffering, one gives alms, undertakes virtue… splits the Saṅgha. Bodily happiness and bodily suffering are a decisive support condition for faith… for aspiration. (2)

Vipāko [V 1.0424] dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—object decisive support, proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo – arahā kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati…pe…. (3)

Natural Decisive Support—an arahant, relying on bodily happiness, generates unarisen functional attainment, attains to arisen functional attainment, and contemplates formations as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. Relying on bodily suffering, an arahant generates unarisen functional attainment, attains to arisen functional attainment… (3)

103. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

103. A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—object decisive support, proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… mānaṃ jappeti… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ [T 1.0459] hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati…pe… saddhā…pe… patthanā saddhāya… sīlassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ [M 1.0373] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa…pe… paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sekkhā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kusalasamāpattiṃ uppādenti…pe… maggo sekkhānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya…pe… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa…pe… micchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… micchādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā…pe… byāpādassa…pe… mātughātikammaṃ mātughātikammassa…pe… niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā…pe… niyatamicchādiṭṭhi niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā…pe… saṅghabhedakakammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Natural Decisive Support—relying on faith, one gives alms… utters conceit… grasps views. Relying on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom, one gives alms… grasps views. Relying on lust… hatred… delusion… conceit… views… aspiration, one gives alms… generates attainment, kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha… Faith… aspiration is a decisive support condition for faith… for virtue… for aspiration. The preliminary work for the first jhāna is a decisive support condition for the first jhāna… the preliminary work for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a decisive support condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the first jhāna is a decisive support condition for the second jhāna… the base of nothingness is a decisive support condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… the preliminary work for the first path is a decisive support condition for the first path… the preliminary work for the fourth path is a decisive support condition for the fourth path… the first path is a decisive support condition for the second path… the third path is a decisive support condition for the fourth path. The trainees, relying on the path, generate unarisen wholesome attainments… the path is a decisive support condition for the trainees’ analytical knowledge of meaning… for their skill in knowing what is possible and what is impossible. Killing living beings is a decisive support condition for killing living beings… for wrong view… wrong view is a decisive support condition for wrong view… for ill will… matricide is a decisive support condition for matricide… for fixed wrong view… fixed wrong view is a decisive support condition for fixed wrong view… for the kamma of splitting the Saṅgha. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0425] – saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti [T 1.0460] …pe… saddhā…pe… patthanā kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa kammavipākassa (syā.) upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)
