Natural Decisive Support—relying on faith, one torments and afflicts oneself, experiences suffering rooted in seeking… relying on aspiration, one torments and afflicts oneself… Faith… aspiration is a decisive support condition for bodily happiness, for bodily suffering, and for the attainment of fruition. Wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a decisive support condition for its result. The path is a decisive support condition for the attainment of fruition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—object decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo – arahā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Maggo arahato atthappaṭisambhidāya…pe… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural Decisive Support—an arahant, relying on the path, generates unarisen functional attainment, attains to arisen functional attainment, and contemplates formations as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. The path is a decisive support condition for an arahant’s analytical knowledge of meaning… for their skill in knowing what is possible and what is impossible. (3)

104. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

104. A neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither-resultant-nor-kamma-producing phenomenon by way of the Decisive Support Condition—object decisive support, proximate decisive support, natural decisive support…

Pakatūpanissayo [M 1.0374] – arahā utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti…pe…. (1)

Natural Decisive Support—an arahant, relying on climate… food… lodging, generates unarisen functional attainment… (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe….

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo – utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ, kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa, phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Natural decisive support: Climate, food, and lodging are a condition for physical pleasure, physical pain, and the attainment of fruition by way of decisive support condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [T 1.0461] …pe….

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of decisive support condition: object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support, and so on.

Pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0426] – utuṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Natural decisive support: Relying on climate, one gives a gift… or splits the Saṅgha. Relying on food… lodging, one gives a gift… or splits the Saṅgha. Climate, food, and lodging are a condition for faith… aspiration by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

105. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ.

105. A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence.

Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… kāyaṃ… rūpe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Object pre-nascence: An arahant regards the eye as impermanent… the body… forms… tangibles… the physical base as impermanent… with the divine eye, forms… with the divine ear-element, sounds… Base pre-nascence: The physical base is a condition for aggregates that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence.

Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejāta…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe…. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Object pre-nascence: Trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self; they delight in it and rejoice in it. Taking it as an object, lust arises… or sorrow arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states have ceased, a resultant state arises with that as its object. The ear… the physical base as impermanent… a resultant state arises with that as its object. The form base is a pre-nascent condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible base for body-consciousness… Base pre-nascence: The eye base is a pre-nascent condition for eye-consciousness… the body base for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for resultant aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0462][M 1.0375] vipākadhammadhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ.

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of pre-nascence condition: object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence.

Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ…pe… ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ [V 1.0427] uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ…pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ…pe….

Object pre-nascence: For trainees or ordinary people, taking the eye as an object… lust arises… sorrow arises. The ear… the physical base as impermanent… sorrow… with the divine eye, forms… with the divine ear-element, sounds…

Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Base pre-nascence: The physical base is a condition for resultant-producing aggregates by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

106. Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā vipākā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

106. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of post-nascence condition: post-nascent resultant aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo…. (1)

A resultant-producing phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of post-nascence condition… (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo…. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of post-nascence condition… (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

107. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā vipākadhammadhammā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

107. A resultant-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of repetition condition: preceding resultant-producing aggregates are a condition for succeeding resultant-producing aggregates… adaptation for change-of-lineage… adaptation for purification… change-of-lineage for the path… purification for the path by way of repetition condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā…pe… paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of repetition condition: the preceding… is a condition. (1)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

108. Vipāko [T 1.0463] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā cetanā…pe…. (1)

108. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of kamma condition: resultant volition is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant volition… (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ…pe… cetanā vatthussa kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of kamma condition: resultant volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant volition is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena… volition is a condition for the physical base by way of kamma condition. (2)

Vipāko [V 1.0428][M 1.0376] dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of kamma condition: resultant volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant volition is a condition for its associated aggregates and for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A resultant-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition: resultant-producing volition is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous kamma: resultant-producing volition is a condition for resultant aggregates by way of kamma condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā kaṭattārūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition: co-nascent, at a different moment. Co-nascent: kamma-producing volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. At a different moment: kamma-producing volition is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon and for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition. At a different moment: kamma-producing volition is a condition for resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (4)

Vipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0464] vipākadhammadhammassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – vipākadhammadhammā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (5)

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon and for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition—kamma-producing volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (5)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition—neither resultant nor kamma-producing volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (1)

Vipākapaccayo

Resultant Condition

109. Vipāko [V 1.0429] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

109. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of resultant condition—one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of resultant condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe [M 1.0377] vipākā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe…. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of resultant condition—resultant aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of resultant condition. The aggregates for the base… and so on. (2)

Vipāko dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon and for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of resultant condition—one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of resultant condition. (3)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

110. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – vipākā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ… tīṇi. (Paṭisandhipi imesaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ kātabbā.)

110. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—resultant nutriments are a condition for associated aggregates… three. (Rebirth-linking for these three should also be done.)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of nutriment condition… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa [T 1.0465] āhārapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—neither resultant nor kamma-producing nutriments are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition; physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

111. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi (paṭisandhi kātabbā kātabbaṃ (sī.).) Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

111. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of faculty condition… three (rebirth-linking should be done). A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of faculty condition… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0430] nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of faculty condition—neither resultant nor kamma-producing faculties are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition; the material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of faculty condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo; kāyindriyaṃ…pe…. (2)

A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of faculty condition—the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition; the body faculty… and so on. (2)

Vipāko [M 1.0378] ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – cakkhundriyañca cakkhuviññāṇañca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyindriyañca kāyaviññāṇañca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A resultant phenomenon and a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon are conditions for a resultant phenomenon by way of faculty condition—the eye faculty and eye-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates associated with eye-consciousness by way of faculty condition… and so on… the body faculty and body-consciousness are conditions for the aggregates associated with body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. (1)

Jhānapaccayo

Jhāna Condition

112. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo [T 1.0466]… tīṇi.

112. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of jhāna condition… three. A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of jhāna condition… three.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā jhānaṅgā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo.

A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—neither resultant nor kamma-producing jhāna factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of jhāna condition.

Maggapaccayo

Path Condition

113. Vipāko dhammo vipākassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo. Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā maggaṅgā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo.

113. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of path condition… three. A kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a kamma-producing phenomenon by way of path condition… three. A neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon is a condition for a neither resultant nor kamma-producing phenomenon by way of path condition. Neither resultant nor kamma-producing path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of path condition.

Sampayuttapaccayo

Association Condition

114. Vipāko [V 1.0431] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo; nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo.

114. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of association condition. One resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... A phenomenon that is productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is productive of result by way of association condition; a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of association condition; two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of association condition.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

115. Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā [M 1.0379] khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ [T 1.0467] vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

115. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: the resultant aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the resultant aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced matter by way of dissociation condition; the aggregates are a condition for the physical basis by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent: the resultant aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: the aggregates that are productive of result are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent: the aggregates that are productive of result are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the physical basis is a condition for aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascent: aggregates that are neither resultant nor productive of result are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ [V 1.0432] – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of dissociation condition: co-nascent, pre-nascent. Co-nascent: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical basis is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness... and so on... the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness... and so on... the physical basis is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is productive of result by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascent: the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates that are productive of result by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

116. Vipāko [T 1.0468] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ…pe…. (1)

116. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of presence condition—one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates... and so on... (1)

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa…pe… sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikhaṇe vipākā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of presence condition: co-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: resultant aggregates are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates are a condition for kamma-produced matter by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: resultant aggregates are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Vipāko [M 1.0380] dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo – vipāko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for both a resultant phenomenon and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of presence condition—one resultant aggregate is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... (3)

117. Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

117. A phenomenon that is productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is productive of result by way of presence condition... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of presence condition: co-nascent, post-nascent. Co-nascent: aggregates that are productive of result are a condition for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: aggregates that are productive of result are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0433] vipākadhammadhammassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca…pe… vipākadhammadhammo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…. (3)

A phenomenon that is productive of result is a condition for both a phenomenon that is productive of result and a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of presence condition... and so on... one aggregate that is productive of result is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition... and so on... (3)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa [T 1.0469] …pe… sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe….

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor productive of result by way of presence condition... by way of co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascent: one aggregate that is neither resultant nor productive of result is a condition for three aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of presence condition; one great element... and so on... the great elements are a condition for mind-originated matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter by way of presence condition. External... nutriment-originated... temperature-originated... for non-percipient beings, one great element... and so on...

Purejātaṃ – arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, vatthu nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.

Pre-nascence—an arahant regards the eye as impermanent… the ear… the base as impermanent… with the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear element, one hears sounds; the base is a condition by way of presence for the aggregates that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing.

Pacchājātā – nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo; rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Post-nascence—aggregates that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing are a condition by way of presence for this pre-arisen body; physical nutriment is a condition by way of presence for this body; the material life faculty is a condition by way of presence for kamma-originated material phenomena.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ – paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 1.0381] atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… assādenti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo…pe… domanassaṃ…pe… kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā…pe… sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ…pe… vipāko tadārammaṇatā…pe… rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ [T 1.0470] kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: whether trainees or ordinary people, they regard the eye as impermanent… and savor it; based on that, lust arises… sorrow arises… When wholesome or unwholesome states have ceased, the resultant registers that as its object… the ear… the physical base… the resultant registers that as its object… the visible-form base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tangible-object base is a condition for body-consciousness… the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the resultant aggregates by way of presence condition.

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0434] vipākadhammadhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato…pe… assādenti…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā…pe… vatthu vipākadhammadhammānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of presence condition. Pre-nascence: whether trainees or ordinary people, they regard the eye as impermanent… they delight in it… sorrow arises. The ear… they regard the physical base as impermanent… sorrow arises. With the divine eye… the physical base is a condition for the resultant-producing aggregates by way of presence condition.

118. Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañca tiṇṇannaṃ…pe… kāyaviññāṇasahagato…pe… vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ…pe…. (1)

118. Resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing are a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one aggregate co-arisen with eye-consciousness and the eye base are a condition for the three other aggregates… co-arisen with body-consciousness… one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three other aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking, one resultant aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three other aggregates….

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.

Resultant phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing are a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence: resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking, resultant aggregates and the great elements are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition.

Pacchājātā – vipākā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa…pe… pacchājātā vipākā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Post-nascence: resultant aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence… Post-nascence: resultant aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition.

Vipākadhammadhammo [T 1.0471] ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākadhammadhammassa…pe… sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – vipākadhammadhammo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ…pe…. (1)

Resultant-producing phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing are a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon… by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. Co-nascence: one resultant-producing aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three other aggregates….

Vipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0382] ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa [V 1.0435] atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – vipākadhammadhammā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Resultant-producing phenomena and phenomena that are neither resultant nor resultant-producing are a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of presence condition—by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Co-nascence: resultant-producing aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: resultant-producing aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of presence condition. Post-nascence: resultant-producing aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition.

Natthi-vigatāvigatapaccayā

Absence, Disappearance, and Non-disappearance Conditions

119. Vipāko dhammo…. (Natthi-vigataṃ anantarasadisaṃ, avigataṃ atthisadisaṃ.)

119. A resultant phenomenon…. (Absence and Disappearance are similar to Contiguity; Non-disappearance is similar to Presence.)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Conformity to Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Section

Suddhaṃ

Pure

120. Paccanīyuddhāro

Summary of the Negative

121. Vipāko [V 1.0436][M 1.0383] dhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

121. A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition.

Vipāko dhammo vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a resultant-producing phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition.

Vipāko dhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A resultant phenomenon is a condition for a phenomenon that is neither resultant nor resultant-producing by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition.

Vipāko dhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

The resultant phenomenon is a condition for the resultant phenomenon and for the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (4)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the result-producing phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the resultant phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of kamma condition. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākadhammadhammo vipākassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca kammapaccayena paccayo. [T 1.0473] (4)

The result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the resultant phenomenon and for the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of kamma condition. (4)

Vipākadhammadhammo [V 1.0437] vipākadhammadhammassa ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ca sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (5)

The result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the result-producing phenomenon and for the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (5)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition... by way of post-nascence condition... by way of nutriment condition... by way of faculty condition. (1)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo vipākassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the resultant phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of co-nascence condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo [M 1.0384] vipākadhammadhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon is a condition for the result-producing phenomenon by way of object condition... by way of decisive support condition... by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ… purejātaṃ. (1)

The resultant phenomenon and the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are related to the resultant phenomenon by way of co-nascence... by way of pre-nascence. (1)

Vipāko ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sahajātaṃ… pacchājātaṃ… āhāraṃ… indriyaṃ. (2)

The resultant phenomenon and the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are related to the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of co-nascence... by way of post-nascence... by way of nutriment... by way of faculty. (2)

Vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā vipākadhammadhammassa sahajātaṃ… purejātaṃ. (1)

The result-producing phenomenon and the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are related to the result-producing phenomenon by way of co-nascence... by way of pre-nascence. (1)

Vipākadhammadhammo ca nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo ca dhammā nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammassa sahajātaṃ… pacchājātaṃ… āhāraṃ… indriyaṃ. (2)

The result-producing phenomenon and the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon are related to the neither-resultant-nor-result-producing phenomenon by way of co-nascence... by way of post-nascence... by way of nutriment... by way of faculty. (2)

Dependent on a clung-to and subject to clinging phenomenon, a clung-to and subject to clinging phenomenon arises by root condition: dependent on one clung-to and subject to clinging aggregate, three aggregates arise… and so forth… dependent on two clung-to and subject to clinging aggregates, two aggregates arise; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one clung-to and subject to clinging aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced form arise… and so forth… dependent on two clung-to and subject to clinging aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced form arise; dependent on aggregates, the physical basis arises; dependent on the physical basis, aggregates arise; dependent on one clung-to and subject to clinging great element, three great elements arise… and so forth… dependent on two clung-to and subject to clinging great elements, two great elements arise; dependent on the great elements, kamma-produced form and derived form arise. Hetuyā [T 1.0481][M 1.0391] nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare tīṇi, samanantare tīṇi, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye nava, upanissaye tīṇi, purejāte tīṇi, āsevane dve, kamme nava, vipāke nava, āhāre nava, indriye nava, jhāne nava, magge nava, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte nava, atthiyā nava, natthiyā tīṇi, vigate tīṇi, avigate nava.

12. By root condition, nine; by object condition, three; by predominance condition, five; by contiguity condition, three; by immediate contiguity condition, three; by co-nascence condition, nine; by mutuality condition, three; by dependence condition, nine; by decisive support condition, three; by pre-nascence condition, three; by repetition condition, two; by kamma condition, nine; by result condition, nine; by nutriment condition, nine; by faculty condition, nine; by jhāna condition, nine; by path condition, nine; by association condition, three; by dissociation condition, nine; by presence condition, nine; by absence condition, three; by disappearance condition, three; by non-disappearance condition, nine.

13. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ [V 1.0446] dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā, ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ; asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

13. Dependent on a phenomenon that is clung to and graspable, a phenomenon that is clung to and graspable arises by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate that is clung to and graspable, three aggregates; dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking, dependent on one aggregate that is clung to and graspable, three aggregates and kamma-originated materiality... and so forth... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-originated materiality; dependent on aggregates, the base; dependent on the base, aggregates; dependent on one great element, three great elements... and so forth... dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality, derived materiality; for non-percipient beings, dependent on one great element... and so forth... dependent on the great elements, kamma-originated materiality, derived materiality. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke upādinnupādāniye khandhe [T 1.0482] paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is clung to and graspable, a phenomenon that is not clung to but is graspable arises by non-root condition—dependent on rootless aggregates that are clung to and graspable, mind-originated material form arises. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyaṃ [M 1.0392] dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is clung to and graspable, phenomena that are both clung to and graspable and not clung to but graspable arise by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate that is clung to and graspable, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise... and so forth... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ anupādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca upādārūpaṃ. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is not clung to but is graspable, a phenomenon that is not clung to but is graspable arises by non-root condition—dependent on one rootless aggregate that is not clung to but is graspable, three aggregates and mind-originated material form arise... and so forth... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-originated material form arise. Dependent on one great element that is not clung to but is graspable... and so forth... dependent on the great elements, mind-originated material form and derived materiality arise. External... nutriment-originated... temperature-originated... dependent on one great element... and so forth... dependent on the great elements, derived materiality arises. Dependent on aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness arises. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyañca [V 1.0447] anupādinnupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetuke upādinnupādāniye khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

Dependent on a phenomenon that is both clung to and graspable and not clung to but graspable, a phenomenon that is not clung to but is graspable arises by non-root condition—dependent on rootless aggregates that are clung to and graspable and the great elements, mind-originated material form arises. (1)

Non-predominance Condition

15. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ [V 1.0448] dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati naadhipatipaccayā (paṭisandhi paripuṇṇaṃ)… tīṇi.

Anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati naāsevanapaccayā – vipākaṃ anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā (saṃkhittaṃ).

The Root Condition

47. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā [V 1.0464] – upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā, tayo khandhe saṃsaṭṭho eko khandho, dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā, paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

47. A clung-to and a-basis-for-clinging phenomenon arises associated with a clung-to and a-basis-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition—one clung-to and a-basis-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates; three aggregates are associated with one aggregate; two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one clung-to and a-basis-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – anupādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1)

A not-clung-to but a-basis-for-clinging phenomenon arises associated with a not-clung-to but a-basis-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition—one not-clung-to but a-basis-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon arises associated with a not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: one not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates. (1) (Abbreviated.)

Saṅkhyāvāro

The Section on Enumeration

48. Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… adhipatiyā dve…pe… āsevane dve…pe… vipāke dve…pe… avigate tīṇi.

48. By root condition, three… and so on… by dominance condition, two… and so on… by repetition condition, two… and so on… by result condition, two… and so on… by non-disappearance condition, three.

(Yathā [T 1.0498] kusalattike gaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbā.)

(Just as the enumeration in the wholesome triad, so should it be enumerated.)

Anulomaṃ.

Forward Order

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. Conditional Negative

Nahetupaccayo

The Non-Root Condition

49. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ [M 1.0406] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

49. A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon arises associated with a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by non-root condition: one rootless clung-to and fuel-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ [V 1.0465] dhammaṃ saṃsaṭṭho anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā – ahetukaṃ anupādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ saṃsaṭṭhā tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe saṃsaṭṭhā dve khandhā; vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe saṃsaṭṭho vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. (1) (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

A not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon arises associated with a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by non-root condition: one rootless not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging aggregate is associated with three aggregates… and so on… two aggregates are associated with two aggregates; delusion accompanied by doubt and restlessness is associated with the aggregates accompanied by doubt and restlessness. (1) (Abbreviated.)

Nahetuyā dve, na adhipatiyā tīṇi…pe… navippayutte tīṇi. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

By non-root condition, two; by non-dominance condition, three… and so on… by non-disassociation condition, three. (Abbreviated.)

By root condition, by non-dominance condition, three… and so on… by non-disassociation condition, three.

Nahetupaccayā ārammaṇe dve…pe… avigate dve.

50. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ sampayutto upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā tīṇi…pe… avigate tīṇi.

1. The Section on Analysis

Hetupaccayo

The Root Condition

51. Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0466][M 1.0407] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

51. A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the clung-to and fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates by root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the clung-to and fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by root condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the clung-to and fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by root condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for both a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon and a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the clung-to and fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by root condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by root condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ [T 1.0500] khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates by root condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by root condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [V 1.0467] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon and a not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by root condition: the not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging roots are a condition for the conjoined aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

52. Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0408] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… upādinnupādāniye khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vippassanti, assādenti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… upādinnupādāniyaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

52. A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—whether trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self, delight in it, and rejoice in it; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. When wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, a resultant [consciousness] arises taking that as its object. The ear…nose…tongue…body…clung-to and fuel-for-clinging forms…odors…tastes…tangibles…the base…clung-to and fuel-for-clinging aggregates are contemplated as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self; they delight in them and rejoice in them; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. When wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, a resultant [consciousness] arises taking that as its object. A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging form sense-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging odor sense-base…taste sense-base…tangible sense-base is a condition for body-consciousness by object condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa [T 1.0501] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… upādinnupādāniye khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passati, cetopariyañāṇena upādinnupādāniyacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Upādinnupādāniyā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—one contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self, delights in it, and rejoices in it; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. The ear…nose…tongue…body…clung-to and fuel-for-clinging forms…odors…tastes…tangibles…the base…clung-to and fuel-for-clinging aggregates are contemplated as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self; one delights in them and rejoices in them; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees clung-to and fuel-for-clinging forms; with the knowledge of penetrating minds, one knows the mind of a person endowed with clung-to and fuel-for-clinging consciousness. Clung-to and fuel-for-clinging aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of penetrating minds, the knowledge of recollecting past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by object condition. (2)

53. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni [V 1.0468] paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti; anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… anupādinnupādāniye khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato [M 1.0409] vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā [T 1.0502] saddaṃ suṇanti, cetopariyañāṇena anupādinnupādāniyacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

53. A not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—having given alms, undertaken the precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects on that; one reflects on past good deeds; emerging from jhāna, one reflects on the jhāna; noble ones reflect on the change-of-lineage state, reflect on purification; noble ones reflect on abandoned defilements, reflect on suppressed defilements, and know defilements previously accumulated. They contemplate not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging forms…sounds…odors…tastes…tangibles…not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging aggregates as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self, delight in them, and rejoice in them; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. With the divine eye, they see not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging forms; with the divine ear-element, they hear sounds; with the knowledge of penetrating minds, they know the mind of a person endowed with not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging consciousness. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness by object condition. The base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by object condition. Not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic powers, the knowledge of penetrating minds, the knowledge of recollecting past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by object condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… anupādinnupādāniye khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanavipākassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanavipākassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—whether trainees or ordinary people contemplate not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging forms…sounds…odors…tastes…tangibles…not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging aggregates as impermanent, as suffering, or as not-self; they delight in them and rejoice in them; based on that, lust arises…or sorrow arises. When wholesome and unwholesome states have ceased, a resultant [consciousness] arises taking that as its object. The wholesome [attainment of the] base of infinite space is a condition for the resultant [attainment of the] base of infinite consciousness by object condition. The wholesome [attainment of the] base of nothingness is a condition for the resultant [attainment of the] base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by object condition. A not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging form sense-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging tangible sense-base is a condition for body-consciousness by object condition. (2)

54. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena [T 1.0503] paccayo. (1)

54. A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—Nibbāna is a condition for the path and for the fruit by object condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti; nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā cetopariyañāṇena anupādinnaanupādāniyacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti; anupādinnaanupādāniyā [V 1.0469] khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but fuel-for-clinging phenomenon by object condition—noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, review the fruit, and review Nibbāna; Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, and for adverting, by object condition. Noble ones, with the knowledge of penetrating minds, know the mind of a person endowed with not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging consciousness; not-clung-to and not-fuel-for-clinging aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of penetrating minds, the knowledge of recollecting past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting, by object condition. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

55. Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0410] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… upādinnupādāniye khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (1)

55. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object dominance: Having held the eye as important, one savors and rejoices in it; having held that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. The ear… nose… tongue… body… clung-to and clingable forms… smells… tastes… tactile objects… the base… clung-to and clingable aggregates—having held them as important, one savors and rejoices in them; having held that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ [T 1.0504] katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… anupādinnupādāniye khandhe garuṃ katvā assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – anupādinnupādāniyādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unclung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object dominance: Having given a gift, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews that, holding it as important; one reviews past good actions, holding them as important; having emerged from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, holding it as important; trainees review change-of-lineage, holding it as important, and review purification, holding it as important. They savor and rejoice in unclung-to and clingable forms… sounds… smells… tastes… tactile objects… unclung-to and clingable aggregates, holding them as important; having held that as important, lust arises, wrong view arises. Co-nascence dominance: An unclung-to and clingable dominant factor is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – anupādinnaanupādāniyādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object dominance: Nibbāna is a condition for the path and for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: An unclung-to and unclingable dominant factor is a condition for associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ [V 1.0470] garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – anupādinnaanupādāniyādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of dominance condition—object dominance, co-nascence dominance. Object dominance: Noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, holding it as important; review the fruit, holding it as important; review Nibbāna, holding it as important. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: An unclung-to and unclingable dominant factor is a condition for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [M 1.0411] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo[T 1.0505]. Sahajātādhipati – anupādinnaanupādāniyādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon is a condition for both an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon and an unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: An unclung-to and unclingable dominant factor is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

Anantarapaccayo

Immediate Condition

56. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā upādinnupādāniyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; pañcaviññāṇaṃ vipākamanodhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo; vipākamanodhātu vipākamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

56. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Preceding clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for succeeding clung-to and clingable aggregates by way of immediate condition; the five-sense consciousness is a condition for the resultant mind-element by way of immediate condition; the resultant mind-element is a condition for the resultant mind-consciousness-element by way of immediate condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, vipākamanoviññāṇadhātu kiriyamanoviññāṇadhātuyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. The life-continuum is a condition for adverting by way of immediate condition; the resultant mind-consciousness-element is a condition for the functional mind-consciousness-element by way of immediate condition. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… āvajjanā anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unclung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Preceding unclung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for succeeding unclung-to and clingable aggregates by way of immediate condition; adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification… adverting is a condition for the unclung-to and clingable aggregates by way of immediate condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo; anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unclung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Adverting is a condition for the five consciousnesses by way of immediate condition; unclung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of immediate condition. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0506][V 1.0471] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An unclung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path… adaptation is a condition for fruition-attainment… for one emerging from cessation… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a condition for fruition-attainment by way of immediate condition. (3)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon is a condition for an unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Preceding unclung-to and unclingable aggregates are a condition for succeeding unclung-to and unclingable aggregates by way of immediate condition. The path is a condition for the fruit… the fruit is a condition for the fruit by way of immediate condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [M 1.0412] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An unclung-to and unclingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of immediate condition. Fruition is a condition for emergence by way of immediate condition. (2)

Samanantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

57. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo (anantarapaccayasadisaṃ).

57. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of contiguity condition (similar to the immediate condition).

Sahajātapaccayo

Co-nascence Condition

58.
