Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… tayo mahābhūtā ekassa mahābhūtassa [T 1.0507] …pe… dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

58. The clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the clung-to and clingable phenomenon—one clung-to and clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates [...]; two aggregates for the other two [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one clung-to and clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates and for materiality produced by kamma [...]; two aggregates for the other two and for materiality produced by kamma [...]. The aggregates are a co-nascence condition for the physical base [...]; the physical base is a co-nascence condition for the aggregates [...]. One great element is a co-nascence condition for the other three great elements [...]; three great elements for one great element [...]; two great elements for the other two great elements [...]. The great elements are a co-nascence condition for materiality produced by kamma and derived materiality. For non-percipient beings, one great element [...]. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0472] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—the clung-to and clingable aggregates are a co-nascence condition for mind-produced materiality. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the clung-to and clingable phenomenon and the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon. One clung-to and clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality [...]; two aggregates are a co-nascence condition for the other two and for mind-produced materiality. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ [M 1.0413]…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The not clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—one not clung-to and clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality [...]; two aggregates for the other two and for mind-produced materiality. One not clung-to and clingable great element [...]; the great elements are a co-nascence condition for mind-produced materiality [...]; external [...]; nutriment-produced [...]; temperature-produced [...]; one great element [...]; the great elements are a co-nascence condition for derived materiality. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa [T 1.0508] dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon—one not clung-to and not clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates [...]; two aggregates are a co-nascence condition for the other two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—the not clung-to and not clingable aggregates are a co-nascence condition for mind-produced materiality. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo; anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon is a co-nascence condition for both the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon and the not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon. One not clung-to and not clingable aggregate is a co-nascence condition for the other three aggregates and mind-produced materiality [...]; two aggregates are a co-nascence condition for the other two aggregates and mind-produced materiality. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0473] ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The not clung-to and clingable phenomenon and the not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon are a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—the not clung-to and not clingable aggregates and the great elements are a co-nascence condition for mind-produced materiality. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The clung-to and clingable phenomenon and the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon are a co-nascence condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—the clung-to and clingable aggregates and the great elements are a co-nascence condition for mind-produced materiality. (1)

Aññamaññapaccayo

Mutuality Condition

59. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa [T 1.0509] aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca…pe… khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… dve mahābhūtā dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

59. The clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a mutuality condition for the clung-to and clingable phenomenon—one clung-to and clingable aggregate is a mutuality condition for the other three aggregates [...]; two aggregates for the other two aggregates [...]. At the moment of rebirth-linking, one clung-to and clingable aggregate is a mutuality condition for the other three aggregates and the physical base [...]; the aggregates are a mutuality condition for the physical base [...]; the physical base is a mutuality condition for the aggregates [...]. One great element is a mutuality condition for the other three great elements [...]; two great elements are a mutuality condition for the other two great elements [...]. For non-percipient beings, one great element [...]. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0414] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. (1)

The not clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a mutuality condition for the not clung-to and clingable phenomenon—one not clung-to and clingable aggregate is a mutuality condition for the other three aggregates [...]; two aggregates are a mutuality condition for the other two aggregates. One great element [...]; external [...]; nutriment-produced [...]; temperature-produced [...]; one great element [...]. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa aññamaññapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

The not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon is a mutuality condition for the not clung-to and not clingable phenomenon—one not clung-to and not clingable aggregate is a mutuality condition for the other three aggregates [...]; two aggregates for the other two aggregates [...]. (1)

Nissayapaccayo

Dependence Condition

60. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo [V 1.0474] – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

60. A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is clung to and clingable—one clung to and clingable aggregate is a condition by way of dependence for the other three aggregates…pe… at the moment of rebirth-linking…pe… one great element…pe… for non-percipient beings, one great element…pe… the eye-base is a condition by way of dependence for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base is a condition by way of dependence for body-consciousness…pe… the physical basis is a condition by way of dependence for the clung to and clingable aggregates. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0510] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable—the clung to and clingable aggregates are a condition by way of dependence for mind-produced material forms. The physical basis is a condition by way of dependence for the aggregates that are not clung to, but clingable. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – vatthu anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable—the physical basis is a condition by way of dependence for the aggregates that are neither clung to nor clingable. (3)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is clung to and clingable and for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable—one clung to and clingable aggregate is a condition by way of dependence for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced material forms…pe… two clung to and clingable aggregates are a condition by way of dependence for the other two aggregates and for mind-produced material forms. (4)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa… ekā.

A phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable is a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable… one instance.

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo… tīṇi.

A phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable… three.

Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0415] ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable and a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable are a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable—one aggregate that is neither clung to nor clingable and the physical basis are a condition by way of dependence for the other three aggregates…pe… two aggregates that are neither clung to nor clingable and the physical basis are a condition by way of dependence for the other two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā [T 1.0511] anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa [V 1.0475] nissayapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable and a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable are a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable—the aggregates that are neither clung to nor clingable and the great elements are a condition by way of dependence for mind-produced material forms. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa nissayapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable and a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable are a condition by way of dependence for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable—the clung to and clingable aggregates and the great elements are a condition by way of dependence for mind-produced material forms. One aggregate that is not clung to, but clingable and the physical basis are a condition by way of dependence for the other three aggregates…pe… two aggregates that are not clung to, but clingable and the physical basis are a condition by way of dependence for the other two aggregates. (1)

Upanissayapaccayo

Decisive Support Condition

61. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa…pe… utu kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa…pe… bhojanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa…pe… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

61. A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is clung to and clingable—contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—bodily pleasure is a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and for bodily pain. Bodily pain is a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and for bodily pain…pe… climate is a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and for bodily pain…pe… food is a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and for bodily pain…pe… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food are a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and for bodily pain. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ [T 1.0512] deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ anupādinnupādāniyāya [M 1.0416] saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is not clung to, but clingable—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—relying on bodily pleasure, one gives a gift, undertakes morality, observes the Uposatha, generates jhāna, generates insight, generates higher knowledge, generates meditative attainment, kills a living being…pe… splits the Saṅgha. Relying on bodily pain… climate… food… one gives a gift…pe… splits the Saṅgha. Bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food are a condition by way of decisive support for faith that is not clung to, but clingable… for morality… for learning… for generosity… for wisdom… for greed… for hatred… for delusion… for conceit… for view… for aspiration. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0476] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ upanissāya maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ… utu… bhojanaṃ maggassa… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable. Natural decisive support—relying on bodily pleasure, one generates the path, attains fruition attainment. Relying on bodily pain… climate… food, one generates the path, attains fruition attainment. Bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food are a condition by way of decisive support for the path… for fruition attainment. (3)

62. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – anupādinnupādāniyaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… rāgaṃ… dosaṃ… mohaṃ… mānaṃ [T 1.0513]… diṭṭhiṃ… patthanaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Anupādinnupādāniyā saddhā… sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgo… paññā… rāgo… doso… moho… māno… diṭṭhi… patthanā… utu… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ… anupādinnupādāniyāya saddhāya… sīlassa… sutassa… cāgassa… paññāya… rāgassa… dosassa… mohassa… mānassa… diṭṭhiyā… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa parikammaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe… pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa…pe… niyatamicchādiṭṭhi niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā…pe…. (1)

62. A phenomenon that is not clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is not clung to and clingable—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—relying on faith that is not clung to and clingable, one gives a gift, undertakes morality, observes the Uposatha, generates jhāna, generates insight, generates higher knowledge, attains meditative attainment, fosters conceit, or grasps a wrong view. Relying on virtue that is not clung to and clingable… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… aversion… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration… climate… food… dwelling, one gives a gift…pe… attains meditative attainment, fosters conceit, grasps a wrong view, kills a living being…pe… splits the Saṅgha. Faith that is not clung to and clingable… virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… aversion… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration… climate… food… dwelling… are a condition by way of decisive support for faith that is not clung to and clingable… morality… learning… generosity… wisdom… lust… aversion… delusion… conceit… view… aspiration. The preliminary activity for the first jhāna is a condition by way of decisive support for the first jhāna…pe… the preliminary activity for the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition by way of decisive support for the base of neither perception nor non-perception…pe… the first jhāna is a condition by way of decisive support for the second…pe… the base of nothingness is a condition by way of decisive support for the base of neither perception nor non-perception…pe… killing living beings is a condition by way of decisive support for killing living beings…pe… fixed wrong view is a condition by way of decisive support for fixed wrong view…pe…. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – anupādinnupādāniyaṃ saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ sīlaṃ [M 1.0417]…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Anupādinnupādāniyā saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa[V 1.0477], kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is not clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is clung to and clingable—contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—relying on faith that is not clung to and clingable, one heats and torments oneself, experiencing suffering rooted in seeking. Relying on virtue that is not clung to and clingable…pe… dwelling, one heats and torments oneself, experiencing suffering rooted in seeking. Faith that is not clung to and clingable…pe… dwelling are a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure and bodily pain. Wholesome and unwholesome kamma is a condition by way of decisive support for its result. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0514] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyassa maggassa…pe… catutthassa maggassa parikammaṃ catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is not clung to and clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable—contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—the preliminary activity for the first path is a condition by way of decisive support for the first path. The preliminary activity for the second path…pe… the preliminary activity for the third path…pe… the preliminary activity for the fourth path is a condition by way of decisive support for the fourth path. (3)

63. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyo maggo tatiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa…pe… maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

63. A phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable—object decisive support, contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—the first path is a condition by way of decisive support for the second path. The second path is a condition by way of decisive support for the third path…pe… the third path is a condition by way of decisive support for the fourth path…pe… the path is a condition by way of decisive support for fruition attainment. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is clung to and clingable—contiguous decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—fruition attainment is a condition by way of decisive support for bodily pleasure. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūnissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjanti, saṅkhāre aniccato [T 1.0515] dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Maggo ariyānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya dhammappaṭisambhidāya niruttippaṭisambhidāya paṭibhānappaṭisambhidāya ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is neither clung to nor clingable is a condition by way of decisive support for a phenomenon that is not clung to and clingable—object decisive support, natural decisive support…pe…. Natural decisive support—noble ones, relying on the path, give rise to unarisen attainments, enter arisen attainments, and contemplate formations as impermanent, suffering, and not-self. The path is a condition by way of decisive support for the noble ones’ analytical knowledge of meaning, analytical knowledge of phenomena, analytical knowledge of language, analytical knowledge of ready wit, and for skill in what is possible and impossible. (3)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

64. Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0478][M 1.0418] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… upādinnupādāniyaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

64. A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: trainees or ordinary people contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delight in it, and rejoice in it; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states cease, resultant consciousness taking that same object arises. Similarly for the ear… nose… tongue… body… forms that are clung to and are a basis for clinging… odors… tastes… tangibles… the base—they contemplate them as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delight in them, and rejoice in them; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states cease, resultant consciousness taking that same object arises. The form base that is clung to and is a basis for clinging is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the odor base that is clung to and is a basis for clinging… taste base… tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the eye base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates that are clung to and are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti [T 1.0516] abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence: they contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delight in it, and rejoice in it; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. Similarly for the ear…pe… one contemplates the base as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delights in it, and rejoices in it; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. With the divine eye, they see a form that is clung to and is a basis for clinging. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates that are not clung to but are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is not clung to and not a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence: the base is a condition for the aggregates that are not clung to and not a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

65. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati [V 1.0479] …pe… domanassaṃ [M 1.0419] uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. (1)

65. A phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. Object pre-nascence: one contemplates a form that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging… a sound… an odor… a taste… a tangible as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delights in it, and rejoices in it; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. With the divine eye, one sees a form that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging; with the divine ear element, one hears a sound. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā [T 1.0517] uppajjati. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to and is a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. Object pre-nascence: one contemplates a form that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging… a sound… an odor… a taste… a tangible as impermanent, suffering, and not-self, delights in it, and rejoices in it; based on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states cease, resultant consciousness taking that same object arises. The form base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging, and a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging, are a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. The form base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition…pe… the tangible base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the body base are a condition for body-consciousness by way of pre-nascence condition. The form base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the base are a condition for the aggregates that are clung to and are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition…pe… the tangible base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the base are a condition for the aggregates that are clung to and are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging, and a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging, are a condition for a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. The form base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the base are a condition for the aggregates that are not clung to but are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition…pe… the tangible base that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging and the base are a condition for the aggregates that are not clung to but are a basis for clinging by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

66. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena [T 1.0518] paccayo. (1)

66. A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen aggregates that are clung to and are a basis for clinging are a condition for this previously arisen body that is clung to and is a basis for clinging by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0420][V 1.0480] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A phenomenon that is clung to and a basis for clinging is a condition for a phenomenon that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen aggregates that are clung to and are a basis for clinging are a condition for this previously arisen body that is not clung to but is a basis for clinging by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and clingable and not-clung-to but clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen not-clung-to but clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā [T 1.0519] anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and clingable and not-clung-to but clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (3)

67. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

67. A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to and not-clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to and not-clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen not-clung-to but clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [V 1.0481] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā anupādinnaanupādāniyā [M 1.0421] khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of post-nascence condition. Subsequently arisen not-clung-to and not-clingable aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and clingable and not-clung-to but clingable body by way of post-nascence condition. (3)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

68. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena [T 1.0520] paccayo. (1)

68. A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Preceding not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for succeeding not-clung-to but clingable aggregates by way of repetition condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage… adaptation is a condition for purification by way of repetition condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon by way of repetition condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path by way of repetition condition. (2)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

69. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Cetanā vatthussa kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

69. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Clung-to and clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates by way of kamma condition; at the moment of relinking, clung-to and clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. Volition is a condition for the physical base by way of kamma condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Clung-to and clingable volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Clung-to and clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0482] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Not-clung-to but clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0422] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa [T 1.0521] kammapaccayena paccayo – nānākkhaṇikā anupādinnupādāniyā cetanā vipākānaṃ upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous not-clung-to but clingable volition is a condition for resultant clung-to and clingable aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

70. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā kusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

70. A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Co-nascent and asynchronous. Co-nascent: not-clung-to and not-clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates by way of kamma condition. Asynchronous: wholesome not-clung-to and not-clingable volition is a condition for resultant not-clung-to and not-clingable aggregates by way of kamma condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Not-clung-to and not-clingable volition is a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to and not-clingable phenomenon by way of kamma condition. Not-clung-to and not-clingable volition is a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Result Condition

71. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipāko upādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0522] eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

71. A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon—the clung-to and graspable resultant single aggregate is a condition by way of result-condition for the three aggregates… two aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the two aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, the clung-to and graspable resultant single aggregate is a condition by way of result-condition for the three aggregates and for kamma-born materiality… two aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the two aggregates and for kamma-born materiality. The aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the base. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0483] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā upādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—the clung-to and graspable resultant aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for mind-born materiality. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo [M 1.0423]…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—the clung-to and graspable resultant single aggregate is a condition by way of result-condition for the three aggregates and for mind-born materiality… two aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the two aggregates and for mind-born materiality. (3)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon—the not clung-to and not graspable resultant single aggregate is a condition by way of result-condition for the three aggregates… two aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—the not clung-to and not graspable resultant aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for mind-born materiality. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko [T 1.0523] anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of result-condition for both a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon—the not clung-to and not graspable resultant single aggregate is a condition by way of result-condition for the three aggregates and for mind-born materiality… two aggregates are a condition by way of result-condition for the two aggregates and for mind-born materiality. (3)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment-condition

72. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

72. A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon—clung-to and graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates; at the moment of rebirth-linking, clung-to and graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-born materiality. Clung-to and graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the clung-to and graspable body. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0484] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo; upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—clung-to and graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for mind-born materiality; clung-to and graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the not clung-to but graspable body. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo[M 1.0424]. Upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—clung-to and graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-born materiality. Clung-to and graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for both the clung-to and graspable body and the not clung-to but graspable body. (3)

73. Anupādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0524] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

73. A not clung-to but graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—not clung-to but graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-born materiality. Not clung-to but graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the not clung-to but graspable body. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not clung-to but graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon—not clung-to but graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the clung-to and graspable body. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not clung-to but graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—not clung-to but graspable edible food is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for both the clung-to and graspable body and the not clung-to but graspable body. (3)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon—not clung-to and not graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [V 1.0485] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—not clung-to and not graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for mind-born materiality. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā [T 1.0525] āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of nutriment-condition for both a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon—not clung-to and not graspable nutriments are a condition by way of nutriment-condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-born materiality. (3)

74. Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

74. Both clung-to and graspable phenomena and not clung-to but graspable phenomena are a condition by way of nutriment condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon—both clung-to and graspable edible food and not clung-to but graspable edible food are a condition by way of nutriment condition for the clung-to and graspable body. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0425] ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

Both clung-to and graspable phenomena and not clung-to but graspable phenomena are a condition by way of nutriment condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—both clung-to and graspable edible food and not clung-to but graspable edible food are a condition by way of nutriment condition for the not clung-to but graspable body. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Both clung-to and graspable phenomena and not clung-to but graspable phenomena are a condition by way of nutriment condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon—both clung-to and graspable edible food and not clung-to but graspable edible food are a condition by way of nutriment condition for both the clung-to and graspable body and the not clung-to but graspable body. (3)

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

75. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ [T 1.0526] kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

75. A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—clung-to and graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, clung-to and graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-born materiality by way of faculty condition. The eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness… the material life faculty is a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of faculty condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0486] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā indriyā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—clung-to and graspable faculties are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—clung-to and graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not clung-to but graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—not clung-to but graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—not clung-to and not graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of faculty condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [M 1.0426] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā indriyā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—not clung-to and not graspable faculties are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa [T 1.0527] ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for both a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—not clung-to and not graspable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of faculty condition. (3)

Jhānapaccayo

Jhāna Condition

76. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyāni [V 1.0487] jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

76. A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—clung-to and graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of jhāna condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, clung-to and graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-born materiality by way of jhāna condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—clung-to and graspable jhāna factors are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of jhāna condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for both a clung-to and graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—clung-to and graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of jhāna condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not clung-to but graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—not clung-to but graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of jhāna condition. (1)

77. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa [T 1.0528] dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (1)

77. A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—not clung-to and not graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of jhāna condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—not clung-to and not graspable jhāna factors are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of jhāna condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [M 1.0427] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni jhānaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon is a condition for both a not clung-to but graspable phenomenon and a not clung-to and not graspable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition—not clung-to and not graspable jhāna factors are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of jhāna condition. (3)

Maggapaccayo

Path Condition

78. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni [V 1.0488] maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

78. A clung-to and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and graspable phenomenon by way of path condition—clung-to and graspable path factors are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of path condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking… and so on. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—clung-to and clingable path factors are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of path condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – upādinnupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—clung-to and clingable path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of path condition. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa [T 1.0529] dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—not-clung-to but clingable path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of path condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (1)

A not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—not-clung-to and non-clingable path factors are a condition for associated aggregates by way of path condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—not-clung-to and non-clingable path factors are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of path condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyāni maggaṅgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ maggapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon by way of path condition—not-clung-to and non-clingable path factors are a condition for associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of path condition. (3)

Sampayuttapaccayo

Association Condition

79. Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0428] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo [V 1.0489] – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. (1)

79. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of association condition—one clung-to and clingable aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of association condition… two aggregates for two aggregates… at the moment of rebirth-linking…. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ [T 1.0530] khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of association condition—one not-clung-to but clingable aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of association condition… two aggregates for two aggregates…. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sampayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

A not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon by way of association condition—one not-clung-to and non-clingable aggregate is a condition for three aggregates by way of association condition… two aggregates for two aggregates…. (1)

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

80. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

80. A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: at the moment of rebirth-linking, clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for kamma-born materiality by way of dissociation condition. Aggregates are a condition for the physical basis by way of dissociation condition. The physical basis is a condition for aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of dissociation condition… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The physical basis is a condition for clung-to and clingable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent clung-to and clingable body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā [T 1.0531] purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, prenascence, postnascence. Conascence: clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the physical basis is a condition for not-clung-to but clingable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent not-clung-to but clingable body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo [V 1.0490][M 1.0429] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to and non-clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Prenascence: the physical basis is a condition for not-clung-to and non-clingable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A clung-to and clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon and for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: clung-to and clingable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body, which is clung-to and clingable and not-clung-to but clingable, by way of dissociation condition. (4)

81. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

81. A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence: not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent not-clung-to but clingable body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A not-clung-to but clingable phenomenon is a condition for a clung-to and clingable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence: not-clung-to but clingable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent clung-to and clingable body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0532] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon is a condition for both the clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon and the not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. By way of post-nascence—the not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and to-be-clung-to body and not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to body by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to phenomenon is a condition for the clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. By way of post-nascence—the neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and to-be-clung-to body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to phenomenon is a condition for the not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—by way of conascence and post-nascence. By way of conascence—the neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. By way of post-nascence—the neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to body by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [V 1.0491][M 1.0430] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to phenomenon is a condition for both the clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon and the not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. By way of post-nascence—the neither-clung-to nor to-be-clung-to aggregates are a condition for this previously arisen clung-to and to-be-clung-to body and not-clung-to and to-be-clung-to body by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

82. Upādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0533] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ…pe… ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe… mahābhūtā kaṭattārūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.

82. The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascent: one grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates are a condition for the other two aggregates by way of presence condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, one grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition…pe… two aggregates are a condition for the other two aggregates and for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. The aggregates are a condition for the base…pe… the base is a condition for the aggregates…pe… one great element…pe… the great elements are a condition for kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality by way of presence condition. For non-percipient beings, one great element…pe… the great elements are a condition for kamma-produced materiality and derived materiality by way of presence condition.

Purejātaṃ – sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati.
