Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, assādenti abhinandanti; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… upādinnupādāniyaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ [T 1.0534] kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.

Pre-nascent: Whether trainees or ordinary people, they contemplate the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they relish it, delight in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… displeasure arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states have ceased, resultant consciousness that takes that as its object arises. The ear… nose… tongue… body… grasped and liable-to-be-grasped forms… odors… tastes… tangible objects… the base—they contemplate them as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; they relish it, delight in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… displeasure arises. When wholesome or unwholesome states have ceased, resultant consciousness that takes that as its object arises. The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped odor-base… taste-base… tangible-base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness…pe… the base is a condition for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates by way of presence condition.

Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa [V 1.0492] atthipaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Post-nascent: The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent, grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body by way of presence condition. Grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body by way of presence condition. The material life faculty is a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0431] dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Sahajātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… upādinnupādāniye rūpe… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā upādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passati. Vatthu anupādinnupādāniyaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, and nutriment. Conascent: The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent: One contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one relishes it, delights in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… displeasure arises. The ear… nose… tongue… body… grasped and liable-to-be-grasped forms… odors… tastes… tangible objects… the base—one contemplates them as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one relishes it, delights in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… displeasure arises. With the divine eye, one sees grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form. The base is a condition for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates by way of presence condition. Post-nascent: The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent, not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body by way of presence condition. Grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body by way of presence condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0535] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu anupādinnaanupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition for the not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon by way of presence condition. Pre-nascent: The base is a condition for the not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Sahajāto – upādinnupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (4)

The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon and for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—co-nascence, post-nascence, and nutriment. Co-nascent: One grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality…pe… two grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for mind-produced materiality. Post-nascent: The grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped and not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. Grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition by way of presence for the body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped and not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. (4)

83. Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Sahajāto – anupādinnupādāniyo eko khandho [V 1.0493] tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ [M 1.0432]…pe… mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ… āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ [T 1.0536]… utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ…pe…. Purejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Dibbena cakkhunā anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpaṃ passati. Dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

83. The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, and nutriment. Co-nascent: One not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality…pe… two not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for mind-produced materiality. One great element is a condition by way of presence for the other three great elements…pe… the great elements are a condition by way of presence for mind-produced materiality and derived materiality. External… nutriment-produced… temperature-produced… one great element is a condition by way of presence for the other three great elements…pe…. Pre-nascent: One contemplates a not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form… sound… odor… taste… tangible object as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one relishes it, delights in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… or displeasure arises. With the divine eye, one sees a not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form. With the divine ear element, one hears a sound. Post-nascent: The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent, not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body. Not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition by way of presence for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Purejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniye rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—pre-nascence, post-nascence, and nutriment. Pre-nascent: One contemplates a not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form… sound… odor… taste… tangible object as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; one relishes it, delights in it. Dependent on that, lust arises…pe… or displeasure arises. When wholesome or unwholesome [states] cease, resultant consciousness arises, taking that as its object. A not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped form-base is a condition by way of presence for eye-consciousness…pe… a not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped tangible-base is a condition by way of presence for body-consciousness. Post-nascent: The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent, grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body. Not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa [T 1.0537] ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon and for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—post-nascence and nutriment. Post-nascent: The not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped and not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. Not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped edible food is a condition by way of presence for the body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped and not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. (3)

84. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo [V 1.0494] – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 1.0433] atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

84. The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—one not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates…pe… two not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon. Post-nascent: The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent, grasped and liable-to-be-grasped body. (2)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—co-nascence and post-nascence. Co-nascent: The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for mind-produced materiality. Post-nascent: The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent body, which is not-grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. (3)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca [T 1.0538] anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (4)

The not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon and for the not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped phenomenon—co-nascence and post-nascence. Co-nascent: One not-grasped and not-liable-to-be-grasped aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. Three aggregates are a condition by way of presence for one aggregate and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. Two aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and liable-to-be-grasped. (4)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajāto – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā [V 1.0495] dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 1.0434] purejātassa imassa anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (5)

The non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for both the non-grasped but graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent—one non-grasped and non-graspable aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for mind-produced materiality. Three aggregates are a condition by way of presence for one aggregate and for mind-produced materiality. Two aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for mind-produced materiality. Co-nascent—one non-grasped and non-graspable aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is non-grasped but graspable. Three aggregates are a condition by way of presence for one aggregate and for this pre-nascent body, which is non-grasped but graspable. Two aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is non-grasped but graspable. (5)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca [T 1.0539] anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (6)

The non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped but graspable phenomenon. Post-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates are a condition by way of presence for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and graspable and non-grasped but graspable. (6)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnaanupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajāto – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātassa imassa upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (7)

The non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon is a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable phenomenon, the non-grasped but graspable phenomenon, and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon—co-nascent and post-nascent. Co-nascent—one non-grasped and non-graspable aggregate is a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and graspable and non-grasped but graspable. Three aggregates are a condition by way of presence for one aggregate and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and graspable and non-grasped but graspable. Two aggregates are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates and for this pre-nascent body, which is grasped and graspable and non-grasped but graspable. (7)

85. Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – pacchājātaṃ, indriyaṃ. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

85. The grasped and graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon are a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable phenomenon—post-nascent and faculty. Post-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition by way of presence for kamma-produced materiality. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ[T 1.0540]. Sahajāto – anupādinnaanupādāniyo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā ca vatthu ca ekassa khandhassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The grasped and graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon are a condition by way of presence for the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon—co-nascent and pre-nascent. Co-nascent—one non-grasped and non-graspable aggregate and the physical base are a condition by way of presence for the other three aggregates. Three aggregates and the physical base are a condition by way of presence for one aggregate. Two aggregates and the physical base are a condition by way of presence for the other two aggregates. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā [V 1.0496] ca anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

The non-grasped but graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon are a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable phenomenon—post-nascent and nutriment. Post-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable body. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0435] ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Sahajātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The non-grasped but graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon are a condition by way of presence for the non-grasped but graspable phenomenon—co-nascent, post-nascent, and nutriment. Co-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates and the great elements are a condition by way of presence for mind-produced materiality. Post-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition by way of presence for the non-grasped but graspable body. (2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro [T 1.0541] ca upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The non-grasped but graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped and non-graspable phenomenon are a condition by way of presence for both the grasped and graspable phenomenon and the non-grasped but graspable phenomenon—post-nascent and nutriment. Post-nascent—the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition by way of presence for both the grasped and graspable body and the non-grasped but graspable body. (3)

86. Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Purejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca cakkhāyatanañca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca kāyāyatanañca kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca upādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā ca anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – anupādinnupādāniyā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

86. Grasped and graspable phenomena and non-grasped but graspable phenomena are a condition for a grasped and graspable phenomenon by way of presence: pre-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Pre-nascence: the non-grasped but graspable visible object base and the eye base are a condition for eye-consciousness by way of presence… and so on… the non-grasped but graspable tangible object base and the body base are a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence. The non-grasped but graspable visible object base and the physical base are a condition for the grasped and graspable aggregates by way of presence… and so on… the non-grasped but graspable tangible object base and the physical base are a condition for the grasped and graspable aggregates by way of presence. Post-nascence: the grasped and graspable aggregates and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition for the grasped and graspable body by way of presence. The grasped and graspable material food and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition for the grasped and graspable body by way of presence. Post-nascence: the non-grasped but graspable aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ. Sahajātā – upādinnupādāniyā [V 1.0497] khandhā ca [T 1.0542] mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – anupādinnupādāniyaṃ rūpāyatanañca vatthu ca anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… anupādinnupādāniyaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca vatthu ca anupādinnupādāniyānaṃ khandhānaṃ [M 1.0436] atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – upādinnupādāniyā khandhā ca anupādinnupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro anupādinnupādāniyassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

Grasped and graspable phenomena and non-grasped but graspable phenomena are a condition for a non-grasped but graspable phenomenon by way of presence: co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence, and nutriment. Co-nascence: the grasped and graspable aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-produced materiality by way of presence. Pre-nascence: the non-grasped but graspable visible object base and the physical base are a condition for the non-grasped but graspable aggregates by way of presence… and so on… the non-grasped but graspable tangible object base and the physical base are a condition for the non-grasped but graspable aggregates by way of presence. Post-nascence: the grasped and graspable aggregates and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition for the non-grasped but graspable body by way of presence. The grasped and graspable material food and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition for the non-grasped but graspable body by way of presence. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo… āhāraṃ… upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

Grasped and graspable phenomena and non-grasped but graspable phenomena are a condition by way of presence for a grasped and graspable phenomenon and for a non-grasped but graspable phenomenon… nutriment… the grasped and graspable material food and the non-grasped but graspable material food are a condition by way of presence for the grasped and graspable body and for the non-grasped but graspable body. (3)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Pacchājātā – anupādinnaanupādāniyā khandhā ca anupādinnaanupādāniyo kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

Grasped and graspable phenomena, non-grasped but graspable phenomena, and non-grasped and non-graspable phenomena are a condition for a grasped and graspable phenomenon by way of presence: post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. Post-nascence: the non-grasped and non-graspable aggregates, the non-grasped and non-graspable material food, and the material life faculty are a condition for kamma-produced materiality by way of presence. (1)

Natthi-vigatāvigatapaccayā

Absence, Disappearance, and Non-disappearance Conditions

87. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa [T 1.0543] natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)

87. A grasped and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a grasped and graspable phenomenon by way of absence… by way of disappearance… by way of non-disappearance. (In brief.)

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. The Direct Method

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

Suddhaṃ

The Simple Method

88. Hetuyā [V 1.0498] satta, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye ekādasa, upanissaye nava, purejāte satta, pacchājāte nava, āsevane dve, kamme aṭṭha, vipāke cha, āhāre dvādasa, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte dasa, atthiyā tevīsa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate tevīsa.

88. In root condition, seven; in object condition, six; in predominance condition, five; in contiguity condition, seven; in immediate contiguity condition, seven; in co-nascence condition, nine; in mutuality condition, three; in dependence condition, eleven; in decisive support condition, nine; in pre-nascence condition, seven; in post-nascence condition, nine; in repetition condition, two; in kamma condition, eight; in result condition, six; in nutriment condition, twelve; in faculty condition, seven; in jhāna condition, seven; in path condition, seven; in association condition, three; in dissociation condition, ten; in presence condition, twenty-three; in absence condition, seven; in disappearance condition, seven; in non-disappearance condition, twenty-three.

Sabhāgaṃ

The Homogeneous Method

Hetupaccayā [M 1.0437] adhipatiyā cattāri, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye satta, vipāke cha, indriye satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte cattāri, atthiyā satta, avigate satta (saṃkhittaṃ).

In root condition: with predominance, four; with co-nascence, seven; with mutuality, three; with dependence, seven; with result, six; with faculty, seven; with path, seven; with association, three; with dissociation, four; with presence, seven; with non-disappearance, seven (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattikassa gaṇanā sajjhāyamaggena gaṇitā, evaṃ gaṇetabbā. Kusalattikassa gaṇanato upādinnattike gaṇanā gambhīrā sukhumatarā ca, evaṃ kātūna asammohantena gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(As the enumeration of the wholesome triad is calculated by the method of recitation, so should this be calculated. The enumeration in the appropriated triad is more profound and more subtle than the enumeration of the wholesome triad; thus, it should be enumerated without confusion.)

Anulomaṃ.

The Direct Method.

Paccanīyuddhāro

The Reverse Method

89. Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena [T 1.0544] paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo [V 1.0499]… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

89. A grasped and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a grasped and graspable phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A grasped and graspable phenomenon is a condition for a non-grasped but graspable phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of nutriment condition. (2)

Upādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An unappropriated and appropriating phenomenon is a condition for an unappropriated and appropriating phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of nutriment condition. (1)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [M 1.0438] dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (2)

(2)

Anupādinnupādāniyo [T 1.0545] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

Anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo. (4)

90. Anupādinnaanupādāniyo [V 1.0500] dhammo anupādinnaanupādāniyassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

Anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo upādinnupādāniyassa ca anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (6)

Upādinnupādāniyo ca anupādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (1)

1. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ [T 1.0549][V 1.0504][M 1.0442] dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

1. A defiled and defiling phenomenon arises dependent on a defiled and defiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on one defiled and defiling aggregate, three aggregates... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon arises dependent on a defiled and defiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on defiled and defiling aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Both defiled and defiling phenomena and undefiled but defiling phenomena arise dependent on a defiled and defiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on one defiled and defiling aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ[V 1.0505]; paṭisandhikkhaṇe asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ; khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā…pe… mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ upādārūpaṃ. (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon arises dependent on an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on one undefiled but defiling aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form; at the moment of rebirth-linking, dependent on one undefiled but defiling aggregate, three aggregates and kamma-produced material form... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and kamma-produced material form; dependent on aggregates, the base arises; dependent on the base, aggregates arise; dependent on one great element, three great elements... dependent on the great elements, mind-produced material form, kamma-produced material form, and derived material form arise. (1)

2. Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ [T 1.0550] dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. (1)

2. An undefiled and undefiling phenomenon arises dependent on an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on one undefiled and undefiling aggregate, three aggregates... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesike khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon arises dependent on an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on the undefiled and undefiling aggregates, mind-produced material form arises. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ [M 1.0443] dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ…pe… dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañca rūpaṃ. (3)

Both undefiled but defiling phenomena and undefiled and undefiling phenomena arise dependent on an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on one undefiled and undefiling aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced material form... dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates and mind-produced material form. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikañca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesike khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon arises dependent on both an undefiled but defiling phenomenon and an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on the undefiled and undefiling aggregates and the great elements, mind-produced material form arises. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikañca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ (saṃkhittaṃ). (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon arises dependent on both a defiled and defiling phenomenon and an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by root condition: dependent on the defiled and defiling aggregates and the great elements, mind-produced material form arises (abbreviated). (1)
