8. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0508] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

8. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of root condition: defiled and defiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0445] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of root condition: defiled and defiling roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [T 1.0552] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition by way of root condition for both a defiled and defiling phenomenon and an undefiled but defiling phenomenon: defiled and defiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of root condition: undefiled but defiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, undefiled but defiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for kamma-originated materiality by way of root condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled and undefiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon by way of root condition: undefiled and undefiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates by way of root condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and undefiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of root condition: undefiled and undefiling roots are a condition for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0509] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled and undefiling phenomenon is a condition by way of root condition for both an undefiled but defiling phenomenon and an undefiled and undefiling phenomenon: undefiled and undefiling roots are a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated materiality by way of root condition. (3)

Ārammaṇapaccayo

Object Condition

9. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa [T 1.0553] ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati[M 1.0446]. Diṭṭhiṃ assādeti…pe… vicikicchaṃ ārabbha…pe… uddhaccaṃ ārabbha…pe… domanassaṃ ārabbha…pe…. (1)

9. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of object condition: one savors and delights in lust; taking that as object, lust arises, views arise, doubt arises, restlessness arises, distress arises. One savors views…pe… taking doubt as object…pe… taking restlessness as object…pe… taking distress as object…pe…. (1)

(Yathā kusalattike vibhattaṃ, evaṃ vibhajitabbaṃ.)

(As it is analyzed in the wholesome triad, so should it be analyzed.)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā pahīne kilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhite kilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti, saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti; sekkhā vā puthujjanā vā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, kusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati; saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe assādenti abhinandanti…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati, akusale niruddhe vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjati. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition. Noble ones reflect upon the abandoned defilements, reflect upon the suppressed defilements, know the defilements accumulated in the past; they contemplate the defiled and defiling aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; through the knowledge of the penetration of minds, they know the mind of one endowed with a defiled and defiling mind; trainees or ordinary persons contemplate the defiled and defiling aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; when wholesome states have ceased, a resultant state arises with that as its object; they savor and delight in the defiled and defiling aggregates… and so on… distress arises; when unwholesome states have ceased, a resultant state arises with that as its object. The defiled and defiling aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of the penetration of minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (2)

10. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā[T 1.0554], uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati, ariyā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti, cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti[V 1.0510]; sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti, cetopariyañāṇena asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa[M 1.0447], pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

10. An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition. Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reflects upon that; one reflects upon deeds well done in the past; having emerged from jhāna, one reflects upon the jhāna; noble ones reflect upon change-of-lineage, reflect upon purification; they contemplate the eye as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; the ear… the nose… the tongue… the body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tactile objects… the base, the undefiled but defiling aggregates as impermanent, suffering, and non-self; they see forms with the divine eye, hear sounds with the divine ear element, and know the mind of one endowed with an undefiled but defiling mind through the knowledge of the penetration of minds. The base of infinite space is a condition for the base of infinite consciousness… and so on… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception by way of object condition. The form base is a condition for eye-consciousness by way of object condition… and so on… the tactile object base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of object condition. The undefiled but defiling aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of psychic power, the knowledge of the penetration of minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings according to their kamma, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni assādeti…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ assādeti…pe… cakkhuṃ assādeti[T 1.0555]. Phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ… asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati… domanassaṃ uppajjati. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of object condition. Having given alms, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in that; taking that as object, lust arises, wrong view arises… and so on… distress arises; one savors deeds well done in the past… and so on… having emerged from jhāna, one savors the jhāna… and so on… one savors the eye… tactile objects… the base… one savors and delights in the undefiled but defiling aggregates; taking them as object, lust arises… distress arises. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of object condition—Nibbāna is a condition for the path and the fruit by way of object condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā cetopariyañāṇena asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa, āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition. Noble ones, having emerged from the path, reflect upon the path, reflect upon the fruit, and reflect upon Nibbāna. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage, for purification, and for adverting by way of object condition. Noble ones know the mind of one endowed with an undefiled and non-defiling mind through the knowledge of the penetration of minds. The undefiled and non-defiling aggregates are a condition for the knowledge of the penetration of minds, the knowledge of past lives, the knowledge of the future, and for adverting by way of object condition. (2)

Adhipatipaccayo

Dominance Condition

11. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0511] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena [T 1.0556] paccayo. (1)

11. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition: by object-dominance and conascence-dominance. Object-dominance: esteeming lust, one savors and delights in it; esteeming it, lust arises, wrong view arises. Esteeming wrong view, one savors and delights in it; esteeming it, lust arises, wrong view arises. Conascence-dominance: a defiled and defiling dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0448] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: a defiled and defiling dominant factor is a condition for mind-produced matter by way of dominance condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for both a defiled and defiling phenomenon and an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Conascence-dominance: a defiled and defiling dominant factor is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-produced matter by way of dominance condition. (3)

12. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, sekkhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Sahajātādhipati – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

12. An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for another undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition—through object-dominance or co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one reviews it, treating it as weighty; one reviews past good deeds, treating them as weighty; emerging from jhāna, one reviews the jhāna, treating it as weighty; trainees review change-of-lineage, treating it as weighty; they review purification, treating it as weighty. Co-nascence dominance: an undefiled but defiling dominant phenomenon is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-produced material phenomena by way of dominance condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati – dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati[T 1.0557], taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, pubbe suciṇṇāni [V 1.0512] garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati…pe… jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati…pe… cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati…pe… phoṭṭhabbe…pe… vatthuṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesike khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Object-dominance: having given a gift, undertaken precepts, or performed the Uposatha observance, one savors and delights in that, treating it as weighty; by treating that as weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises. One savors and delights in past good deeds, treating them as weighty... etc. ... emerging from jhāna, one savors and delights in the jhāna, treating it as weighty... etc. ... one savors and delights in the eye, treating it as weighty... etc. ... in tangible objects... etc. ... one savors and delights in the base and the undefiled but defiling aggregates, treating them as weighty; by treating that as weighty, lust arises, wrong view arises.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – nibbānaṃ maggassa, phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition—through object-dominance or co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: Nibbāna is a condition for the path or for the fruit by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: an undefiled and non-defiling dominant phenomenon is a condition for its associated aggregates by way of dominance condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0449] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati – ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition—through object-dominance or co-nascence dominance. Object-dominance: noble ones, having emerged from the path, review the path, treating it as weighty; they review the fruition, treating it as weighty; they review Nibbāna, treating it as weighty. Nibbāna is a condition for change-of-lineage and for purification by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: an undefiled and non-defiling dominant phenomenon is a condition for mind-produced material phenomena by way of dominance condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo[T 1.0558]. Sahajātādhipati – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for both an undefiled but defiling phenomenon and an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of dominance condition. Co-nascence dominance: an undefiled and non-defiling dominant phenomenon is a condition for its associated aggregates and for mind-produced material phenomena by way of dominance condition.

Anantarapaccayo

Contiguity Condition

13. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

13. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. The preceding defiled and defiling aggregates are a condition for the succeeding defiled and defiling aggregates by way of contiguity condition.

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0513] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. The defiled and defiling aggregates are a condition for emergence by way of contiguity condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa… āvajjanā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. The preceding undefiled but defiling aggregates are a condition for the succeeding undefiled but defiling aggregates by way of contiguity condition. Adaptation is a condition for change-of-lineage... adaptation is a condition for purification... adverting is a condition for the undefiled but defiling aggregates by way of contiguity condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – āvajjanā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. Adverting is a condition for the defiled and defiling aggregates by way of contiguity condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0450] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa [T 1.0559]… anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā… nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. Change-of-lineage is a condition for the path… purification is a condition for the path… adaptation is a condition for fruition attainment… for one emerging from cessation, the base of neither perception nor non-perception is a condition for fruition attainment by way of contiguity condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Maggo phalassa… phalaṃ phalassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. The preceding undefiled and non-defiling aggregates are a condition for the succeeding undefiled and non-defiling aggregates by way of contiguity condition. The path is a condition for fruition… fruition is a condition for fruition by way of contiguity condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo – phalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of contiguity condition. Fruition is a condition for emergence by way of contiguity condition.

Samanantarapaccayādi

Proximity Condition, etc.

14. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo…pe… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… aññamaññapaccayena paccayo… nissayapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo [V 1.0514] …pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati…pe… dosaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati. Rāgo…pe… patthanā rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe… niyatamicchādiṭṭhi niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo…pe…. (1)

14. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the contiguity condition… by way of the conascence condition… by way of the mutuality condition… by way of the support condition… by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: Relying on lust, one kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha… relying on hatred, one kills a living being… splits the Saṅgha. Lust… aspiration is a condition for lust… aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. Killing a living being is a condition for killing a living being by way of the decisive support condition… fixed wrong view is a condition for fixed wrong view by way of the decisive support condition… (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa [T 1.0560] upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ… vipassanaṃ… abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Rāgo…pe… patthanā saddhāya…pe… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇaṃ hantvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti, jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ [M 1.0451] uppādeti, abhiññaṃ uppādeti, samāpattiṃ uppādeti…pe… saṅghaṃ bhinditvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti. Akusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: Relying on lust, one gives gifts, undertakes precepts, performs the Uposatha observance, develops jhāna… insight… higher knowledge, attains meditative absorption… relying on aspiration, one gives gifts… attains meditative absorption. Lust… aspiration is a condition for faith… bodily pleasure, bodily pain by way of the decisive support condition. Having killed a living being, one gives gifts, undertakes precepts, performs the Uposatha observance, develops jhāna, develops insight, develops higher knowledge, attains meditative absorption in order to counteract that… having split the Saṅgha, one gives gifts, undertakes precepts, performs the Uposatha observance in order to counteract that. Unwholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pakatūpanissayo – rāgaṃ upanissāya maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Dosaṃ…pe… patthanaṃ upanissāya maggaṃ uppādeti, phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Rāgo…pe… patthanā maggassa… phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition. Natural decisive support: Relying on lust, one develops the path, attains fruition attainment. Relying on hatred… relying on aspiration, one develops the path, attains fruition attainment. Lust… aspiration is a condition for the path… fruition attainment by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

15. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sīlaṃ… sutaṃ… cāgaṃ… paññaṃ… kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ… kāyikaṃ [T 1.0561] dukkhaṃ… utuṃ… bhojanaṃ… senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti…pe… samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ saddhāya…pe… kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo[V 1.0515]. Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa…pe…. (1)

15. An undefiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: Relying on faith, one gives gifts… attains meditative absorption. Relying on virtue… learning… generosity… wisdom… bodily pleasure… bodily pain… climate… food… lodging, one gives gifts… attains meditative absorption. Faith… lodging is a condition for faith… bodily pleasure, bodily pain by way of the decisive support condition. Wholesome kamma is a condition for its result by way of the decisive support condition. The preparatory work for the first jhāna is a condition for the first jhāna… the base of nothingness is a condition for the base of neither perception nor non-perception… (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ…pe… senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati…pe… saṅghaṃ bhindati, saddhā…pe… senāsanaṃ rāgassa…pe… patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: Relying on faith, one boasts, grasps a view; relying on virtue… relying on lodging, one kills living beings… splits the Saṅgha. Faith… lodging is a condition for lust… aspiration by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa…pe… dutiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyassa maggassa…pe… catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: The preparatory work for the first path is a condition for the first path… the second path… the third path… the fourth path by way of the decisive support condition. (3)

16. Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0452] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa…pe… dutiyo maggo tatiyassa maggassa…pe… tatiyo maggo catutthassa [T 1.0562] maggassa…pe… maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

16. An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: The first path is a condition for the second path… the second path is a condition for the third path… the third path is a condition for the fourth path… the path is a condition for fruition attainment by way of the decisive support condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo…pe…. Pakatūpanissayo – ariyā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti, uppannaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjanti, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Maggo ariyānaṃ atthappaṭisambhidāya…pe… ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the decisive support condition—object decisive support, contiguity decisive support, natural decisive support… Natural decisive support: Noble ones, relying on the path, produce unarisen attainments, enter into arisen attainments, and contemplate formations as impermanent, suffering, and non-self. The path is a condition for the noble ones’ analytical knowledge of meaning… skill in knowing what is possible and impossible by way of the decisive support condition. Fruition attainment is a condition for bodily pleasure by way of the decisive support condition. (2)

Purejātapaccayo

Pre-nascence Condition

17. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0516] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; sotaṃ… ghānaṃ… jivhaṃ… kāyaṃ… rūpe… sadde… gandhe… rase… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

17. The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one contemplates the eye as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self; the ear… nose… tongue… body… forms… sounds… odors… tastes… tangibles… the base as impermanent, as suffering, as not-self. With the divine eye, one sees forms; with the divine ear-element, one hears sounds. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the tangible-base for body-consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. Base pre-nascence—the eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness…pe… the body-base for body-consciousness by way of the pre-nascence condition. The base is a condition for the undefiled but defilable aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [T 1.0563] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati[M 1.0453]; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ – vatthu saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—object pre-nascence, base pre-nascence. Object pre-nascence—one savors and delights in the eye; dependent on that, lust arises…pe… grief arises. The ear…pe… tangible objects… the base: one savors and delights in the base; dependent on that, lust arises…pe… grief arises. Base pre-nascence—the base is a condition for the defiled and defilable aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo – vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of the pre-nascence condition—the base is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable aggregates by way of the pre-nascence condition. (3)

Pacchājātapaccayo

Post-nascence Condition

18. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

18. The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition—the subsequently arisen defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition—the subsequently arisen undefiled but defilable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0517] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo – pacchājātā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena [T 1.0564] paccayo. (1)

The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the post-nascence condition—the subsequently arisen undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of the post-nascence condition. (1)

Āsevanapaccayo

Repetition Condition

19. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

19. The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of the repetition condition—the former defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for the latter defiled and defilable aggregates by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – purimā purimā…pe… anulomaṃ gotrabhussa… anulomaṃ vodānassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the repetition condition—the preceding…pe… adaptation for change-of-lineage… adaptation for purification, by way of the repetition condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo – gotrabhu maggassa… vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of the repetition condition—change-of-lineage for the path… purification for the path, by way of the repetition condition. (2)

Kammapaccayo

Kamma Condition

20. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0454] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

20. The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of the kamma condition—defiled and defilable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the kamma condition—simultaneous and non-simultaneous. Simultaneous: defiled and defilable volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the kamma condition. Non-simultaneous: defiled and defilable volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the kamma condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca [T 1.0565] dhammassa [V 1.0518] kammapaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for both a defiled and defilable phenomenon and an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the kamma condition. Defiled and defilable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the kamma condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe…. Nānākkhaṇikā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of the kamma condition—simultaneous and non-simultaneous. Simultaneous: undefiled but defilable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the kamma condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking…pe…. Non-simultaneous: undefiled but defilable volition is a condition for the resultant aggregates and for kamma-produced material phenomena by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā, nānākkhaṇikā. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākkhaṇikā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā kusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of the kamma condition—simultaneous and non-simultaneous. Simultaneous: undefiled and undefilable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates by way of the kamma condition. Non-simultaneous: undefiled and undefilable wholesome volition is a condition for the resultant undefiled and undefilable aggregates by way of the kamma condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent: undefiled and undefilable volition is a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0455] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo – sahajātā [T 1.0566] asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for both an undefiled but defilable phenomenon and an undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of kamma condition—co-nascent: undefiled and undefilable volition is a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of kamma condition. (3)

Vipākapaccayo

Resultant Condition

21. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo =19 …pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe… khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. (1)

21. An undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of resultant condition—a single resultant undefiled but defilable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates... and so on... at the moment of rebirth-linking, a single resultant undefiled but defilable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and kamma-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates... and so on... the aggregates are a condition for the physical basis by way of resultant condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ…pe…. (1)

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of resultant condition—a single resultant undefiled and undefilable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates by way of resultant condition... and so on... two aggregates are a condition for two aggregates... and so on. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipākā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. (2) Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo – vipāko asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of resultant condition—the resultant undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition. (2) An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon and an undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of resultant condition—a single resultant undefiled and undefilable aggregate is a condition for the three aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of resultant condition... and so on... two aggregates... and so on. (3)

Āhārapaccayo

Nutriment Condition

22. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [T 1.0567] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

22. A defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of nutriment condition... threefold.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0456] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo.

An undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of nutriment condition—undefiled but defilable nutriments are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of nutriment condition. At the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... physical nutriment is a condition for this body by way of nutriment condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of nutriment condition... threefold.

Indriyapaccayo

Faculty Condition

23. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0520] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo… tīṇi.

23. A defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of faculty condition... threefold.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo.

An undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of faculty condition—undefiled but defilable faculties are a condition for the associated aggregates and mind-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking... and so on... the eye faculty is a condition for eye-consciousness... and so on... the body faculty is a condition for body-consciousness by way of faculty condition. The material life-faculty is a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of faculty condition.

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo… tīṇi.

An undefiled and undefilable phenomenon... threefold.

Jhānapaccayādi

Jhāna Condition, etc.

24. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo… maggapaccayena paccayo… sampayuttapaccayena paccayo.

24. A defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of jhāna condition... by way of path condition... by way of association condition.

Vippayuttapaccayo

Dissociation Condition

25. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [T 1.0568] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

25. A defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascence—defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascence—defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0457] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo; paṭisandhikkhaṇe asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa…pe… vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena [V 1.0521] paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—co-nascence, pre-nascence, post-nascence. Co-nascence—undefiled but defilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition; at the moment of rebirth-linking, undefiled but defilable aggregates are a condition for kamma-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. The aggregates are a condition for the physical basis... and so on... the physical basis is a condition for the aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence—the eye-basis is a condition for eye-consciousness... and so on... the body-basis is a condition for body-consciousness by way of dissociation condition. The physical basis is a condition for the undefiled but defilable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. Post-nascence—undefiled but defilable aggregates are a condition for this pre-nascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence—the physical basis is a condition for the defiled and defilable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikānaṃ [T 1.0569] khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (3)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition. Pre-nascence—the physical basis is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable aggregates by way of dissociation condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (1)

The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of dissociation condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of dissociation condition. Postnascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of dissociation condition. (1)

Atthipaccayo

Presence Condition

26. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

26. The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition—one defiled and defilable aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā [M 1.0458] – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence—the defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Postnascence—the defiled and defilable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa [V 1.0522] atthipaccayena paccayo – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… dve khandhā…pe…. (3)

The defiled and defilable phenomenon is a condition for both the defiled and defilable and the undefiled but defilable phenomena by way of presence condition—one defiled and defilable aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition… two aggregates…. (3)

27. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ[T 1.0570], indriyaṃ. Sahajāto – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… paṭisandhikkhaṇe…pe… asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe… purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Sotaṃ…pe… kāyaṃ… rūpe…pe… phoṭṭhabbe… vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa…pe… kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa…pe… vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷīkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa…pe… rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

27. The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition: conascence, prenascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascence—one undefiled but defilable aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition… at the moment of rebirth-linking… for non-percipient beings, one great element is a condition for the other three great elements by way of presence condition… prenascence—one contemplates the eye as impermanent, suffering, and not-self. The ear… the body… forms… tactile objects… the physical base as impermanent, suffering, and not-self; one sees forms with the divine eye; hears sounds with the divine ear-element. The form-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the tactile-base is a condition for body-consciousness by way of presence condition. The eye-base is a condition for eye-consciousness… the body-base is a condition for body-consciousness… the physical base is a condition for the undefiled but defilable aggregates by way of presence condition. Postnascence—the undefiled but defilable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. Physical nutriment is a condition for this body… the material life faculty is a condition for materiality produced by kamma by way of presence condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati…pe… domanassaṃ uppajjati; vatthuṃ assādeti…pe… vatthu saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the defiled and defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascence—one savors and delights in the eye; dependent on that, lust arises…pe… sorrow arises; one savors the physical base…pe… the physical base is a condition for the defiled and defilable aggregates by way of presence condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ – vatthu asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikānaṃ [T 1.0571] khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (3)

The undefiled but defilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of presence condition. Prenascence—the physical base is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable aggregates by way of presence condition. (3)

28. Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0523][M 1.0459] dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…. (1)

28. The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled and undefilable phenomenon by way of presence condition—one undefiled and undefilable aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates by way of presence condition…. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṃkilisikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence. Conascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Postnascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates are a condition for this prenascent body by way of presence condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…. (3)

The undefiled and undefilable phenomenon is a condition for both the undefiled but defilable and the undefiled and undefilable phenomena by way of presence condition—one undefiled and undefilable aggregate is a condition for the other three aggregates and for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition…. (3)

29. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ [T 1.0572] atthipaccayena paccayo. (1)

29. The undefiled but defilable and the undefiled and undefilable phenomena are a condition for the undefiled but defilable phenomenon by way of presence condition—conascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of presence condition. Postnascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this body by way of presence condition. Postnascence—the undefiled and undefilable aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for materiality produced by kamma by way of presence condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo…pe…. (2)

The undefiled but defiling and the undefiled and non-defiling phenomena are a condition for the undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascence and prenascence. Conascence—one undefiled and non-defiling aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates… and so on. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo… dve khandhā…pe…. (1)

The defiled and defiling and the undefiled but defiling phenomena are a condition for the defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascence and prenascence. Conascence—one defiled and defiling aggregate and the physical base are a condition for the three aggregates… two aggregates… and so on. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0460] ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo – sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. Sahajātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca kabaḷīkāro āhāro ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā [V 1.0524] – saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (2)

The defiled and defiling and the undefiled but defiling phenomena are a condition for the undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of the presence condition—conascence, postnascence, nutriment, and faculty. Conascence—the defiled and defiling aggregates and the great elements are a condition for mind-originated material phenomena by way of the presence condition. Postnascence—the defiled and defiling aggregates and physical nutriment are a condition for this pre-arisen body by way of the presence condition. Postnascence—the defiled and defiling aggregates and the material life faculty are a condition for materiality produced by kamma by way of the presence condition. (2)

Natthi-vigatāvigatapaccayā

Absence, Disappearance, and Non-disappearance Conditions.

30. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa natthipaccayena paccayo… vigatapaccayena paccayo… avigatapaccayena paccayo.

30. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of the absence condition… by way of the disappearance condition… by way of the non-disappearance condition.

1. Paccayānulomaṃ

1. Concordance of Conditions

2. Saṅkhyāvāro

2. Numerical Enumeration

Suddhaṃ

Pure

31. Hetuyā [T 1.0573] satta, ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā aṭṭha, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi, kamme satta, vipāke cattāri, āhāre satta, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate terasa.

31. By root condition—seven; by object condition—six; by dominance condition—eight; by contiguity condition—seven; by immediate contiguity condition—seven; by co-nascence condition—nine; by mutuality condition—three; by support condition—thirteen; by decisive support condition—eight; by pre-nascence condition—three; by post-nascence condition—three; by repetition condition—three; by kamma condition—seven; by result condition—four; by nutriment condition—seven; by faculty condition—seven; by jhāna condition—seven; by path condition—seven; by association condition—three; by dissociation condition—five; by presence condition—thirteen; by absence condition—seven; by disappearance condition—seven; by non-disappearance condition—thirteen.

Hetusabhāgaṃ

Root-related Section

Hetupaccayā adhipatiyā cattāri, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye satta, vipāke cattāri, indriye cattāri, magge cattāri, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, atthiyā satta, avigate satta.

By root condition and dominance condition—four; by co-nascence condition—seven; by mutuality condition—three; by support condition—seven; by result condition—four; by faculty condition—four; by path condition—four; by association condition—three; by dissociation condition—three; by presence condition—seven; by non-disappearance condition—seven.

Hetusāmaññaghaṭanā (9)

Combination of Root-Conditions and Associated Factors (9)

32. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-atthi-avigatanti [V 1.0525] satta. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissayaatthi-avigatanti tīṇi. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-sampayutta-atthi-avigatanti [M 1.0461] tīṇi. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti tīṇi. (Avipākaṃ – 4)

32. Root, co-nascence, support, presence, and non-disappearance: seven. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, presence, and non-disappearance: three. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, association, presence, and non-disappearance: three. Root, co-nascence, support, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance: three. (Non-resultant – 4)

Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipāka-atthi-avigatanti cattāri. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamaññanissaya-vipāka-atthi-avigatanti dve. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-vipākasampayutta-atthi-avigatanti dve. Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti dve. Hetu-sahajāta-aññamañña-nissaya-vipāka-vippayutta-atthi-avigatanti ekaṃ. (Savipākaṃ – 5) (saṃkhittaṃ.)

Root, co-nascence, support, result, presence, and non-disappearance: four. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, result, presence, and non-disappearance: two. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, result, association, presence, and non-disappearance: two. Root, co-nascence, support, result, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance: two. Root, co-nascence, mutuality, support, result, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance: one. (With result – 5) (in brief.)

(Yathā kusalattike, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).

Anulomaṃ.

Concordance.

Paccanīyuddhāro

Summary of Opposites

33. Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [T 1.0574] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

33. A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (3)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of decisive support condition. (3)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0526] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (4)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon and for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (4)

34. Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo… kammapaccayena paccayo… āhārapaccayena paccayo… indriyapaccayena paccayo. (1)

34. An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition… by way of post-nascence condition… by way of kamma condition… by way of nutriment condition… by way of faculty condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [M 1.0462] dhammo saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa [T 1.0575] upanissayapaccayena paccayo… purejātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of decisive support condition… by way of pre-nascence condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (1)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo… sahajātapaccayena paccayo… upanissayapaccayena paccayo… pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (2)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of object condition… by way of co-nascence condition… by way of decisive support condition… by way of post-nascence condition. (2)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko dhammo asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa ca dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo. (3)

An undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon is a condition for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon and for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence condition. (3)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (1)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon and an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon are conditions for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (1)

Asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko [V 1.0527] ca asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (2)

An undefiled but defiling phenomenon and an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon are conditions for an undefiled and non-defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. (2)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. (1)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon and an undefiled but defiling phenomenon are conditions for a defiled and defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence and pre-nascence. (1)

Saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko ca dhammā asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikassa dhammassa sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ, āhāraṃ, indriyaṃ. (2)

A defiled and defiling phenomenon and an undefiled but defiling phenomenon are conditions for an undefiled but defiling phenomenon by way of co-nascence, post-nascence, nutriment, and faculty. (2)

2. Paccayapaccanīyaṃ

2. The Negative Mode of Conditional Relations

Suddhaṃ

The Simple Section

35. Nahetuyā [T 1.0576] cuddasa, naārammaṇe cuddasa, naadhipatiyā cuddasa, naanantare cuddasa, nasamanantare cuddasa, nasahajāte dasa, naaññamaññe dasa, nanissaye dasa, naupanissaye terasa, napurejāte dvādasa, napacchājāte cuddasa, naāsevane cuddasa, nakamme cuddasa, navipāke cuddasa[M 1.0463], naāhāre cuddasa, naindriye cuddasa, najhāne cuddasa, namagge cuddasa, nasampayutte dasa, navippayutte aṭṭha, noatthiyā aṭṭha, nonatthiyā cuddasa, novigate cuddasa, noavigate aṭṭha.

35. Not by way of root condition, fourteen; not by way of object condition, fourteen; not by way of predominance condition, fourteen; not by way of contiguity condition, fourteen; not by way of immediate contiguity condition, fourteen; not by way of co-nascence condition, ten; not by way of mutuality condition, ten; not by way of dependence condition, ten; not by way of strong dependence condition, thirteen; not by way of pre-nascence condition, twelve; not by way of post-nascence condition, fourteen; not by way of repetition condition, fourteen; not by way of kamma condition, fourteen; not by way of result condition, fourteen; not by way of nutriment condition, fourteen; not by way of faculty condition, fourteen; not by way of jhāna condition, fourteen; not by way of path condition, fourteen; not by way of association condition, ten; not by way of dissociation condition, eight; not by way of presence condition, eight; not by way of absence condition, fourteen; not by way of disappearance condition, fourteen; not by way of non-disappearance condition, eight.

Dukaṃ

The Dyad

Nahetupaccayā naārammaṇe cuddasa (saṃkhittaṃ.)

Not by way of root condition, not by way of object condition, fourteen (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike paccanīyagaṇanā, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration of the negatives in the wholesome triad, so should it be counted.)

Paccanīyaṃ.

The Negative Mode.

3. Paccayānulomapaccanīyaṃ

3. The Affirmative-Negative Mode of Conditional Relations

Hetudukaṃ

The Root Dyad

36. Hetupaccayā [V 1.0528] naārammaṇe satta, naadhipatiyā satta, naanantare satta, nasamanantare satta, naaññamaññe tīṇi, naupanissaye satta, napurejāte satta, napacchājāte satta, naāsevane satta, nakamme satta, navipāke satta, naāhāre satta, naindriye satta, najhāne satta, namagge satta, nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā satta, novigate satta.

36. By way of root condition: not by way of object condition, seven; not by way of predominance condition, seven; not by way of contiguity condition, seven; not by way of immediate contiguity condition, seven; not by way of mutuality condition, three; not by way of strong dependence condition, seven; not by way of pre-nascence condition, seven; not by way of post-nascence condition, seven; not by way of repetition condition, seven; not by way of kamma condition, seven; not by way of result condition, seven; not by way of nutriment condition, seven; not by way of faculty condition, seven; not by way of jhāna condition, seven; not by way of path condition, seven; not by way of association condition, three; not by way of dissociation condition, three; not by way of absence condition, seven; not by way of disappearance condition, seven.

Ghaṭanā

The Arrangement

Hetu-sahajāta-nissaya-atthi-avigatanti naārammaṇe satta…pe… naaññamaññe tīṇi…pe… nasampayutte tīṇi, navippayutte tīṇi…pe… novigate satta (saṃkhittaṃ.)

Root, co-nascence, dependence, presence, non-disappearance—not by way of object condition, seven… and so on… not by way of mutuality condition, three… and so on… not by way of association condition, three; not by way of dissociation condition, three… and so on… not by way of disappearance condition, seven (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike anulomapaccanīyagaṇanā vibhattā, evaṃ vibhajitabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration of the affirmative-negative mode is distinguished in the wholesome triad, so should it be distinguished.)

Anulomapaccanīyaṃ.

The Affirmative-Negative Mode.

4. Paccayapaccanīyānulomaṃ

4. The Negative-Affirmative Mode of Conditional Relations

Nahetudukaṃ

The Non-Root Dyad

37. Nahetupaccayā [M 1.0464] ārammaṇe cha, adhipatiyā aṭṭha, anantare satta, samanantare satta, sahajāte nava, aññamaññe tīṇi, nissaye terasa, upanissaye aṭṭha, purejāte tīṇi, pacchājāte tīṇi, āsevane tīṇi[T 1.0577], kamme satta, vipāke cattāri, āhāre satta, indriye satta, jhāne satta, magge satta, sampayutte tīṇi, vippayutte pañca, atthiyā terasa, natthiyā satta, vigate satta, avigate terasa.

37. Not by way of root condition: by way of object condition, six; by way of predominance condition, eight; by way of contiguity condition, seven; by way of immediate contiguity condition, seven; by way of co-nascence condition, nine; by way of mutuality condition, three; by way of dependence condition, thirteen; by way of strong dependence condition, eight; by way of pre-nascence condition, three; by way of post-nascence condition, three; by way of repetition condition, three; by way of kamma condition, seven; by way of result condition, four; by way of nutriment condition, seven; by way of faculty condition, seven; by way of jhāna condition, seven; by way of path condition, seven; by way of association condition, three; by way of dissociation condition, five; by way of presence condition, thirteen; by way of absence condition, seven; by way of disappearance condition, seven; by way of non-disappearance condition, thirteen.

Tikaṃ

The Triad

Nahetupaccayā [V 1.0529] naārammaṇapaccayā adhipatiyā satta (saṃkhittaṃ.)

Not by way of root condition, not by way of object condition: by way of predominance condition, seven (in brief).

(Yathā kusalattike paccanīyānulomagaṇanā vibhattā, evaṃ vibhajitabbaṃ.)

(Just as the enumeration of the negative-affirmative mode is analyzed in the wholesome triad, so should it be analyzed.)

Paccanīyānulomaṃ.

The Negative-Affirmative Mode.

Saṃkiliṭṭhattikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Defiled Triad is concluded.

Paṭṭhānapāḷi paṭhamo bhāgo niṭṭhito.

The First Part of the Paṭṭhāna is concluded.
